Skill rediscovery uses one authoritative catalog and deterministic text; disabled or newly restricted skills cannot reuse an activation cache. [Goal changes](flower-goals.md) use Floret-owned typed context facts, separate from the four product-collected partitions.

entries.title: Gateway v6 independent device protocol
entries.summary: Gateway v6, authority epoch 70, defines independent client-device trust and Runtime attachments. Cloud machine management and publication are absent. Client public routes are pairing/challenge, pairing/complete, identity, catalog, access/open and access/service under /gateway/v6.

entries.title: RCPP v5 Cloud API
entries.summary: RCPP v5 separates Cloud authority from route. CloudRuntimeBinding binds Environment/Runtime/Namespace/principal/generation. One Runtime controller owns direct/Gateway enrollment, registration, heartbeat, reserve and recovery; Desktop never duplicates credential ownership.

entries.title: Self-contained installer distribution
entries.summary: Release produces CGO-free macOS/Linux amd64/arm64 self-contained installers, renders bootstrap from exact binary digests and signs SHA256SUMS. Receiver needs shell/HTTPS downloader/SHA256, not Go/Cosign/Python/OpenSSL/package manager.

entries.title: CI and release gates
entries.summary: Focused checks precede staged pre-commit and exact-tip main admission. Long-thread/browser/Electron/broad UI/Docker/native/stress remain explicit. Release requires authenticated artifacts and same-commit historical-conversation Actions. Staged notices use index snapshot/installed metadata/cached exact Go with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, no network/index rewrite.

entries.title: ReDevPlugin release artifact gate
entries.summary: Consume the coordinated published ReDevPlugin release with artifacts bound to tag, source, target, digest, signer and receipt. Exactly one platform-release-manifest.json binds tag/source/workflow/attestation. Independently verify Go proxy/SumDB h1/go.mod, two npm SHA512/provenance, runtime/worker crates checksums/Cargo VCS, manifest version/closed coordinate order/contract-set hash.

entries.title: Plugin integration gate
entries.summary: Plugin gate checks released ReDevPlugin Host/market against Redeven authority, placement, renderer and Desktop lifecycle. Use published packages/isolated profiles; copied platform paths, implicit grants, second bridges and stale projections fail instead of fabricating integration.

entries.title: OKF release assets
entries.summary: Releases distribute OKF manifest and SHA256 verification assets alongside CLI/Desktop packages and signed SHA256SUMS. The signed aggregate remains their public integrity anchor; standalone verification files never replace authenticated release checksums or source provenance.

entries.title: Automated service-template catalog updates
entries.summary: The template repository publishes immutable recommendations. Redeven daily/manual adoption pins public Go checksums, regenerates notices/OKF and passes normal integration checks. Failure retains published main and uncertain push requires ref inspection.

entries.title: Deploy and qualify standalone Web Center
entries.summary: Center binary/UI deploy separately from Runtime/Desktop. Package contains binary/UI,two units,environment examples,Docker/Compose/.env,licenses,DEPLOYMENT.md and manifest. --version reads source/time without state. Reject dirty source and extra/missing/link/mismatched target/tag/digest; both targets share commit.

entries.title: Flower persistent-index startup acceptance
entries.summary: Published Floret 7.52.0 on an isolated 710,344,704 B/219-thread database achieves full product construction/activation P95 9.429 s over 20 runs, with maximum GC-live heap 261.052 MiB upstream/295.018 MiB product. Targets≤10 s/350 MiB pass for this dataset; canonical validation still has substantial temporary allocation.

entries.title: Control-plane capacity qualification
entries.summary: Capacity acceptance runs10000 Runtime sessions through real Nginx/TLS/MySQL and canonical admission with production heartbeat/recovery. Combine client latency/recovery with independently measured server CPU/RSS/database/queues/challenges; client success alone is insufficient.

entries.title: ReDevPlugin target build toolchain
entries.summary: Redeven prepares target C compilation and archiving alongside Rust before building the exact published ReDevPlugin source crate. macOS builds Linux static PIE with pinned Zig and the existing Rust LLD wrapper. `scripts/redevplugin_build_toolchain.json` pins Rust 1.98.0, Zig 0.16.0, official archive checksums and build-input files.

entries.title: Graphical window native transport qualification
entries.summary: Published graphical transport passes direct, encrypted tunnel, authority and Linux checks. Host lock blocks active macOS capture/Electron fullscreen; locked-host refusal does not qualify unlocked use. Functional results remain separate from performance qualification.

entries.title: Current-desktop acceptance method
entries.summary: Qualify the desktop contract using published dependencies/GOWORK=off. Preserve failures and meet agreed-host thresholds before acceptance; integration, a picture, admitted input or synthetic fixture cannot substitute for real performance. The acceptance record owns measured results and remaining work.

entries.title: Remote desktop product, reconnect and physical-device evidence
entries.summary: Published product runs separately qualify office interaction, reconnect, physical locks and capture formats. Keep failed latency, frame, authority and setup outcomes with their original versions. Later successes cover named fixtures only; physical IME, acoustic output, photons and cross-product parity remain limited.

entries.title: LAN C05 comparison, preparation and experiment decisions
entries.summary: Published six-frame Linux delivery retains all three paired RustDesk outcomes, source-input audits and adverse trials. One favorable round does not prove parity or identify a cause. Immutable candidate and fixture identities constrain retries, with published compatibility and real performance qualification kept distinct.

entries.title: Wayland capture qualification and unresolved limits
entries.summary: Live GNOME, installed native fixtures and synthetic PipeWire measurements qualify different paths. Retain the functional-only udesk24 designation, failed consent/layout/performance results and exact published identities. Later synthetic improvements do not certify live capture, physical input or full release acceptance.

entries.title: Prepare Linux hosts for native applications
entries.summary: Floe Native Apps prepares managed Wayland/Xwayland; Desktop may transfer verified offline archives. No monitor/full desktop is needed. Snap/Flatpak require installed services; missing prerequisites get guidance, never automatic security changes. Refresh after explicit admin preparation.

entries.title: Host application qualification methods and platform evidence
entries.summary: Qualify process/window, decoded picture and actual app effects independently using published dependencies. Preserve failures, exact scope and save/cancel semantics. Userspace/package evidence certifies no host policy, arbitrary app, physical pointer or OS IME.

entries.title: Host application picture performance
entries.summary: Floe Native Apps owns picture capture/codec; Redeven forwards/qualifies display choices. Measure actual pixels/bytes and retain failed budgets; these workloads certify no video/WAN/physical-display/universal parity.

entries.title: ReDevPlugin 3.15 performance qualification
entries.summary: ReDevPlugin3.15.0 improved measured warm execution. Redeven defers unopened placements while retaining opened surfaces. [Host boundary](../architecture/redevplugin-boundary.md) owns current contracts; these source/workload-specific results are not a universal SLA.

entries.title: Flower explicit long-thread qualification
entries.summary: Complete conversations and responsive interaction are required. Record source/tree cleanliness, tools, dependencies, metrics and supervised cleanup. Product/dependency changes invalidate timing. Policy-only changes may cite unchanged-product evidence with its original source identity.

entries.title: Flower streaming, request-history and navigation qualification
entries.summary: Published Floret owns canonical reads and bounded source reuse; Redeven qualifies queue, history and rendering together through real Service and production browser/Electron. Retain original source identities, workload differences and failed absolute budgets. Relative CPU gains and later passes never erase adverse runs.

entries.title: Flower context qualification methods and historical attribution limits
entries.summary: Qualify published Floret through production Runtime/surfaces in isolated deterministic, installed Ollama and real DeepSeek lanes. Native tokens and visible characters are independent. Retain attribution failures, exact source scope and untested providers.

entries.title: Flower Ollama task qualification
entries.summary: Explicit Ollama qualification uses the installed model, production Flower and published Floret. Verify real tool effects, files, processes, canonical views and streams. Failures remain failures without simulated substitutes or automatic reruns. Tests own cleanup and preserve source credentials/configuration.

concepts.title: AI tool runtime and canonical interaction ownership

frontmatter.title: AI tool runtime and canonical interaction ownership

concepts.summary: Redeven supplies typed product tools, policies, effects and presentation; Floret owns invocation, irreversible intent, approvals and admitted history. Lease release follows the canonical terminal view, not the HTTP response or Desktop connection lifetime, so an existing session cannot admit hidden work after the final lifecycle snapshot.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Runtime
Floret renders reference display content and snapshots into canonical model history for execution and compaction, preserving order across follow-ups.

## Interactions
Resolve commits before publication; pending interaction/active projection publish atomically and waiting clears run_progress. Persistence failure stays unresolved; rejection/cancellation is row-local, never global failure.

Each interaction has one stable identity and belongs to one thread and tool call or input request.

Canonical effect intent is written before an irreversible operation.

Redeven handlers return the typed terminal current view without waiting for provider continuation, receipt observation, authority release, or a legacy local handler.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Redeven must consume published Floret releases and must not persist a second copy of Floret-owned conversation, tool, approval, todo, context, projection, or provider state. Tool and execution provenance must come from explicit contracts and results rather than inference.

Floret owns canonical interaction identity, atomic answer settlement, effect-attempt state, cancellation, and unknown-outcome termination. Browser interaction state is presentation only and cannot authorize, settle, or replay an effect.

concepts.title: Local ChatGPT admission and account lifecycle

frontmatter.title: Local ChatGPT admission and account lifecycle

concepts.summary: Authenticated local capability and verified account facts govern ChatGPT registration, renewal and requests. Interrupted logout is completed at startup; normal maintenance scans never clear a live logout. Account updates use model_directory.changed and merge independently of drafts.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Account lifecycle
### Sign-in and registration
One `chatgpt.Client` owns bounded, five-minute in-memory attempts.

### Renewal and credential coordination
[Account maintenance](../../internal/chatgpt/lifecycle.go) starts with the Runtime service, independently of AI readiness, connection bindings and open windows. Runtime shutdown cancels maintenance without signing out and never schedules OS background work.

### Logout and connection changes
Sign-out first records intent and stops related tasks through Floret's existing immediate Cancel with descendants. The private Desktop model source observes current account facts once per second and passes confirmed account stop reasons to its owning Runtime; it never owns another task lifecycle.

The Runtime Service protocol, secrets schema, Floret public API and domain migration remain unchanged.

## Local admission
### Local host admission
The authenticated Runtime settings response publishes `auth_capabilities` with an `openai_chatgpt` availability, disabled reason and connection binding. Desktop identity, loopback URL text, renderer headers and client declarations cannot establish local access.

That source executes against the local account store; the remote settings page exposes no account login, credential transfer or account email.

### Account lifecycle
The [ChatGPT account lifecycle](#account-lifecycle) is the canonical owner of registration, verified sign-in persistence, issued-client retry, local saved-account selection, renewal, cancellation cleanup and logout. Connection saves and explicit logout have separate results.

### Model and request contracts
The public account model endpoint's listed models preserve server order and are intersected with reviewed adapter capabilities. ChatGPT connections reject custom endpoints, API credentials and custom model declarations.

No error silently switches authentication or API billing.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
This concept owns local registration and credential lifecycle. Connection configuration stores only account bindings; it cannot commit or roll back OAuth tokens. Cancellation cleanup may retain a verified signed-out registration, and remote revocation failure never becomes confirmed success.

Floret owns canonical conversation, engine execution and opaque provider state.

Old API-key-only saves remain supported.

concepts.title: Browser and native drag timing qualification

frontmatter.title: Browser and native drag timing qualification

concepts.summary:
Browser drag timing is measured from actual input events, with all model and
assertion failures retained. [Script contracts](computer-use-scripts.md) define
behavior; [qualification](computer-use-qualification.md) defines the test lane.
Browser measurements certify only the tested browser paths and durations.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Measure drag duration between delivered press and release events. Keep
deterministic adapter assertions separate from real-provider task outcomes,
and retain original failures when correcting test expectations.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Browser qualification neither changed nor timed native delivery. The subsequent native repair has separate evidence. Local event spans do not guarantee arbitrary application actions or general model reliability. Retain all original failures.

sections.title: Evidence
sections.body:
October 28 browser regressions reproduced duration, coordinates, both transports and interruption boundaries. Repair passed focused Node/Go/vet checks; delivered 5,000-ms spans were ~5,007/5,004 ms. DeepSeek's original 27/33 retained five assertion defects and one extra click. Corrected repeats still failed invalid/omitted waits; invalid durations rejected before input. Later 9/9 browser tasks are separate and include recovered model errors.

Native monotonic scheduling reproduced an old 500-ms request releasing at ~17 ms. Published repair delivered ~502/5,002 ms, with early release on cancellation. Independent AppKit receipts and production-helper tests cover actual down/up/endpoints; Go rejects fractional/nonfinite/out-of-range values. Authorization, balanced cleanup and takeover remained unchanged.

Original native model 11/15 retained browser-field assertion defects and a parser defect; a tree task made four field errors before recovery. Corrected cases passed separately. Final v0.25.1 direct, Go/vet and Swift checks passed, but 4/5 model tasks retained TAKEOVER_REQUIRED before input. Validation repeats retained one extra release of unknown origin. Adding source markers yielded three later passes (~1,003 ms) without explaining that earlier release. Original failures remain and are not silently classified as model errors. Browser tests do not certify native timing or arbitrary applications.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Configuration and credential-file hashes remain unchanged. Production source

Git. The configured wire alias is verified, not the remote model weights.
These observations do not establish universal model success or certify arbitrary
applications. Linux uses deterministic native fixtures, not a real-model run.
The user explicitly excludes Redeven push and its push gate; local feature

concepts.title: Computer script read and validation boundaries

frontmatter.title: Computer script read and validation boundaries

concepts.summary: Reads return promised shapes or explicit failures, never fabricated empty observations. Typed preflight document/candidate invalidation with no preparation/input returns not_dispatched, seals invocation and adds no completed_actions. [Scripts](computer-use-scripts.md) owns namespace/failure barriers; every read retains privacy/permission/publication checks.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Validation and identity
Validate min/max arity before guest/image/download-cursor dispatch; extras fail SCRIPT_ARGUMENT_ERROR with method/documented_arity. Preserve types/options/empty/zero/null. Validate whole operation before focus/scroll/input; closed diagnostics exclude secrets/page errors. Keys accept characters/documented names/modifiers, not physical Equal. computer_wait defaults0/no settling; legacy waitFor keeps state.

Wait-only browser sequences need no page revision/virtual focus. Mixed sequences bind initial revision through waits/events, reject replacement input and release owned transitions. Delay is not invalidation; missing/malformed observation seals, never fabricates tree. Explicit invalidation-return follows Scripts contract.

Node/text/query/table/attribute/condition/lower faults retain semantic_read/source identity. Whole-page/image reads bind revision through publication; refs bind target/ancestors/main, not unrelated children. text samples innerText/URL/title/frame/document/ref together; combined reads fence same-document routes. Ordinary mutation is not document replacement; new-route/old-data remains source truth for model judgment.

Empty child URL requires exact isolated-frame document.URL with unchanged lifecycle/origin/privacy, never parent/blank allowlist. Bad URL fails without disconnect/malformed response; later explicit read may recover. Retired frames reject input and cannot be reinstalled by fenced inventory; unknown inventory remains unknown. Publication failure retires images, no quiescence/second ledger.

Entry/publication privacy scans are independent. Navigation checks control/destination without old-page reads; timers check control without content/editing. Neither publishes nor cancels takeover. Later reads/input retain privacy; confirmed input stays separate.

## Conditions and navigation
One deadline spans preparation/safety/sampling/cleanup/publication. Check privacy every sample without URL/title rereads. Return requested_state/timeout/elapsed/samples, never readiness. Timeout is data; requireState raises CONDITION_TIMEOUT/seals even caught, retaining prefix. Closed diagnostics retain method/state/time/zero-based operation indexes but no matching text/raw errors. Completed waits need not match.

Only typed document/candidate change discards affected sample under same deadline/privacy latch. Resample from exact lifecycle evidence, never global revision/error wording; retain frame/scope/event/protocol facts. Revalidate original unique query/fixed scope even for absence. Invalid samples are not absent/hidden. Ambiguity/stale ref/root, unknown evaluation/protocol, permission/cancel stop; ordinary reads/input never retry candidate faults.

navigate/back/reload accept commit|domcontentloaded|load and0..30000ms, defaults load/20000. Return command_acknowledged/navigation_stage/wait(state reached|timeout, wait_until, timeout_ms, elapsed_ms). Deadline starts before dispatch; root/loader includes pre-ack events, same-document/download. Timeout permits explicit reads/waits in same namespace; unknown/network acknowledgement, permission/cancel/target change stops. No replay/network-idle heuristic.

## Evaluation and delivery
One evaluate/callFunctionOn checker rejects exceptionDetails/invalid shapes, preserving promised false/zero/empty/null/void. Only confirmed same-document install marks preparation. Later explicit reads may reprepare, never replay effects. Observer readiness is not app readiness.

Evaluation facts retain phase/method/exception|invalid_result. DOMSnapshot validates used fields, allows protocol-empty and omits unavailable offsets. Typed transport invalidation keeps method, never invented codes; unknown stage=internal_error. Activity/results/logs exclude raw exception/stacks/page values; prior output survives except privacy. Help uses observed roles/refs.

Input methods return closed delivery/needs_observation/invalidation, not read/business success. Optional post_action_check unavailable neither revokes acknowledgement nor exposes unchecked content. Private input pauses; permission/cancel/connection/target/cleanup/uncertainty stops. Content-returning edits/legacy images keep publication checks. action_executed confirms completion; preparation_executed requires fresh read without completed click/scroll. Posted/observed counts are not business outcomes; unknown release/delivery/mutation exceptions cannot confirm completion. Closed actionability preserves failed_checks without relabeling prefix. Missing refs yield observation-unavailable/reference_not_retained, not invented change.

Hit facts include point/ancestry/embedding/scroll intersection, no text. Resolve CSS pseudo origin before ancestors/shadow checks; overlays reject without alternate point. Root/OOPIF checks validate known ancestors, not unrelated frames. Text uses Range rectangles, elements/documents native geometry; unsupported measurement fails. connected/rendered/visible/opacity_zero/enabled/editable/receives are distinct. Offscreen text may be visible; transparent rendered targets still need hit ownership. Hover needs no enabled, click does, fill needs editable. Return closed stage/state/bounds.

## Bounded reads
query(limit,cursor) returns loaded authorized AX attributes/count/loss/document/cursor,<=200items/48KiB. Content changes invalidate cursor; retain only returned refs. href keeps relative/query/fragment with credential redaction. Retired linkSummary fails predispatch with precise_attribute_read; explicit attributes preserve query/fragment. Long fields use source reads.

rows selects one table/grid excluding nested tables, retaining header/data/cell roles/refs. Per page<=200rows/48KiB, per row<=200cells/44KiB, cell<=2000Unicode. cells_truncated/text_truncated expose loss; incomplete rows prove no total. Cursor binds full cell content; count covers loaded matches. attribute:string|null and getAttribute:{attribute,value,redacted?} distinguish absent/empty. Nonempty DOM names<=2000chars; values>2000codepoints need source(). URL credentials remain private; native rejects browser-only methods before dispatch.

scroll_progress is return-only requested scope/measured_ref, not wheel receiver. Immediate before/after/offset_changed proves no scroll_effect; unknown=null. Separate preparation/input. Wheel uses clipped/transformed visible intersection/document viewport, checks ancestors/embedding overlays then sends once; not offscreen center/enabled check. Rejection retains preparation, no alternate/replay.

No automatic diff/advisor. read_options is explicitly target-level method_inventory, not per-node ability. root/limit/continuation retains source scope; node detail is not subtree, child_refs/children_truncated describes returned relations. Use snapshot/rows/query/count for collections.

sections.body: [Source reads](computer-source-reads.md) owns AX/DOM fields/chunks/children/cursors/ref retention under same privacy/publication boundary. Loaded collections prove no unseen data. Recovery cannot switch target, persist lifecycle or replay input.

concepts.summary:

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
locator.source() enumerates fields. Browser distinguishes AX and DOM; native
exposes AX attributes, actions and parameterized range reads. Long scalar values
return text/json chunks with Unicode-code-point offset/total, truncation and a
content-bound cursor. Child-reference collections return items/offset/total pages
(up to 200) from the existing ref owner. Changed source invalidates continuation;
empty, unavailable and unsupported values remain distinct. Source roles survive
the canonical guest projection. DOM reads explicitly include hidden/offscreen
facts and preserve URL query/fragment while removing credentials. Password/OTP
subtrees, including closed shadow roots, retain the privacy boundary. Source data
never grants iframe, filesystem, clipboard or application authority.

Browser AX child_refs retain ignored and DOM-less records as read-only refs in the existing owner; source reads validate AX/document identity without actionability. DOM-less records retain an ancestor privacy anchor and cannot authorize input. All declared child IDs must resolve or the read fails explicitly, never reports a false empty list.

Browser source/text/attribute/geometry/selection/node reads preserve page document_id and exact frame_id/frame_document_id provenance. Cross-frame query items carry their own frame provenance; table rows/cells share the table result provenance without repeating it per cell. These are facts, not readiness or automatic invalidation policy.

No separate source store is introduced. Ref retention is bounded; read returned
refs before requesting distant pages. Source changes, detached DOM nodes and
replaced windows reject stale refs. A missing source fact is never synthesized.

concepts.title: Managed browsers and authorized Chrome tabs

frontmatter.title: Managed browsers and authorized Chrome tabs

concepts.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns connection, authorization and control for managed Chromium, explicit CDP and Chrome extension through one restricted executor. Explicit Browser and desktop connection/tab creation selects the conversation target. Approval Required binds current target/URL; temporary URL authority never becomes saved origin permission.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
This is neither a model tool nor another opening path.

## Managed profiles
Both carriers use /_redeven_proxy/api/browser/installation. Default profiles lazily create their first page; later selected-page loss fails explicitly.

Under published FloeBrowser ownership, Go Runtime launches one sandboxed Chromium process group/profile; Node inventory/source adapters attach to loopback CDP. Retain Playwright isolation flags: basic profile-local credential storage/mock keychain, sandbox enabled. Never access personal keychains/request keychain permission. Passive inventory never launches Chrome. Explicit Start creates no page/target change and reuses its owner.

Explicit Stop confirms page closure with saved sign-ins/downloads retained. Gates reject Stop during action/task/private-control/viewer ownership. Retire authority before releasing gates; queued work cannot restart/replace the old page. Running/idle/stopped/failed state comes from Runtime, not profile metadata.

One maintenance worker probes once/minute; release requires ten minutes with zero actual pages, unfinished downloads and target owners. Retained pages are intentional resources. Passive reads do not reset idleness; failed probes prove nothing.

Shutdown cancels maintenance, closes owned groups independently of helper responsiveness, then escalates bounded graceful→terminate→kill. Remove receipts only after confirmed cleanup; retain/return failure, including disable/recovery. A profile kernel lock lasts for owner lifetime. Atomic receipts bind PID/birth, executable, profile and owner PID/birth. Next explicit start may reclaim a verified obsolete owner; ambiguous/live/invalid identities fail. Never scan/kill Chrome by executable name. Spawn-before-receipt and uncatchable-kill-without-restart cleanup are not guaranteed. Receipts prove cleanup identity, not authority/history/replay. Only isolated protocol fixtures may use helper launch; production stays Runtime-managed.

## Input and observation
Semantic clicks check visible/enabled/stable geometry and actual hit target, including parent overlays. Text targets require the fixed point inside the exact source text quad and the actual hit on its containing element, including Shadow DOM/frame coordinates; no parent action or alternate point is substituted. Preparation is not input completion: blocked clicks return action_executed:false and fresh-observation demand after viewport change. Bounded waits sample rendered CSS; labels use safe observed titles, never discovery as account identity.

Same-document capture may settle read-only for <=1s within budget; check before/after capture. Persistent motion returns capture/viewport_unstable without pixels. Cancellation/document change/privacy latch wins; never replay input. Frame inventory owns document identity: child navigation/removal revokes its subtree; root replacement/cancel/handback revokes all. Image/snapshot revisions stay page-wide; ref reads recheck document after DOM/AX.

Locator keys require focusable elements; AX roots use ui.key('PageDown'). Exact DOM.focus/document rejection yields ELEMENT_NOT_ACTIONABLE, focus/not_focusable, no key/connection retirement. Generic faults/lost focus/unknown acknowledgements or release stay uncertain without replay; retain safe stage/reason/fresh-read demand, warning and completed prefix.

Hit tests convert viewport CSS into owning CDP document coordinates, including scrolled frames, and check every cross-process embedding overlay. Unavailable protocol yields TARGET_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE/observation_stage:hit_test, never invented coverage. Capture includes non-overlay scrollbars and an immutable actual-dimension transform with before/after checks. Scoped scroll verifies its control-center hit target.

## Downloads
Capture browser.downloadCursor() before input; sequential waitForDownload({after:cursor}) or exact known ID follows. Bounded page-local memory excludes old files; multiple arrivals are ambiguous. No replay/latest-file inference/durable ledger. Published SourceDownload alone writes identity; raw CDP cannot duplicate it. Same names remain distinct; AMBIGUOUS_DOWNLOAD includes bounded exact candidates.

readDownload(id,{offset,limit}) returns bounded base64/continuation; sequential chunks share a short-lived stream retired on cancel/idle/disposal. saveDownload(id) copies <=256MiB into task scratch with run authorization/partial cleanup and per-chunk offset/count/identity/total validation. Guests cannot choose paths; terminal/file tools process the returned path and deliver finals.

## Chrome extension and CDP
MV3 uses Native Messaging/chrome.debugger for the exact tab. Bounded webNavigation creation facts identify popup source; tab-group opener metadata is not action provenance. Remote Linux uses remote managed browser/private desktop, never silent local Chrome.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Internal cancellation drains the operation before clearing its ephemeral flag; it never sets user_control or changes private mode/permission/Stop barriers. Drained reads permit authorized same-target reads; uncertain writes remain terminal. Invalidated captures without bytes/attachments retain observation_invalidated/needs_observation; inconsistent target/safety/frame payloads fail.

Recovery uses ordinary profile preparation; private input cannot own another default profile and passive sampling launches nothing. [Design evidence](computer-use-design-evidence.md) records public/installed-code comparisons; no forced reload/CSP rewriting. Pre-identity failure cannot bind guessed downloads. Generic unavailable events neither latch globally nor infer names/times; waits may time out until identity-bearing upstream failure exists.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## User contract
The shared Browser and desktop dialog opens Browser settings for this environment.

Users never choose a file   or follow an archive download link.

No agent installation tool, automatic re-enable, shell fallback or target substitution is introduced.

## Distribution and state
Standard Runtime release suites carry `computer.zip`: official Node, published Playwright, QuickJS, the published FloeBrowser SDK and its native media collector, and product helpers, with a closed SHA-256 file inventory.

Offline delivery retains this helper suite and does not include Chromium. Missing browser binaries remain an explicitly confirmed online installation; packaging optimization cannot initiate downloads or change browser selection. The media collector is selected for the suite target before the closed inventory is generated, preserving the upstream manifest as evidence and enforcing runtime digest checks. macOS signing derives the selected runtime digest only after verifying unchanged executable content; see [Desktop bundle contracts](../desktop/desktop-development-bundles.md).

The Runtime never accepts a client-supplied URL, executable path or checksum.

No installation automatically restarts following a Runtime restart.

sections.title: Boundaries

The existing installation snapshot reports package state separately from `launch` state, structured reason and applicable action. A bounded native `--version` probe recognizes missing shared libraries without opening a page; unknown failures retain their own category.

## Explicit preparation
The shared installation controller starts `prepare_system` only after user action. The normal enabled switch, operation ID, progress subscription, cancellation and one-shot open continuation remain authoritative.

Runtime independently checks the installed version and policy before accepting the ready phase.

Connection observation remains bounded to the open guide; pressing Connect or copying the manual connection link starts a fresh observation window after installation, timeout or a failed check.

concepts.title: Semantic desktop operations and explicit control

frontmatter.title: Semantic desktop operations and explicit control

concepts.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns desktop execution: explicit macOS app window or private Linux Xvfb/D-Bus. Application discovery reuses HostApplicationCatalog; exact candidate selection uses NSWorkspace with current app/foreground permission. Launch completion is synchronized, cancellation stops further actions, and window readiness is bounded.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## macOS windows
The Swift helper inventories regular and accessory application windows, reads AX roles, labels, non-sensitive values, supported actions and bounds, and exposes bounded subtree queries.

Minimized windows are restored once and allowed to settle; zero/multiple windows
return explicit selection facts. No path-supplied shell launcher or independent
application lifecycle is exposed to guest scripts.

Secret fields enter the existing private takeover channel rather than model observations.

Snapshots declare source macos_accessibility and application_provided coverage.
truncated:false means the available tree was not cut, not that all visible content
is present. Use screenshots and targeted scrolling when application AX content
is sparse. No global accessibility opt-in attribute is forced.

## Explicit interaction and effects
The published floe-native-apps v0.26.0 owns pointer events, timed sequences,
window/PID routing and pasteboard primitives. Redeven owns target/process checks,
authorization, cancellation, source serialization and result facts. Directed input
requires a live window route; missing optional WindowServer support fails without
foreground substitution. Receipts count delivered events, not application effects.
Cancellation releases only task-owned transitions at the last posted position.
AX actions retain existing foreground consent because applications may activate.

The script facade exposes hover, left/right/middle and modified clicks, holds,
selection read/text/ranges/all/replacement, discovered AX actions, values and
bounded input sequences. UTF-16 selections reject split surrogates. Browser
counterparts use CDP input, DOM selection or explicitly identified synthetic
control events. Preflight rejects unsupported controls before mutation.

Native key/press and copy/cut/paste select the existing consented foreground route before dispatch: AppKit may receive a background chord without executing its menu action. No automatic foreground retry follows directed input. AX selection ranges have no direction contract; non-none directions fail before mutation. Explicit input preserves modifiers and repeat, and cancellation releases only posted task-owned keys/buttons.

Copy/cut preserve their actual editing semantics; paste is independent of fill.
System clipboard read/write/paste requires Full access plus platform permission.
Typed bytes and formats are explicit. Supplied paste leaves the clipboard when
consumption is unverified; it never restores over a concurrent user copy. Browser
setFiles uses supplied bytes only (16 files, 256 KiB encoded), never arbitrary host
paths. Existing target discovery/selection, downloads and native file dialogs
retain their authorization boundaries. Capabilities describe support conditions;
unsupported application controls fail explicitly.

## Linux private desktop
The Xvfb owner starts a private session D-Bus and AT-SPI bus. The executor rejects socket or environment paths leading outside that private desktop; it never discovers or attaches to another logged-in user's session.

Environment inspection is read-only and reports all missing configured executables and their actual paths. The setup question and Linux diagnostics offer **Ask Flower to install**. A click starts a separate conversation through the current Runtime adapter with the selected model, permission mode and working directory. Flower rechecks the observed host, installs or repairs components through existing general-purpose terminal tools, and verifies X11, private D-Bus, AT-SPI and screenshot readiness. Custom paths require confirmation before changes. No automatic package-manager command is executed by the UI, and captured suggested commands are excluded from the repair prompt. Host observations are bounded JSON explicitly identified as untrusted data.

The repair uses existing approval controls, never requests passwords in chat or tool calls, and reports a blocker if private system authorization is unavailable. Admission is not installation success. The original conversation, draft, references and pending input remain intact; the repair carries a readable thread reference back to the original task. Durable outbox recovery retries the same request identity after an uncertain send. Accepting a repair never binds unrelated drafts, and a delayed receipt does not redirect a user who changed conversations. Interrupted package operations require inspection before another attempt; no failed Computer Use action is replayed.

An explicit RWX-authorized verification serializes with target control, refuses an occupied desktop, and checks X11, private D-Bus, AT-SPI and screenshot capture without changing the conversation target or sending input. Passive refresh never starts the desktop. Previously failed target snapshots become selectable after a fresh successful resource check; selection still performs its normal readiness handshake.

A failed private-desktop readiness check reports that input was not dispatched. Only exact, current canonical evidence in an agent-authored question exposes the setup entry; verification leaves that question unanswered and never replays the failed action. Linux application discovery is not implied by private desktop availability.

Product target preferences and canonical historical results follow their existing owners.

concepts.title: Browser and desktop settings
concepts.summary: Both carriers share Browser and desktop settings. Runtime capabilities, thread grants and extension consent are independent. The browser page presents connected profiles with their actual Chrome/Chromium marks, inline connection status, and a shared connect/refresh action row.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Overview and navigation
The overview identifies the actual Runtime hostname and platform, followed by one grouped settings list for the built-in browser, browser connections, and desktop/applications. Each entire row is a keyboard-accessible navigation control with aligned plain status text and a chevron. Narrow layouts place status beneath the description without shrinking the hit area. Built-in browser settings consistently use the Chromium mark. Conversation target status, manual page/app selection and its advanced endpoint discovery route are absent. Overview and browser refresh read only the environment; candidates load only for application grants in access settings. Opening or enabling never downloads.

Refresh retains the previous observed profiles until the response arrives. Disconnected states expose the connection action, while genuine diagnostics remain visible. Pairing details and permissions explanations use secondary disclosure. Both carriers bundle unchanged, hash-pinned theSVG browser and operating-system marks; unknown identities remain generic. Layout uses published Floe surfaces and tokens, reflows at narrow widths, and reserves asynchronous action geometry.

Extension installation presents two compact action rows: open the real browser Extensions page, then reveal the prepared folder in the host file manager. Instructions explicitly place Developer mode and folder dragging in the browser. Settings must not render simulated drop targets, browser switches or draggable folders; decorative brand marks imply no interaction. Paths, alternate installation and longer explanations stay in Help. Opening a page or folder is not installation evidence; only the existing browser handshake can confirm a connection.

Both carriers provide complete explicit localized copy.

## Runtime observation and recovery
`GET computer/environment` returns hostname, platform, managed-browser capability, desktop capability, and the existing live Chrome status snapshot. Capability is an observation, not an authorization or a guarantee that subsequent startup cannot fail.

Published Floe components already supply the required UI primitives, so this change is product integration rather than an upstream platform extension.

Missing Linux desktop components have an explicit **Ask Flower to install** action in diagnostics and the canonical setup question. It creates a separate same-Runtime conversation using the normal durable send contract, with a reference back to the original task. Opening diagnostics, passive refresh and desktop verification never submit the original input or retry its failed action. Repair admission, installation and verification are distinct facts; the executable repair contract is owned by [Linux private desktop](computer-use-desktop.md#linux-private-desktop).

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
The global Settings category embeds the existing browser controller. Contextual links retain exact thread/environment identity; unavailable targets never substitute another Runtime. Browser installation transfers capture admitted environment/incarnation transport independently of panel lifetime; reopening observes the same operation. Chrome guide steps survive category changes without preparing twice.

Inspection never selects a page, grants authority, starts a task or installs components. A lost selection stays unavailable until it is recovered or explicitly replaced; the settings dialog does not own Floret lifecycle.

concepts.summary:
Redeven owns authorized screenshots; Floret owns history/preparation. Durable frames and ephemeral samples have separate
lifetimes; tool success does not prove delivery. Each controller holds one model anchor. Viewer sampling cannot replace it. Changed target, document, viewport, bounds or observed native accessibility state rejects stale input.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
- Missing, changed or unauthorized bytes fail explicitly. No unrestricted URL fallback.
- [Image reads](image-read-and-retention.md) share immutable Computer storage;
  computer:// identities and retention stay intact.
- Safe results include target, location, summary and safety. Semantic/script
  operations include images only when requested.
- All authorized model images use published Floret PrepareModelImage: JPEG quality
  85 and a 2560-pixel longest side, without upscaling. Uploads, image_read/crops,
  browser/native screenshots, MCP images, summaries and historical replay share
  this policy. Alpha remains PNG; EXIF orientation is applied and ICC retained.
  An animation stays byte-identical when it fits; oversized animation fails
  explicitly without flattening frames. An unchanged smaller original may be kept.
- Canonical original bytes, hashes, locators and visible history never change.
  Model notices report source/model dimensions and bytes; fine text can be read
  through an original-backed crop. Preparation never fetches arbitrary URLs.
- Preparation precedes estimation/freezing. Transport retries reuse exact bytes;
  Desktop RPC carries validated derived metadata to prevent lossy recompression.
  Encoding revisions invalidate provider state. No durable derivative cache exists.
- Flower caps JSON/base64 at 32 MiB independently of tokens: product policy,
  not a provider limit. Remote DTOs share the cap; services own final rendering.
- Media dimension/count/byte failures retain typed actual/limit/stage through
  Desktop RPC and canonical failure projection. Published Floret v7.94.0 recovers
  aggregate count/total-byte failures through safe historical compaction even
  with low token usage. Individual invalid/dimension failures remain terminal;
  neither class aliases token overflow. UI provides numeric
  diagnostics and input/model guidance without unchanged Retry or secret payloads.

## Screenshot coordinates
A model screenshot returns frame_geometry with its computer:// identity, original
image dimensions and model_image dimensions. Browser geometry also carries CSS
visual viewport scale/offset. Screenshot handles use model_pixels plus frame and
document_id; explicit browser image_pixels retains original pixel semantics.
Default browser CSS and native window coordinates keep their existing units.
Native window screenshots support model_pixels with a transient window anchor.
Full-page/cropped arbitrary images do not establish an input mapping.

Input and takeover invalidate the anchor. Known-change
checks cannot eliminate arbitrary dynamic layout races; semantic locators remain
preferable for moving controls. The final attachment supplies after_frame when
several screenshots were taken.

concepts.summary: Runtime owns observer-bound private pixels/input; Floret takeover/continuation. Bind observer/revision/thread/run/target; disconnect revokes and uncertainty never replays. Canonical answer starts a fresh Run/observation; private input also waits for matching decoded pixels.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Browser observation and private input
The shared browser controller enforces visible password fields, structured
one-time-code input semantics, secret-change latches and explicit permissions in
each frame, including shadow roots. Native adapters enforce platform secure-field
roles. They do not classify ordinary labels or page prose as CAPTCHA, OTP or
instruction attacks. Observed content is untrusted data, never authorization.
The model decides task meaning and whether human help is needed; it never receives
confirmed protected values or pixels for classification. Unmarked secrets are not
guaranteed detectable by accessibility; native apps must expose secure fields and
users retain explicit takeover control. Script navigation receipts require target control and destination grants, not old-page privacy sampling: they return only command/lifecycle facts, never page content. Pure timers also publish no content and send no input. Existing Runtime takeover/permission barriers remain authoritative; ordinary input and all explicit content reads retain full privacy checks. An unreadable frame stops the observation
without inventing a human requirement. Unknown read failures are not retried;
only measured viewport instability has a one-second same-target resampling window
inside the invocation budget. Explicit condition waits own their original deadline
through final publication and resample only typed identity invalidation. Failed
wait samples retain elapsed time and sample count without claiming a condition result.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Evidence/isolation
Retain canonical results, fixture events/frames/hashes, cleanup and initial model/assertion/product failures; never repeat until green. Native/provider/foreground acceptance stays outside ordinary/exact-main gates. Real Service/UI checks one counted effect with encoding loss/invalid optional result. Both adapters retain pre-input cancel/revoke and terminal unknown acknowledgement.

## DeepSeek
TestComputerReliabilityDeepSeek uses production Service/published Floret, configured deepseek-flash and catalog Chromium. REDEVEN_COMPUTER_RELIABILITY_E2E=1 requires absolute CONFIG_ROOT/EVIDENCE_DIR and BROWSER_TEST_INSTALLATION under REDEVEN_COMPUTER_/REDEVEN_ prefixes. Run GOWORK=off go test ./internal/ai -run '^TestComputerReliabilityDeepSeek$' -count=1 -v -timeout=22m. Repeat1..5/default1; browser-only may parallel3. Native E2E is serialized and requires absolute REDEVEN_COMPUTER_NATIVE_TEST_HOST selecting staged relay beside signed Desktop Access. Build published Swift and stage_desktop_access.mjs with stable identity; grant that app explicitly. Bare build has no permission; protocol-only stages disposable signed app without grants. Preserve config/secrets/thread hashes.

Read canonical ERROR/host envelopes through ThreadToolResultReader; script failures need data.script_error, predispatch rejection stays distinct. Prose/logs are not execution and completed waits survive later faults. Independent cases require:
- Capture/refs:four PageDown+screenshot, parent ref survives child navigation; options/waits retain exact field/index/safe condition.
- Stale/image:STALE_REFERENCE and zero pointer, then image before one pointer; variable visuals/forms/tables require prior image/exact values/totals.
- Batch:three reads/two transitions in one script/image/independent totals. Download:one export/save identity/exact bytes/project file, no anonymous reacquisition.

Target selection chooses where work runs; it is not another confirmation of an already authorized action.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Authority and lifetime
Healthy JavaScript namespace belongs to thread/turn/target; context_reset preserves selected target. Unrestricted discovery/select/exec and explicit/saved/read-only primitives retain discovery. Retry uses source-Turn names/current grants/canonical preparation/requery. BatchExclusiveGroup rejects conflicting prepared targets before input and across batches; unrelated/inventory tools may coexist. No alias/rebind/replay.

Require selected target, code, readable description; omitted target uses saved binding, candidate_ref is not target ID. Limits30s/50operations/eight namespaces. ui.budget/final report remainder; operation51 stops before execution with SCRIPT_OPERATION_LIMIT, budget_exhausted=operations/context_reset and retained effects. Await/loops/same-target navigation compose; visual judgment returns to model. No timers; const/let call-local, globalThis healthy namespace only. SCRIPT_NO_PROGRESS means no supported pending work, STALE_REFERENCE invalid observed identity; neither permits replay/retarget. Unique lookup missing/ambiguous fails; query/count0/wait timeout are data.

Host-call failure seals even if caught, retires namespace/promises and retains effects. Parse-only failure retains healthy namespace; post-start SyntaxError/fault retires jobs. Diagnostics distinguish parse/execution/host_operation with closed phase/method/field/expected/example/source position; raw interpreter text stays private, only known unsupported option names echo. Help owns object-qualified signatures, snapshot/observe invalidation union, observed roles/return shapes/loaded totals/unavailable globals, not business advice. Detailed topics remain on demand. CDP preserves method/signed code. Only source-owner predispatch rejection proves action_executed:false; helper_exchange retains typed unavailable/invalid/rejected uncertainty, and only exact validated request/target proves no effect.

Cancellation/deadline remains typed through interpreter retirement/closed pipes, retaining stop_reason and confirmed prefix separately from uncertainty. Failed guest-reply delivery cannot relabel completed effects. No helper acknowledgement/replay is needed to settle cancellation. [Read contract](computer-script-read-contract.md) owns arity, conditions, privacy, delivery/actionability and bounded source shapes.

## Explicit invalidation/output
Readonly snapshot/observe/screenshot/locators, including snapshot pre-resolution, accept on_invalidated:'return'. Only typed no-effect document change returns invalidated/document_changed/observation_stage/needs_observation with no content/preparation/input/takeover/cancel/revoked authority. Default throws; budget consumed, no completed_actions. Model chooses another read; never auto-retry/reset candidate/unknown/uncertain outcomes.

Invocation-local read_outcomes retains <=50 operation indexes/actions/statuses/bounded document/typed invalidation, even emit:false, not locals/content/recovery choices. Successful reads retain total/returned_count/truncated through later faults. Snapshot adds source_truncated, loaded_accessibility_tree scope and root_ref/limit before guest filtering; no hidden-node/loading inference. Privacy pause discards content. completed_reads identifies successful kinds/scopes independently of image/observation authority. Activity retains zero-based failure/reset. Confirmed input followed by typed missing/ambiguous/unsupported read shows action performed/content unreadable with actual computer_failed_read kind; unknown effects, guest/input failures never become neutral interruptions.

Bounds: snapshot256KiB, helper512KiB, final1MiB, logs64KiB UTF8, explicit observation prefix384KiB. Logs and automatic observations have independent budgets. log encodes the argument array; emit:false does not reduce log cost. Reject oversized log without emission; SCRIPT_OUTPUT_LIMIT stops/resets while retaining earlier output/reads/output_limit, never implying read failure/replay. Publish logs before subsequent operations. Failed read discards its own content/pixels and seals calls/logs; privacy removes invocation content.

Runtime help distinguishes outer/data.truncated delivery loss from read_outcomes/source_truncated source-page loss independent of filtering. Full delivery may contain truncated source; no flag proves readiness. Prefix retains trees/index/target; output_order indexes logs/observations/images. current_observation_index replaces exact duplicates only. output_limit reports stage/delivered counts/remaining bytes; ui.budget includes JSON within65536. Only snapshot/observe/locator.snapshot accept emit; false retains shape/identity/budget. Screenshot/help always emit, log collections without duplicate snapshots. Old images grant no coordinates.

Automatic tree_text is self-contained parent-first DFS/sibling order, no baseline/duplicates.32KiB includes escaping/metadata, title/URL4KiB encoded each with loss flags/exact document. Legacy observe/full:true/node remains structured. JSON-quoted refs/roles/names/key=JSON resist quote/newline/bidi forgery; indentation encodes ancestry, parent_ref for sparse/depth>8, frame inheritance only full tree and explicit frame_absent. Preserve false/mixed/empty/loss. source_truncated=collection loss, output_truncated=render loss, truncated=either. Full/node fields<=2000codepoints; linear encoded accounting reserves omissions. Floret owns tokens; released adapters own collection/input, no automatic diff/advice.

## Delivery and reads
Typed preflight invalidation before mutation reports not_dispatched/action_executed:false with no completed_actions. Confirmed delivery may require fresh observation; actionability exposes measured failed_checks/quads/stability/preparation/time without choosing recovery. Explicit clipboard APIs own shortcuts; key/press rejects implicit clipboard. Ref query is unique; subtree uses root_ref/snapshot. Image dimensions/original_image_pixels require exact membership; crop grants no input.

Use trees for controls, text for prose/code, collections for loaded data and images for visuals; retain headings/units/period/scope/keys. Counts/cursors prove no unseen dataset; successful reads may reveal app errors. Denied/unvisited remains unknown, no business-success inference.

Browser input uses exactly first-quad center or supplied point, never alternate search. Defaults scroll_into_view:false, stability_timeout_ms:0 (0..5000). type inserts, fill replaces. Native window scroll, scrollAt(no click), selector scroll and doubleClick remain distinct. Browser-only waits accept text|value, equals:string and timeout, sampling visible textContent/value; completed waits survive guest faults.

Drag integer duration_ms0..5000 follows straight held path, zero no delay. Monotonic origin prevents accumulated waits, not transport cost. Cancel/takeover/document change releases at last confirmed point; NativeInputSequence begins after down acknowledgement with current authority/receipts. Unknown replies never replay; independent AppKit measures timing.

[Semantics](computer-use-semantics.md) owns roles/identity. getByRole(role,{name?,exact?,root_ref?}) coexists with legacy reads. Unique locator.text uses isolated HTML innerText,<=12000Unicode with element/browser_dom/innerText/truncation, no visibility filter. Document/text/SVG returns TARGET_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, never body/parent fallback. Unsupported methods give factual capability diagnostics, no prescribed recovery or completeness/readiness promise.

Immutable image handles bind frame/document/image despite metadata edits; global image survives only healthy namespace. Downloads expose exported ID/immutable wait cursor without reacquisition. Screenshots attach directly, no path/export. Safe current snapshot(including emit:false)/screenshot clears needs_observation; input/stale/read failure/uncertainty sets it. Current evidence, never title, owns observation_status; private takeover excludes pixels/content.

concepts.summary: ComputerUseRuntime normalizes browser, macOS AX and Linux AT-SPI facts into bounded schema v2. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Snapshot and node identity
Observations include `semantic_schema_version: 2`, `document_id`, `roots`, `nodes`, `truncated`, optional `focus_ref`, `total` and `execution_mode`.

References still require document revision and fresh DOM/AX identity validation.

`children_truncated` marks exported nodes with omitted descendants, including Runtime byte pruning. It is not evidence of empty rows or virtualization. Agents can read a row or table subtree through `root_ref`; completeness claims require checking the returned truncation facts.

Single-node reads use the same bounded observation path on browser, macOS and
Linux. child_refs only links returned nodes; an omitted child is not an empty
subtree. Native child-list read failures stop observation rather than becoming
empty arrays.

Name, description and string value have a 2,000 Unicode code-point budget.
name_truncated, description_truncated and value_truncated are true only when
the adapter omitted part of that field; snapshot truncated continues to describe
omitted nodes. Runtime validates these flags and preserves them in compact,
detailed and single-node output; model-facing selection, snapshot and node use canonical role while preserving platform_role. A detailed read does not remove field limits.
Browser query items also carry name_truncated when needed.

References compare the full native name through a bounded SHA-256 digest, never
the displayed prefix. Changed names receive different tokens so a fresh observation
cannot rebind an old reference. Browser collection cursors include complete-name digests
for every match, including items outside the current page. The existing reference
table and cursor owner remain authoritative; no additional lifecycle or replay
state exists. A failed or malformed DOM/AX identity read is observation-unavailable,
not proof of a stale reference. Preserve the observed token and sanitized protocol
method/code, reject input before dispatch, and require successful validation on a
later explicit call. Only confirmed identity changes invalidate the token. Semantic selectors match full names, including on native adapters.

Both directions of every parent/child edge must agree. An observation describes the bounded returned tree, not an exhaustive view of every application node.

Browser document_id describes the page sample revision across reads. Each source-backed node/query item exposes frame_id and frame_document_id for its actual frame lifetime. A table result carries that provenance once at its root; its rows and cells belong to the same frame. An unrelated iframe replacement may advance document_id without changing a main-frame ref or frame_document_id. Ref validation remains owned by the existing frame/document records. Text-tree frame_document_id inherits like frame_id; frame_document_absent explicitly clears inheritance.

## Roles, states and relationships
One Runtime alias inventory owns normalization and canonical selector expansion.
Standard landmarks including navigation, main, banner, contentinfo and
complementary, plus supported structural/live-region roles, round-trip through
this inventory. Unknown `other` remains reference-only, never a wildcard. Invalid
canonical selectors return safe field/expected/recovery diagnostics before dispatch.
Browser references are opaque bounded hashes of controller, document revision,
frame, native node identity, role and complete-name digest. The existing reference table remains their sole
owner; no second alias registry exists. At most 2,000 records remain in access order; successful resolution and returned source refs refresh retention. Retired document records stay bounded in that same table so known replacement still rejects as stale. A missing record means reference_not_retained, not proof that a node changed. It never triggers automatic resolution or replay.

Browser nodes report actions_scope:declared_only instead of guessing click/fill
support from roles or focusability. The listed actions are not an input allowlist;
target capabilities expose generic inputs and dispatch validates current
actionability. Native source-declared actions retain their platform meaning.

An ignored or truncated target has no invented reference; a platform-computed name or safe description may still be available.

## Reading order
Browser snapshot/query enumeration and Runtime normalization preserve preorder depth-first source AX child order through ignored ancestors within each authorized frame; this is not a visual or cross-frame interleaving order. They preserve root/sibling order, including guest/full/model output. Parents precede children, preserving valid bounded prefixes and omission flags. Structure never joins independently filtered fields into invented records; use source relationships and explicit object keys.

Adapters retain the existing sensitive-field, CAPTCHA, origin/application and revision checks before exposing content. Runtime additionally rejects secure AX subroles and password-text nodes, constrains types and sizes, and strips unknown metadata.

Confirmed actions survive an observation failure; failed content never enters model history and input is not replayed.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Discovery and selection
`computer_list_targets` lists browser profiles/pages and application windows without a preselected target. Explicit system/personal-browser tasks use `system`, which excludes managed and native window candidates and never starts a managed profile.

Discovery never launches. Selecting an application
candidate opens/restores that exact catalog entry; one accessible window is
selected, while zero or multiple windows return launch facts and window candidates. App and foreground grants, current target ownership and private pause boundaries
are checked before launch. Launch uncertainty never authorizes automatic replay.

A changed title/URL requires fresh discovery rather than a silent substitute.

## Default work and explicit switching
For `current`, the Runtime reads the thread's `computer_target_id`. An existing selection must still resolve to that exact resource.

Environment settings never bind or replace the current target. Their access controls manage grants independently of Flower's target selection.

## Persistence and fork
The migrated product store remains the only selection store. The binding belongs
to the thread, persists across turns and restart, and is not copied to a fork.
Script context_reset clears the thread/turn/target JavaScript namespace without
clearing this binding or granting readiness.

A lost task page fails until an authorized candidate is selected. Deleting product settings removes the selection and grants; a later bind never recreates a deleted thread.

## Binding contract and observation identity
Selection returns version 3 with exact backend availability and the shared core
script guide and one bounded initial observation through the normal runtime gate.
Observation failure retains selected:true and needs_observation; private pauses
retain selection without leaking content. Confirmed app opening remains
action_executed:true. Confirmed new-tab creation remains action_executed:true
even if a later selection step fails, with created_target:{target_id,target_kind}
from the confirming extension, managed or CDP owner. This opaque identity does
not imply selected/observed state or grant authority; it exposes no endpoint.
No tab is recreated or closed automatically. An unconfirmed creation is reported as an
unknown effect, never as an unexecuted action. Startup error types survive the
model-facing result. ui.help discloses read, visual and download details on demand.
The earlier verbose capability fields are superseded by this model-facing guide;
there are no product consumers of those fields. It is not a new registry or authorization source. Native adapters reject
browser-only query, attribute and image-coordinate operations before dispatch.

discovery_name is the discovery label. target_name comes from this call's
observed title, or the stable target ID if no title was observed;
observation_status distinguishes current observation from no new observation.
A failed or zero-operation script must not present an old about:blank label as a
current page. Flower activity shows localized validation/preparation/confirmed or
unknown-effect guidance from returned facts. These facts do not create retry authority.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Task access contains exact allowed origins, application identities and temporary foreground permission. The script cannot submit its own grant fields.

Persisted preference or grants alone cannot prove readiness, foreground safety or platform qualification.

Flower routes the DeepSeek provider to the published Floret v7.66.1 Responses gateway. Floret owns `/responses` rendering, SSE parsing, reasoning, usage normalization,

The route never sends `messages`, `enable_search`, `previous_response_id`, `store`, or `include`.

## Model-specific image input
DeepSeek Vision is enabled by the selected model's `input_modalities`, just like vision models on other providers. Text-only models receive image attachment manifests for model-directed processing; native image content is rendered only when supported.

[Goals](flower-goals.md) use the optional public controller; ordinary executable items retain strict identity.

## Observation
Floret supplies ThreadFactsSource, ThreadWindowSource and canonical body readers. v7.87.4 includes bounded text, lazy fields, startup reuse and single-mutation title summaries from <=16 KiB canonical prefix, without detail/index writes. Blank-module adoption verifies released historical continuation/restart. Floret alone owns cadence, versions, buffers, Activity reduction and reads.

Recheck endpoint/user/namespace each read. Client locators grant no authority. Only Floret synthesizes historical zero-byte Activity defaults on explicit expansion.

Published Floret v7.106.2 retires old-interest resident and deferred detail
consistently, preserving ordered semantic components and accepted explicit
baselines. The adapter consumes this owner contract without compensating diffs,
extra subscriptions, canonical reads or observer persistence.

Workspace facts preserve equal sidebar cache identity. Each observer has two cancellable slots: conversation and child. Off-window Computer assistance uses server-only canonical evidence, excluded from bounded response. [Live delivery](../ui/flower-live-timeline.md) and [qualification](../operations/flower-live-queue-performance.md#navigation-acceptance) own details. No schema/migration change.

## Model result and UI
[Final encoder](../../internal/ai/tool_result_encoding.go) applies execution facts/content policy/JSON, then Text plus independent Decoder.UseNumber structured snapshot. Activity separately projects valid source; truncation cannot alter model content. Floret's uncertain-effect warning sits outside payload budget, preserving complete diagnostics through provider/restart/retry.

Optional encoding loss emits factual error and continues provider loop, never soliciting human confirmation merely for possible mutation. Preserve result_unavailable/result_error_code separately from original owner error, invocation ID, completed_actions, needs_observation and target, including confirmed prefix/uncertain remainder. Malformed metadata cannot replace classification. Empty prefix proves no absence of effects; invocation completion is not task success. Model chooses authorized observation/work; never replay tools. Actual interactions/cancellation/dispatch/uncertainty retain authority; failure to encode safe result is infrastructure failure. Persisted questions keep canonical answer/cancel after restart, without host migration/auto-answer.

Published Floret v7.108.2 owns the model-visible `user_ask` schema and field guidance. Flower
capability definitions consume `runtime.CoreControlDefinitions()` with the selected
public built-in names;
there is no alternate product schema or model-only `open_subagent` choice field.
Guidance for input modes, evidence and Goal operations belongs upstream. Final
HTTP request tests cover control guidance, interaction continuation and provider
adapters; local definition tests alone cannot prove what the model receives.

The compact model contract omits `reason_code`, `required_from_user`,
`choices_exhaustive` and constant choice `kind`. Evidence references remain
required (an empty array is valid); Computer assistance resolves an actual
same-Turn tool call and target, never a guessed latest failure. Stable question
and choice IDs, secret input, custom answers and display hints remain available.
Released v7 arguments, frozen definitions and pending presentations remain owned
and validated by Floret; absent metadata stays absent, without host defaults or
history rewrites. The browser derives its own choice-rendering discriminator.

Final HTTP definition budgets cover OpenAI strict and DeepSeek non-strict forms
across six capability surfaces. Published-runtime fixtures, structured-input and
browser regressions cover compact presentation, selected/custom answers, draft
continuity and secret input. Computer takeover tests cover restart and return
without replaying the blocked action.

request_key remains send idempotency for transient browser outbox, not invocation identity. user_ask supports write and select_or_write; fixed choices always include custom text even without write_label. Floret normalizes historical select; ordinary InputRequired is separate. No product compatibility path.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Typed runtime
Optional ThreadGoalController and WithAgentGoals provide [canonical Goals](flower-goals.md).

Redeven-specific authorization, DTO mapping, live projection, and adapter ownership are specified in [Floret Redeven adapter and projection](floret-redeven-adapter-and-projection.md).

## Automatic display preparation

Redeven publishes service readiness without a global display-preparation sweep and observes public per-thread readiness; it never scans or migrates Floret-owned records. Prepared restarts reuse canonical readiness anchors. Hidden Activity field indexes are prepared only on explicit detail reads. New threads and independently ready conversations remain available while other
threads prepare; a failed preparation is reported without rewriting history.

## Identical consecutive tool calls

Published Floret v7.98.0 owns one sequence of individual calls, including
provider-hosted tools. Only the same tool and all identical arguments count;
descriptions remain significant. JSON object order and formatting are normalized
without losing numeric precision, string contents, array order or value types.
A different call or hosted invocation resets the sequence. Alternating batches
are not consecutive identical calls. Call IDs, streaming fragments and transport
retries add no calls. Completed bounded waits and changed polling tokens retain
their upstream exemptions; Redeven does not exclude description fields.

At the configured limit, Floret rejects before authorization/execution and
persists a paired, explicit non-execution result. The model receives one decision
to adjust or summarize; continuing unchanged stops the turn. Admitted child
events reset the sequence at the next request boundary. Confirmed sibling
results and completed reports survive failure, restart and explicit Retry.
No product polling heuristic, automatic replay or child restart is added.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Format/ownership
Redeven owns distribution/admission/state/credentials/UI; Floret dispatch/approval/effects/history/recovery; official MCP Go SDK wire/sessions. No copied dependencies or second lifecycle.

Immediate skills/<name>/SKILL.md children define Skills; mcp.json uses canonical matching schema. Isolate invalid entries; malformed MCP disables component type. stdio/Streamable HTTP supported; legacy SSE diagnosed/skipped. No hooks/commands/postinstall/private format interpretation.

stdio executable token or ./ package path,never shell expression. Expand PLUGIN_ROOT snapshot/PLUGIN_DATA persistent path once in args/env/cwd; keep cwd contained,no ambient secrets. HTTP headers literal,generated auth/protocol wins,no redirects.

## Distribution
Admins select readable local dirs,public GitHub repo/ref/path or explicit HTTPS catalogs. Freeze refs to commit receipts before bounded download; local dirs snapshot. Product catalog schema flower.agent_plugin_catalog.v1 has id/plugins{id,source{type:github,repository,ref,path}},outside Agent Plugins standard.

Catalog only recommends GitHub; no local install/enable/credentials/execution/default market/address/auto-search. [Catalogs](flower-plugin-catalogs.md) owns opt-in metadata. ASCII HTTPS/valid ports only; reject private DNS targets,unsafe redirects,archive links/duplicates,Windows drive/stream paths. Count entries before extraction,max32 separators,pinned os.Root writes. Materialize contained local symlinks,reject escapes. Limits4096 entries,16MiB/file,128MiB package/archive,1MiB manifest/catalog.

## Review/state/recovery
Prepare<=four workers/two minutes each,no commands. Review source/components/entrypoints/changes before commit. New installs disabled; new update components explicit. MCP config change clears matching credentials; every update clears discovery.

<stateDir>/ai/agent-plugins/:registry.sqlite kind flower_agent_plugins/schema1,read-only preflight/atomic revision-CAS; packages/<sha256> snapshot; staging/<operation UUID>; data/<installation UUID> retained. Digest binds paths/bits/bytes. Future/unknown/drifted stores fail untouched. One registry owns install/component/discovery.

Scope by namespace/endpoint/user; request ID+reviewed digest binds commit,changed-selection replay fails. Ready expires30min but resumes across disconnect; restart fails interrupted prep. Shutdown drains/cancels; cleanup only unreferenced packages/stages,never retained data. Conversation backup/restore omits extensions/config/data/credentials and creates no second manager.

SecretsStore schema4 stores immutable write-only refs,never listed/audited values. Replace/clear invalidates discovery; empty object clears,omission preserves. Uninstall retains data unless explicit permanent delete validates UUID/pinned root; reject escaping replacement. Snapshot stat/read/link uses rooted handles.

Explicit GitHub auto-check preference defaults enabled,<=once/6h,availability only. Apply repeats preparation/review; checks never download/apply/enable/execute.

## Projection/authority
Use existing Skills/MCP managers,not copies. Skills bind plugin name/install UUID/name; MCP install/digest/component/revision/credential/schema. Reject namespaced standalone writes. Readers inspect; authenticated admins manage; stdio additionally write+execute.

Every skill read/MCP call resolves authority and leases resource. Digest mismatch rejects; update/uninstall cannot retire leased install,disable blocks new dispatch immediately. Recheck MCP config after connect/before dispatch. Floret owns in-flight/unknown-effect semantics,no replay. Explicit checks discover tools without bypassing conversation permissions.
