sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Typed details exclude raw/status/name-only affordances. Validate media MIME/size/digest without storing bytes in tool state. Typed decoders validate conditional inputs before resource resolution/authorization. Published Floret owns bounded correction and paired feedback; reuse [child validation](subagent-runtime.md). Projector failures stay contract failures; business/permission/storage errors never imply safe replay.

## Model-visible guidance
First-party names follow lowercase ASCII <domain>_<action>[_object], single underscores and <=64 characters. Registration/final preparation reject invalid/duplicate names; priority never replaces handlers. [Historical spelling](../../internal/ai/toolnames/migration.json) maps only released names; names.go reserves current first-party additions without invented migrations. Reserve mcp_; MCP uses 192 bits of the exact released capability digest, retaining display labels.

Definitions/dispatch/observation/transports share names, without advertised aliases. Hosted provider tools and JavaScript methods retain separate contracts. Strict-schema null-to-omit affects only adapter-added nullable fields. Frozen retries keep bytes.

Published Floret names Goal/input goal_manage/user_ask. Exact explicit allowlists constrain these built-ins; unattended input is separately disabled. Product schema 12→13 migrates exact execution Options.tool_allowlist values, deriving MCP identities without current server configuration. Journals, signatures/effects, user/script text and native history retain original bytes/spelling. Read-only presentation maps history; search bindings retain service. Restart pairs known-undispatched calls with canceled receipts under original identity; new work reauthorizes. No aliases or automatic replay.

[Budget tests](../../internal/ai/tool_definition_budget_test.go) pin final HTTP membership/bytes with ~3–4% allowance, no description truncation. Full/readonly/Computer-disabled/plugin fixtures include controls, attachments and Goal; search/MCP remain unconfigured. Computer defaults to three tools, historical primitives separate.

## Diagnostic ownership
Typed owner/cancel/deadline/filesystem classifications survive; unknown wording stays UNKNOWN. Keywords never infer resources, authority, safety or replacement arguments. Missing error data is not encoding loss. Owners resolve authorized relative/home paths. Removing heuristics alone proves no quality gain.

## File inspection
file_read/file_read_many/path_find are read-only across modes, retaining session read and filesystem policy; admission requirements remain separate. file_search remains readonly-only, with no aliases.

file_read uses Registry.OpenRead and complete UTF-8 lines: 1-based offset (omitted/0=1), default 200/max400, <=8,000 content bytes/24KiB escaped JSON. Exact line_offset/count and next_offset report continuation; total_lines stays unknown until EOF (empty=0). No whole-file rejection/tail scan. Prefix scanning stops at64MiB with cancellation. Oversized lines, invalid UTF-8/NUL fail without partial cursors/fallback; every call reads current bytes.

file_read_many accepts50 paths/default120 lines and <=32KiB encoded items. Errors are per-file; next_index is submitted zero-based index. Individual continuation uses file_read. Preserve executor coordinates/content in model projection; Activity is separate.

path_find.name is a basename glob (*,?,classes), not relative path. Reject malformed patterns; hidden defaults off, no symlink following/gitignore. Bound default200/max1000 results, default8/max32 depth (0=default),10,000 entries,5s,32KiB. Truncation means incomplete; narrow before concluding absence.

## File editing
Product resolves cwd; registry owns logical/canonical write policy including authorized external/scratch roots. Reject readonly/sibling/ancestor/symlink escape independently of target policy. Resolve existing/new-file ancestors before approval. Preserve submitted paths; ordered canonical resources/snapshots reject swaps at preflight, every commit and Move deletion. This is neither OS sandbox nor elimination of TOCTOU.

Only file_write/full contents and file_apply_patch/contextual add/change/delete/move execute. No literal replacement/input_format alias/implied freeform protocol; historical calls and target navigation stay readable.

Forward matching uses anchors/EOF/ranges. Only order failures may reorder unique exact nonoverlapping chunks without anchors/ranges/EOF/pure additions, through the same matcher/plan. Ambiguity requires unique context; providers still request source order. Pure additions append. Preserve untouched endings; insertion uses first ending (empty=LF), nonempty updates retain final newline. Match exact, then whitespace, then supported Unicode normalization at first allowed match; never reindent literals. Add/Move may replace regular files; one operation/path.

Diagnostics retain order/overlap/anchor/EOF/context/duplicate path, chunk/body-line, search boundary/source line and remedy, never choose writes. Validate all before writing; snapshot-check each commit. Validation proves no writes; failure retains completed operations and uncertainty. completed_files means complete operations. Activity owns full actual diff/paths/counts; model omits diff and may inspect. Destination success/source-delete failure is create/update against prior destination, not rename. Atomicity is per-file, never whole patch/Move. Published ordered resources/EffectOutcome/PatchActivity own authorization/settlement/history.

Local feedback/integration and patch correctness/order/diagnostics/scope/runtime tests cover no-effect correction, partial commits/Fork/restart; live proposal fixtures never execute writes. Naming/history tests cover final provider mappings, original signed/paired histories, pending input/approval, Fork/Retry and no replay on published Floret.

November8 baseline16f0a9854 retained37 tools with smaller JSON; DeepSeek baseline9/9 versus candidate8/9 retained a cancellation-count error. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
- Local Env management HTTP waits for Redeven to register the authenticated session identity and access gate, even when the secure carrier is already connected. This host activation barrier is independent of plugin admission; failed plugins cannot withhold ordinary management. Closing, rejecting or expiring a binding releases its waiters, and downstream identity/permission checks remain authoritative.
- After activation, recovery pages settings by 200, retains complete media inventories and resumes eligible admitted queues. Per-thread failure cannot starve later pages; ownership review follows. Incomplete recovery gates destructive maintenance and retries next maintenance pass. Waiters retain their own attempt's result.
- Background phases cannot regress a published generation or unmount Flower. Orphan discovery updates degraded/retry state; successful reconciliation or explicit repair clears issues. Shutdown cancels/joins generation workers before storage close.
- Explicit asynchronous retry admits one startup owner. Replacement cancels long-lived generation work, waits for idempotent lease releases, closes once, then publishes the next monotonic generation.
- Unleasable AI routes return HTTP 503 `AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with sanitized state. Readiness/retry/stop and admin snapshot/restore bypass service acquisition. Incomplete provider leases release supplied resources and cannot report ready.

frontmatter.title: Scheduled workflows and shared Flower work

concepts.summary: Automation owns definitions, context and artifacts; ReDevPlugin owns durable scheduling and published agent.work. Canonical Floret owns admission, execution, approval and observation, with no second model runtime. Tessiven business linkage is deferred.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Definition and authorization

Ownership comes from the authenticated user and Environment, never request fields. Drafts grant no execution; incomplete drafts use revision compare-and-swap. Publication validates the DAG, model, directory, tools and result schemas and requires an explicit expiring grant. Republishing retains prior run grants; revoke disables every version.

Runs pin publication, purpose, scheduled time and request identity. Repeated requests return their receipt; changed payloads conflict. Receipt reads authorize no new effects. Changed drafts require publication before Run or schedule enablement. Archive retains history and stops admission.

Before admission/effects, reconstruct authority from the versioned grant and current Environment cap. Channel-free effects require an owner-bound thread and current delegation, never just an automation label. Interactive effects still require channels. Persist no bearer/admin/platform-model/Desktop authority; background models exclude interactive platform/Desktop sources. Revocation fences effects and requests canonical cancellation.

## Scheduling

Published scheduling owns interval/completion-relative/daily IANA-timezone cadence, missed/overlap policies, bounded queue, claim identity and recovery. Plans pin immutable publications. Preview uses the same calculation without enabling. Pause changes future scheduling independently of unsaved edits and retains admitted work.

Scheduler claim IDs are product run request IDs. Dispatch checks plan revision, publication and authority. Lost responses reconcile against retained admissions; known runs are never resubmitted. Only absence of that exact request in the exclusive workflow store proves not_committed. Unknown canonical effects remain unknown; error wording never establishes retry safety.

## Execution and context

Nodes support fixed tools, Flower, bounded parallel items, conditions, joins, HTML and local artifacts. Structured results expand stable item IDs. Partial joins require minimum success and retain gaps. Retry preserves successful siblings, invalidates descendants and never replays unknown effects without reconciliation. Admissions recheck cancellation/deadline/dependencies; cancellation stays monotonic through authorization.

One run-level context revision spans goal, pinned definition, scheduled time, findings, decisions, results, requirements and source uncertainty. Bounded briefs reference paged contributions/materials; external content grants no authority. Contributions name the actual attempt/read basis; changed content under repeated IDs conflicts. New requirements retain history, invalidate stale results/artifacts and fence late outputs.

Flower nodes use separate execution threads with shared workflow context. Canonical ThreadModelContext snapshots and UsedAt/UsedByRequestID prove loaded context; briefs alone do not. Mutation receipts are compact; evidence requires explicit reads. Results remain candidates until canonical success and output-schema validation.

Fixed HTTP reads use the existing host transport, no ambient headers, no redirects, a 25-second deadline and a 48-KiB body bound. Container reads use the existing product resource adapter. HTML rendering uses escaped Go templates with an enforced 2-MiB output bound. Artifacts retain content, digest and context revision; previews use sandboxed frames with restrictive document policy. Delivery currently saves a local retained artifact, not email or remote publication.

## Unified Flower profiles and plugin work

flowerwork resolves one owner-bound thread profile: plugin authoring, Tessiven design, workflow design/execution or plugin analysis. Profiles supply guidance, tools, skills, result contracts and context references. Product stores retain lifecycle; Floret retains history, without a parallel ledger. Ordinary chats expose no owner-specific tools.

Design reads/saves drafts without enabling execution. Workflow controls own run threads, rejecting ordinary chat mutation/fork/retry/queue/goal/subagent/computer/upload takeover. Tools recheck permissions and the original grant. Unattended Floret disables user input; optional Goal and all built-ins obey the exact final allowlist.

Installed plugins use published agent.work through the platform bridge. Retain its exact binding; revalidate instance/fingerprint/revisions/permissions/expiry before continuation. Plugin owner fields/new bindings cannot renew authority. Each request creates visible host review and permits at most one run after user model/directory selection and authorization. Analysis uses provided materials without arbitrary tool grants; author preview cannot borrow installed-host authority.

## Persistence and lifecycle

Redeven owns/process-locks StateDir/apps/automation/workflows.sqlite. Atomic verified migration precedes readiness: 1→2 retains versioned grants; 2→3 recovers draft/publication revision from definitions, keeping changed drafts unpublished. Unsupported state stays unchanged. Published scheduling migrates opaque schedules.sqlite; Floret storage stays opaque.

Shutdown stops scheduling, drains the controller, stops AI execution, then closes product stores. Model-service generations are acquired through the existing readiness lease, not retained across replacement.

sections.body: Independent canvas: DAG/inspector, undo/redo, recovery/CAS review, keyboard/zoom/fit, narrow layouts, schedule/run/context history and artifacts. Conflicts retain drafts; rebasing requires saved-version review, replacement is undoable and concurrent writes still conflict. Late loads/saves preserve edits; polls cannot regress run revision. Authenticated transport downloads artifacts. Local drafts/offline intents grant no execution authority. Each locale owns its copy.

concepts.summary: Native resource services own endpoint-bound execution, admission and reconciliation; the console presents typed authorized facts and drafts. Disk usage never authorizes cleanup or overrides the reference preflight. [Runtime execution](containers-operation-observation.md#engine-execution) owns discovery, endpoint binding, typed CLI reads and normalization; [volume usage](#volume-observations) owns reference completeness and independent usage reads.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Authority
- Strictly decode mutations and reject unknown fields. Keep uncertain outcomes explicit. Server gates `/_redeven_proxy/api/container-resources` and `container-resource-operations`; disabled controls are only presentation.
- Renderer cannot construct argv, skip admission or mutate managed resources. DTOs expose typed redacted facts, excluding environment/label values, credentials, sockets/certificates, remote URLs and Compose paths. Terminal sessions retain Write/Execute checks.
- [Console](#console) projects established targets/capabilities. Direct engine reachability proves resource readiness; host-service management state cannot replace that probe.

## Console
- Persist only resource view/key per `redeven.containers` instance. Preserve target identity even for same-name resources. Existing actions reuse their source; creation uses the sole compatible engine or asks Docker/Podman within its dialog.
- One compact header owns refresh/Operations; Workbench suppresses duplicate title. [Operation observation](containers-operation-observation.md#operation-ownership) owns progress/errors.
- Compose input is 1–8 ordered absolute YAML paths, optional absolute env-file and at most 16 profiles, represented as arrays. No retired directory-only or lazy-picker alternate path.
- One `ContainerRunDraft`/serializer feeds existing preflight/hash/operation admission. Never persist environment values/host paths in UI state. Retain draft through preflight/confirmation; clear only on success or explicit close.
- Use sortable desktop tables, fewer columns in narrow Workbench and mobile cards/full-screen details. Missing/stopped/unreachable/denied engines show detection state rather than stale inventory.
- Keep restrained typography, semantic surfaces and brief bounded feedback; published primitives own menu/dialog position, focus and presence.
- The log toolbar stays at content height; its viewer receives the remaining detail-body height, with the existing bounded gap and responsive wrapping. Sparse or empty logs must not stretch the toolbar.

## Volume observations
References include stopped containers; sizes report occupied bytes, never capacity. Failed size reads retain inventory with unavailable metrics.

### Reference completeness
Volume inventory and detail return `referenced_containers`, `used_by`, and `references_complete`. The native console renders incomplete observations as Unknown and excludes them from both In use and Unused filters. A partial Used by view may show known references together with an incomplete-inspection notice.

### Disk usage
`GET /container-resources/volume-disk-usage` is an independent, Read-only, no-store observation. Unexpected layouts fail visibly instead of being interpreted as an empty measurement.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
`containerengine` owns execution/redaction; `containerresource` owns admission, locks, cancellation, events and reconciliation; Web Services owns its resources. ReDevPlugin has no Containers adapter/package/client/UI role. Host administrators own engine installation and OS access.

Floe owns reusable pickers/controls/icons. Redeven owns filesystem adaptation, product state/copy/placement/navigation; `containerresource` alone owns mutation/reconciliation.

Volume usage is an observation, not a capacity, quota, free-space, billing, or cleanup contract. Redeven does not infer safety from an unavailable size or an incomplete reference scan, and it does not bypass the authoritative mutation preflight when deleting a volume.

concepts.summary: One ContainerServiceController owns Docker/Podman discovery, lifecycle, configuration, preflight identity and reconciliation. Known management/health faults retain ID/implementation/config sources/actions. Missing CLI/permission/timeout/unknown is not stopped.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Identity/execution
Discover engines independently,one service each,no inactive-context scan/fallback. Share two-second command budget per engine; health reuses selected endpoint. Resource readiness separately bounded. Desktop requires selected desktop-linux/desktop-windows or exact endpoint alias; installed plugin proves no ownership. Use docker desktop version --format json,not slow status. Resolve Podman Machine before health.

Start needs stopped;Stop/Restart running;save-and-restart needs known state before write,plain save remains.

Lifecycle shares two minutes across steps vs ten-second queries/two-second discovery,parent deadline/cancel honored. macOS Start uses /usr/bin/open -g -b com.docker.docker then bounded poll;Restart stops first. Other platforms/Stop use official CLI. LaunchServices allowlists identity/home/PATH/temp/shell/locale/timezone/proxy/certificates,excluding Redeven metadata,Electron/Node controls,CLI overrides,secrets. Explicit empty env stays empty;CLI/probes unchanged. Launch acceptance is not completion;reload final state under lock. Never sudo/pkexec/polkit/elevate/change groups or socket modes.

Read-gated GET /_redeven_proxy/api/container-resources/services returns modes/source IDs;one engine failure cannot hide another. Legacy state→engine,client_proxy→docker_cli.

Optional `diagnostic` separates observed discovery/management/health faults from `guidance_code` ownership advice. It contains only phase, typed code and observation time; never stderr, paths, endpoints or credentials. Permission, missing CLI, timeout, unreachable and unknown are distinct. Only a health probe can report stopped; management failure cannot establish running state. Successful refresh removes the previous diagnostic.

## Interaction
One preflight confirmation names service/localized risk/impact/action,no retyped name/second review. Client binds name,server identity/authority/request+plan hashes. Cancel creates no operation;duplicates locked. Hide hashes/raw prose;history resolves names/localized errors.

Settings warns. Header aligns square outlined Back/title independently of description;touch>=44px. Refresh retains cards,animates indicator only,errors inline. Known Desktop/unknown health retains disabled Start/guidance until revalidated. Active divider replaces controls with elapsed/cancel/secondary history;no invented percent/auto-open history. Failure offers recovery;SSE/poll completion reloads service/Runtime.

Current health leads;active work retains locks/feedback. Terminal start/restart failure on running card and stop failure on stopped card clear live feedback;unknown/config failures retain recovery. Completed/canceled remains history. Current running cannot rewrite failed restart. History separates original result/error/duration from current state;no empty error or historical live timer.

### Ask Flower
Existing cards prioritize a concise localized diagnostic over management guidance. Permission/unreachable/error states and stopped services without Start expose only the Flower icon in the existing action row, with a localized Ask Flower tooltip and accessible name. Read access and a ready resource suffice to ask; asking performs no configuration or lifecycle operation. Active operation controls retain their owner. Existing header Refresh revalidates the same cards and removes the assistance action after recovery.

The action opens the existing [contextual launcher](../ui/flower-activity-companion.md#shared-input-card) beside its button in Activity or Workbench, with one removable/previewable reference before an empty editor. No generated question, extra sidebar or setup wizard. `container_services` accepts only `text_snapshot`: a frozen allowlist of environment/service identity, observed state, available version/rootless/remote facts, capabilities, configuration source IDs, diagnostic, displayed summary, management guidance and capture time. Missing facts remain unknown. Raw configuration and secrets never enter the snapshot.

The existing current-runtime target and server admission own authority; snapshot facts never grant access or authorize elevation. Sending projects the snapshot into the existing canonical text reference/model context. The optional service response and paired Runtime-served Env App addition leave Runtime Service/placement protocols, Desktop request shapes and database schemas unchanged; no compatibility epoch changes.

concepts.title: Container execution and operation observation
concepts.summary: Container operations bind exact engine/endpoint/resource. Public terminal taxonomy distinguishes storage, registry availability, rate limit, missing and denied; UI maps known codes to localized guidance with durable timeline.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Operation ownership
### Admission and serialization
Key by engine, opaque endpoint ID, kind and canonical identity. Reused request ID with changed hashes conflicts, never creates another operation.

### Exact recovery
Read exact operation ID or read-only by-request/<request_id>, independent of recent-list limits. Absence remains uncertain while admission may be in flight; never replay. Container-Operation-Admission: rejected is valid only before operation storage, not a storage-boundary failure.

### Execution, cancellation, and events
Service context spans queue through reconciliation. Only explicit API cancels; closing UI/streams/browser does not. Unknown codes use localized generic failure; raw code/message remain diagnostics. Timeout acknowledges possibly running host work. Desktop setup/startup directs to native app plus status revalidation. Service history uses actual transitions, no generic stages/percentage.

### Authoritative terminal observation
After execution, reload exact endpoint resource/bounded inventory; presence/absence never authorizes replay.

### UI observation
Shell owns pending admissions, concurrent streams and settlement invalidation; Settings/inventory own presentation only. Ambiguous submission retains exact request and blocks duplicates while background reads reconcile. Disposal never cancels admitted work; same-owner reconnect retains history, authentication/environment change retires observers. Fence requests/events by runtime/endpoint/view/generation; stale inventory cannot regress operations. Mobile/desktop share state/cancel authority. Card owns live lifecycle; history is secondary. Terminal polls refresh service/Runtime even after stream loss. Portaled drawer owns responsive container/scroll: sidebar on desktop, horizontal history above narrow details. Stable IDs/pressed rows preserve focus/detail DOM. Separate identity, cancel, duration/current health and timeline; active final step stays pending.

## Engine execution
Observe Docker/Podman independently; never probe inactive contexts or change global selection.

### Execution ownership
Every operation revalidates exact endpoint/resource; observation error is never empty project or successful removal.

### Image pull observation
Preserve CLI endpoint/credential helpers. Unix dedicated pull supplies terminal output and continuously reads both streams with bounded lines/control stripping; ordinary runners unchanged. Windows reports only actual combined-pipe counters. Cancellation stops owned process group; never replay executed pull through nonstreaming fallback.

Sum observed compressed-download counters even with unknown layers. Total stays unknown until every noncached layer reports it; cached contributes zero, extraction never replaces download and completed download is not completed extraction. Suppress unchanged redraws. Preserve bounded trailing error evidence, including containerd unresolved-reference missing errors.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: DB is evidence, not queue/replay journal. UI observes lifecycle; restart read-only reconciliation marks active work interrupted, never success/retry. [Native authority](container-resources-capability.md#authority) owns redaction/permissions. Endpoints stay internal and resolve freshly before operations; unsupported methods fail explicitly.

concepts.title: Database schema migration ownership
concepts.summary: Each repository migrates its own opaque stores. Validate full SQLite/WAL before readiness; contiguous atomic edges preserve records. Future, drifted, wrong-kind or unsupported state remains untouched. Failure blocks only its service without upstream repair or database replacement.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Redeven-owned stores
Each SQLite store declares a stable database kind, current version, supported minimum version, ordered `n -> n+1` migrations, an existing-schema validator, and a final exact verifier.

Migration and verification failure rolls back.

The process-locked redeven_automation store migrates local schema 1 grants to publication-version keys, then schema 2 to 3 recovers published_revision from retained definitions. Changed drafts remain unpublished; grants, runs and private platform bindings are preserved. The adjacent scheduler database remains upstream-owned.

Host identity upgrades use their own private journal and native verification after Registry migration; no live-engine guess or database reset substitutes for resource ownership.

## Upstream-owned stores
Floret owns canonical thread storage and its schema lifecycle through the published Runtime APIs.

Cross-database atomicity is never assumed or simulated by copying upstream lifecycle state into Redeven tables.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Automatic migration is not permission to accept arbitrary historical shapes. A repository-owned pre-release reset is exceptional, user-approved, and permanently closes once its new baseline is distributed.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Chunked history remains an atomic canonical-dimension snapshot; compound controls use Floe CSS.

## Placement
Published SplitWorkspace owns splits/adaptive layouts/docking/swaps/accessible resize. Split creates backend view; subsequent placement edits update it. Named independent views have thumbnails, layout/rename/delete controls and creation above Groups.

Cross-view drag atomically moves membership, leaving vacancy. Pane/sidebar close terminates named session without deleting view/collapsing geometry. Only Delete view releases members without stopping them. New views create fresh sessions.

Footer layout targets current view; row picker targets its view without activation. Preserve members, unavailable sessions, vacancies, reading order and selection. Published adaptive options deduplicate balanced rows/columns/grids/four main directions for2–32 slots; disable standalone/single-slot pickers. One environment provider atomically revision-checks affected source/destination views. Edits survive acknowledgement; conflict retains draft for explicit reload/discard. Catalog waits for shell-confirmed access/current transport. Reconnect pauses requests, retains drafts and reloads after restored access. One lifecycle resets environment/permission authority; unchanged permission retains readiness/drafts, retired connections cannot publish. Edits await readiness.

Active view is panel-local. Import unowned legacyv1 local splits once, clearing only after backend acknowledgement. Missing sessions become vacancies without pruning geometry; close persists fresh vacancy IDs and keeps even empty view selected. Each vacancy offers localized creation/exact drag target. Within-view moves leave vacancy. Local progress/errors preserve failed-close session; empty selection never chooses unrelated session. Views never restart PTYs.

concepts.title: Git workspace inventory lifecycle
concepts.summary: Git queries expose bounded immutable snapshots with revision-bound paging. Git/Files mutations coordinate topology and invalidate snapshots around effects; display grants no authority. Oversized/stale/malformed/exhausted reads return bounded typed errors without losing Flowersec session.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
- Incrementally read NUL-delimited porcelain v2 and reserve token/record/path/heap/process/capture/cache capacity before growth. Filesystem identity prevents recreated paths inheriting old coordination or revisions.
- `git.getCapabilities` advertises revisioned pages, path/directory status and stash-section diff. `git.listWorkspacePathStatuses` accepts bounded known paths and returns rows or directory counts without descendant arrays.
- One Agent Git runtime coordinates cancellable topology, active worktrees, canonical lock order, fair per-repository reads/writes, epochs, process admission and snapshots. Escaped process-group descendants never justify unbounded handlers/pipes.
- Linked-worktree deletion reviews fingerprint removal risks: branch/base commits, merge eligibility, repository/worktree identity, staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted paths and status classes, ignored path summaries, blockers and required authorizations. Preview and execution use the same risk definition; execution rereads current Git status before comparing the reviewed fingerprint.
- Use bounded Git status and `ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard --directory --no-empty-directory -z`. Collapse ignored directories such as `DerivedData/`; do not add a recursive filesystem inventory, per-file metadata fingerprint or content checksum. Ignored content still requires explicit discard consent. Changes within an already-reviewed ignored directory or content-only edits to an already-reviewed dirty path do not invalidate consent; changed path/status sets or repository/worktree identity do.

Repository summaries expose optional whole-index staged additions/deletions from a budgeted, cancellable Git shortstat read. Directory paging never narrows those totals. Binary-only and pure rename changes have zero text-line deltas; failed reads omit statistics. External index writers remain non-transactional.

## Mutation scope and branch removal

- Stage/unstage resolve the requested section, directory and literal paths first. Execute only those resolved paths through a private NUL-delimited pathspec file; a changes action cannot stage conflicts, and unstaging cannot clear conflict stages outside its selection.
- Branch origin and the directory where `git worktree add` ran do not decide removability. A linked worktree created from the primary `main` directory, including below that directory, can be removed with its branch after review. The primary worktree remains non-removable even after switching it to a feature branch; switch that directory to another branch before deleting its old branch.
- Delete review rejects inaccessible or changed repository identity, primary worktrees, locked worktrees, and targets containing another registered worktree (including detached worktrees). Block both safe and force actions and return a stable `blocking_code` for localized UI. Lock/topology changes invalidate the reviewed fingerprint.
- Worktree removal and discarding local content are separate authorizations. Both safe and force modes require explicit discard consent for tracked, untracked or ignored files. Force branch deletion only relaxes the merged-commit check; it does not imply permission to discard local work. Never unlock worktrees automatically.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Git remains authoritative; snapshots are read models. Discard consent covers the reviewed removal risk, not an exact version of every file's bytes. Git may perform its normal content checks when computing status; Redeven does not add a whole-tree scan. External writers remain a non-transactional limit. Published Flowersec owns transport-wide lifecycle; this contract cannot bound non-Git RPCs/notifications or control escaped OS processes, Floret or ReDevPlugin internals.

concepts.title: Host application lifecycle and Linux instance recovery

frontmatter.title: Host application lifecycle and Linux instance recovery

concepts.summary: Viewing, sharing, closing windows and ending processes remain distinct across platforms. The first Force quit action only enters that state; only its final confirmation sends the destructive host request. Instance records bind opaque ID, authorized owner, metadata, boot/PID/start, component identity and private backend endpoint. Reusable window IDs never grant authority.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Cross-platform behavior
| Operation | macOS | Linux |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Close outer Desktop window / browser popup | Release this client lease; app survives | Same |
| Network loss, reload, second viewer | Reconnect same live app; stale input is revoked | Same |
| Release this client lease | End this capture/route; other clients and app survive | End this proxy/route; other clients and app survive |
| No window for more than 40 seconds | Waiting, with native menu/reopen | Waiting, reconnect same process without relaunch |
| Close last window | Viewer closes; app decides whether its process exits | Same |
| Cancel normal close/quit | Preserve application and save dialog | Same; ordinary control is Close all windows |
| Explicit Force quit in library | Confirm loss warning; exact AppKit instance | Confirm loss warning; exact owned backend and descendants |
| Orderly Runtime shutdown or process exit | Native app remains discoverable | Private display survives; new Runtime verifies/reconnects it |
| Running list | Regular apps in the logged-in OS session | Caller-owned Redeven instances, including detached/windowless apps |
| Host reboot / display server destruction / OS cleanup | No survival guarantee | Same; Runtime cgroup cleanup may also end its virtual display |

### Accepted operations and visible state
Quit and force-quit are asynchronous. Shell retains per-application admission and pending state across view replacement and polls authoritative running instances. Only disappearance of the exact target instances settles the operation. The confirmation closes after acceptance; stale cached inventory cannot settle it. No observer retries a quit or escalates it. Environment retirement fences late responses.

## Linux recovery
- Upstream supervises GIO/descendant/sandbox lifetime. Preparation, launcher failure, app exit, windows and first pixels are separate facts. Xpra retains published readiness/final-window/audio-disable behavior.
- Browser profiles are stable private directories per owner/catalog app. Observed process-tree exit before first window fails launch even with zero status; live processes may keep waiting.
- Linux ordinary control is Close all windows, respecting save/cancel. Explicit force quit never follows close, disconnect, cancellation or uncertain response automatically. Acceptance is not exit proof; remove running rows only after kernel confirmation.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Linux cannot generically request AppKit-style application quit or reopen, nor adopt an arbitrary process on another display. macOS requires its real logged-in graphical session and explicit capture/input permissions. Neither backend can preserve an application after its OS or display environment has been destroyed.

Reconnect cannot restore destroyed display/OS processes or change ownership policy. Surviving-instance recovery never substitutes a replacement launch.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Keyboard and composition
- Embed published remote-input/CSS. Each backend has one copy/cut/paste handler, excluding duplicate IME submission. Flush pending pointer output before keys/text/clipboard.
- Native Linux uses authenticated published helper transport without another gesture/composition owner. Browser/OS owns clipboard normalization; confirmed Unicode stays byte-exact.
- Upstream owns retained Xpra capability, private environment, commit-only XIM, toolkit adapters, prepared client and scheduler. Historical preparation version alone cannot reject a viewer, replace modules or kill processes.
- macOS advertises `input_version: 1` and never switches global input source. Same-window recapture may retain focus but rejects input until decoded replacement pixels.

## Pointer gestures
### Gestures and event ownership
A touch begins pending, without a remote button press.

Leaving the document does cancel.

### Scroll and lifecycle
A finger moving up or left reveals content below or to the right.

The Linux native adapter submits fractional CSS-pixel deltas directly; its gesture release callback has no remainder and never releases keyboard input.

Each viewer owns its controller, feedback and transient remainder independently.

### Acceptance boundary
[Validation](../operations/host-application-validation.md#historical-distributioninput) distinguishes generated browser events from actual native application receipts and physical mobile devices. Device emulation cannot qualify a real soft keyboard or pinch.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
[Validation](../operations/host-application-validation.md#input-cursor-and-lifecycle-acceptance) distinguishes simulated events, app receipts, OS IME and physical mobile evidence. Sent packets, emulated viewports and synthetic composition alone do not certify system input acceptance.

A gesture cannot cross painted-window or connection generations. Reopening a viewer cannot upgrade the still-running application's pointer protocol.

concepts.summary: Runtime/native events own application facts; bootstrap and published SDK own viewing, geometry and immutable resources. Modes Automatic/Clarity first/Motion first/Save data persist through reload; same selection,locale/theme never reconnect. [Performance](../operations/host-application-performance.md) owns budgets.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Viewer state
Use [Flowersec window transport](graphical-window-transport.md) for graphical state/picture/input. Reserve browser tab in initiating click, retain app identity through admission and use host launch deduplication for retry; closing pending tab cannot kill uncertain admission. Browser loading has no Desktop chrome/Node dependency. Pre-window launcher exit fails; a live slow process has no window timeout. Terminal records are bounded memory, lost on Runtime restart; expired routes reopen from library. Only confirmed final-window/app closure dismisses established viewing; empty inventory/transport loss proves no exit.

## Picture settings ownership
Env App Settings → Applications & Desktop owns picture mode and native resolution/frame-rate limits in `config.json` under `host_application_picture`, keyed only by authenticated user identity. Viewers use no-store read-only scoped endpoints and retain last confirmed state on network failure; there is one serialized request and pagehide abort. No viewer-local writer or silent preference import remains. Browser openers require registered source, exact origin and product viewer path; Desktop IPC requires exact window/frame/bootstrap identity and routes only to the existing Env window. Opening settings never starts a Runtime.

## Display and native streams
Published compositor owns Wayland/Xwayland geometry,resize and bounded family/popups; Xpra uses selected v20/v21 client. Native chrome moves/maximizes/minimizes primary window. Missing paint/close request/transport proves no closure. Request source density for Clarity; quality/HTTPS cannot recover absent detail. [Certificates](../security/local-ui-network-exposure.md#certificates) owns trust: viewer never creates/trusts certs,changes protocol,restarts Runtime or downgrades TLS.

Published native library owns capture/regions/encoding/composition/cursor normalization. Retain complete cursor PNG/alpha/bounds/hotspot: longest<=24CSSpx,never enlarge small images. New shares use current resources without changing app identity; macOS keeps client system cursor. Only composed current pixels authorize input/ACK.

## Resources and compatibility
Floe owns immutable documents/assets/digests/capabilities; pin one per authorized Xpra share. New combined Linux sessions use native canvas/frame/input/cursor. Xpra pre-client inherits viewer's Flowersec constructor and fails without it. Retiring share revokes its snapshot lookup only.

Compatible viewers reconnect; missing/corrupt/unsupported resources fail preparation/Retry. Protocol<2 retains logical density with explanation. Unsupported input/pointer disables controls while preserving pictures/local UI; authenticated incompatible loaded modules need save/quit/reopen, never hot swap. Transient focus/context follows normal recovery. Quality changes use current authenticated attachment and cannot choose codec/binary/capture executable/install. Native component/decoder must share published SDK; no product codec/parser.

sections.title: Boundaries

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Catalog
Catalog and session listing require read permission. Ownership comes from authorized session metadata, never a request-provided user ID.

Terminal sharing records remain bounded to forty-eight per Runtime lifetime.

A separate Force quit confirmation explicitly warns that unsaved work is lost; it never follows cancellation automatically.

Application inventory loading uses matching horizontal skeleton cards and respects reduced motion.

## Feature access
Persisted `host_access.applications` and `host_access.desktop` independently record `unconfigured`, `enabled`, or `paused`. First catalog/status read initializes missing legacy states from passive capability/session evidence; later grants cannot change intent. Startup restores both gates.

Pause fences new streamed launches and releases only that feature's viewers, retaining preferences. Apps, components, shared OS grants, application inventory and the other feature survive. Legacy `unconfigured` remains supported by both APIs; the desktop API also clears display/approval-reuse preferences. Neither feature exposes reset/removal in the UI. Local launch stays independent.

When both features are unconfigured, goal choices precede authorization; browsing remains available. Setup explains capability purpose and one next action. macOS settings/restart paths are explicit and preserve selected-app intent. Confirmed helper restart ends shares, retains access intent/apps, and requires reconnection. Explicit completion enables access and returns to the list; only selected-app intent opens an app. Background preparation cannot undo disabled access; dismissal withdraws opening, not grants.

An icon-only application-header gear has a localized name/tooltip and opens independent feature states with one setup/resume action each. Before readiness, only explicit setup exposes missing permissions/components; hide picture tuning. Optional collapsed application-picture settings belong to enabled Applications, never Desktop. Persistent desktop authorization requires enabled/ready Desktop. Shared permission maintenance is collapsed while either feature is usable. Collapse, pause, readiness loss or category exit retires portals/mutation authority, preserving drafts; return never reopens tuning or replays writes. Returning from macOS Settings refreshes permissions and both feature summaries. [Launcher interaction](remote-desktop-launcher.md) owns setup/connection presentation.

## Platforms
### Immutable launch plan
GIO resolves the authorized desktop entry. A sandbox launcher requiring metadata fails clearly when metadata is absent; a custom wrapper is not proof that the underlying package is supported.

The [preparation owner](#preparation) selects complete components.

### Private graphics and host services
Each instance owns unique private display/socket, authorization, runtime and bus resources.

It never exposes the whole desktop bus or arbitrary process management.

Support claims require real package and desktop evidence, as recorded in the [validation owner](../operations/host-application-validation.md#retained-xpraplatform-matrix).

### macOS initialization
The [native macOS contract](macos-host-applications.md) owns local launch, remote single-window capture, input, and graceful lifecycle. macOS 13 or newer uses the packaged `redeven-computer-host` helper.

A Mac without a graphical login cannot create a private headless AppKit session. Native AppKit applications do not become X11 applications by installing XQuartz, and Xpra desktop shadowing is not this implementation.

## Preparation
- `go.mod` owns exact dependency/toolchain versions. Never combine partial managed/system installations. [Applications](#catalog) owns environment restoration, private displays and dependencies.
- Status, explicit transfer-plan inspection and observation require Read. Upstream serializes writers with a private-root lease and owns scoped cancellation/idempotent chunks. [Desktop cache](../desktop/host-application-component-cache.md) owns cross-device reuse, seven-day/2GB policy and separate progress.
- Shell owns preparation admission, Desktop acquisition, upload and observation; views own selected-app opening intent. Page disposal only withdraws automatic opening. Explicit Cancel alone requests host cancellation; environment retirement fences results and stops transport. Lost events reconcile status while work is active. Preparation names the selected app. Session refresh cannot reuse stale unavailable state or suppress its one pending opening. [macOS](macos-host-applications.md) owns helper/local launch/explicit capture-input permission and requires graphical login.

Linux readiness uses capability probes; missing components block opening. macOS requires a native graphical session/permissions. Preparation never installs user apps or activates unqualified bytes. Closing a pending viewer withdraws automatic opening.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Independent execution
Host launches in its own session and process group. The foreground start contract remains: templates must not double-fork, background the application, or retain a permanent wrapper.

## Native identity and recovery
The `host:v3` identity binds service ID, launch nonce, PID, and a digest of native facts:

New identities never use formatted dates, timezone, command text, or `kern.boottime`.

An old process's inherited output descriptors cannot be replaced externally; independent output handling takes effect on its next explicit restart.

## Opening and presentation
Host supplies verified native launch identity and executes only the applied authorized hooks through the common [managed opening contract](managed-web-service-opening.md). The driver stores only launch facts and after-start hook completion, never executable snapshots or a second entrance cache. Preparation follows healthy startup and can be retried without stopping the application.

`localui.Server` is built with an agent, Code App app server, bind spec, runtime-control socket path, Local Environment identity, diagnostics store, and optional access gate.

## Concurrent shutdown
Context cancellation and explicit shutdown enter the same serialized close path. Runtime-control and management status serialize start/close and protect endpoint reads, so overlapping shutdown cannot dereference cleared servers or advertise a retired control listener. This uses bounded in-process locks and does not introduce durable lifecycle state.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Discovery and input
AppKit discovers standard locations, running bundle paths and explicit absolute .app paths. Canonical path owns identity; localized metadata/system icons present it. Trusted Desktop Local opens natively; remote selected-window capture uses host-application protocol 2, separate from Computer Use. Verify bundle/process and reuse single-instance windows. Local focus or waiting for pre-frame composition grants no remote authority.

## Helper
One lazy Manager-owned signed Redeven Desktop Access.app serves catalog/app/desktop channels; development uses its distinct Dev identity. Bare executable only relays stdio. Published FloeNativeDesktop launches the exact app through Launch Services before privacy APIs. Authenticated private sockets separate media/control; native capture/input remain upstream. Bounded per-channel queues (128 response messages) isolate credit, authorization and input. Empty inventory leaves helper idle until Runtime closes, preserving capture identity. Helper failure ends sharing, never apps; explicit later open may recover. Shutdown preserves unsaved applications.

## Management
Setup explains screen recording for window display and accessibility for control. Existing grants are reused; local launch needs neither. Request permission, open fixed Settings and reveal actual helper are separate explicit actions; a pending prompt never auto-opens Settings. permission_app_name comes from the running helper. Show one current permission, persistent screen→input steps, exact name and one action that becomes Settings after request; view-only omits input.

Visible setup/opening, return from explicit permission flow or Check again uses check_permissions to renew only idle native ownership and reread both grants. Admission lock spans idle inspection/shutdown; existing channels preserve owner. Concurrent probes defer renewal until next idle admission without losing request. Active sharing restarts only via confirmed recovery. Polling/hidden setup stays passive. Permission operations invalidate catalog snapshots and refresh app/desktop status; identity grants no capabilities. Missing Settings entries offer Finder/add guidance.

Applying permissions confirms sharing will end, restarts only helper and probes the new process. Runtime, feature intent and user apps survive; old input channels never regain authority or replay. Settings navigation does not grant/revoke. Pause/removal follows [feature intent](host-applications.md#feature-access), not OS revocation.

Running applications includes externally launched regular and windowless processes. Requests bind bundle plus opaque path/PID/launch-time generation. Graceful quit cannot force-kill/retarget; acceptance is not exit evidence. Stale/unavailable retains sharing and errors. Failed viewer admission never rolls back sessions from stale catalogs.

## Windows
Registry distinguishes present/unknown/confirmed-empty AX inventories. Live processes wait indefinitely for first window; client release ends lease normally. Only confirmed destruction starts last-window grace. Surface replacement does not destroy AX lifetime: renew input generation and fence retired callbacks. Missing pixels cannot turn confirmed process exit into launch failure.

Exact terminals: application_exited is bound process exit, windows_closed is last shared window closure, sharing_stopped is detachment. Runtime shutdown releases capture/route/input without quitting; new Runtime rediscovers apps but needs explicit sharing. [Lifecycle acceptance](../operations/host-application-validation.md#input-cursor-and-lifecycle-acceptance) separates evidence from compatibility limits.

## Menus
Only explicit inspection reads bound AX menus. Structurally remove Apple/system/cross-app branches before handles, independent of titles/language. Keep literal app name as first group; no replacement menu. Empty/filtered/truncated containers are not leaves. Handles bind app/capture-or-wait generation and verified ancestry; only enabled current leaves execute. Removed/relocated/excluded/disabled/nonleaf/stale targets fail without pressing or disrupting capture. AX cannot describe every effect; local launch leaves OS menus untouched.

## Picture
Capture uses min(viewer DPR,native density,longest-edge limit); settings never resize apps or change permission/process/input identity. Software browser H.264 may decode VideoToolbox output. Encoder failure uses declared JPEG; decoder failure explicitly renegotiates image transport. Unchanged resize retains credit; acknowledge only decoded current-generation frames. Runtime/browser log connection-to-first-frame and first-decoded duration separately. FPS settings are ceilings, not achieved rates; capture/encoding/decode/network still constrain delivery. Capture failure preserves session recovery policy.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Reporter and persisted detail
ManagedOperationProgressDetail schema v2 alone owns detail. Duplicate command IDs get deterministic suffixes. Failed uninstall retains records/output for [reviewed recovery](service-management-recovery.md#management-recovery).

## Background ownership
The environment Shell owns submissions, operation streams and settlement refreshes. Views subscribe without owning execution; closing a drawer or replacing a page neither cancels work nor loses pending admission. Same-owner transport reconnection retains state; environment/authentication retirement fences late results. Streams recover through exact read-only operation/request lookup with bounded backoff, never POST replay or a fabricated timeout failure. Terminal state cannot regress. Private GET snapshots require Read and `private, no-store`; operation output stays memory-only.

## Service-row interaction
Page state keys disclosure by operation_id, never component/service-object identity. Rejected submissions retain local safe failure without backend operation or observed-state change. Compact status opens explicitly; failure labels/notices survive settlement and dismissal. Reduced motion removes animation, not readable completion hold.

## Install admission and handoff
Final install immediately closes the template drawer, clears collection filters and shows a request-owned row at the service's append position. This row is presentation only, never a fabricated ServiceView or persistent cache entry. A raw CreateResult binds its reviewed service ID to the real operation; slow collection refresh cannot hide operation details, cancellation or terminal outcome. Full ServiceView handoff preserves expansion and transfers focus only when the replaced row owned it. No management drawer or service window opens automatically.

A missing receipt proves no rejection. Accepted work uses existing lifecycle retry, not new creation. Fresh reviews remain permission-generation fenced; accepted work follows environment ownership. Unknown install receipts reconcile in the background. Earlier callbacks cannot close a replacement drawer.

## Execution panel
Published Floe planes, ink, LinearProgress, StableText and presence compose a connected rail and fixed-height panel. Narrow rail reveals its current step without scrolling the page. Open details show commands/output immediately in one scrolling transcript; no secondary disclosure. Logs/transfer/stage changes preserve neighboring geometry and existing output nodes. Preserve canonical interleaved output order; follow only while already at the end.

Restrained transitions retain progress identity. Reduced motion is static. Open is natively disabled during operations with its ordinary icon and keyboard/touch/hover action-stage tooltip.

## Release discovery

The background operation refreshes Registry metadata before runtime effects; changed/unavailable releases fail the accepted operation. npm verifies exact version, SHA-512 integrity and Node compatibility, enriches missing default integrity once and resolves the final runtime digest before launch. OCI validates tag plus pinned platform digest; explicitly reviewed digest-only verification persists `digest_verified` in ReleaseIdentity so a missing tag cannot silently change that choice on retry/restart. Later recommendations never retarget a saved install.

- Installed version opens the drawer; never auto-select the first result. Keep service/current-version header, restored candidates during refresh and one scrolling viewport. Notices stay below the list without shifting prior rows; footer links to outstanding confirmation.

start_script configures and runs foreground app; optional repeatable after_start_script shares startup deadline and cannot start another service. [Opening](managed-web-service-opening.md) owns recovery. Release upstream first; consume published module without copied assets/local wiring. [Catalog automation](../release/service-template-updates.md) owns discovery/checksum,not database migration.

Marketplace discovery, acquisition, browsing and qualification follow [the service template marketplace contract](service-template-marketplace.md).

## Instance source versions
`<managed-state>/template-sources/source_<opaque-id>/` retains original files. Registry schema 8 stores source-version metadata and per-instance bindings, not copied executable specifications. Updating the library does not update instances. New instances bind the accepted digest; retained originals survive restart and library updates. The v6-to-v7 migration marks historical bindings unverified and preserves user rows. Execution requires matching applied runtime evidence; passive settings permit explicit source repair without guessing missing history.

Settings expose current/available source versions. An explicit source review preserves instance overrides and installed application release, includes required notices, and binds the source digest to reconfiguration preflight. Applying requires a stopped instance. Source binding and configuration revision commit together; the existing journal carries old/target digests for container/Compose rollback and interrupted-operation recovery. Host hooks take effect on their next matching lifecycle action. Garbage collection protects current, bound and journal/active-operation source versions. Missing bindings or modified originals block execution. Hooks receive `REDEVEN_TEMPLATE_DIR` for the retained originals.

Personal derivation, immutable base retention and editor restrictions are defined in [personal service templates](personal-service-templates.md).

## Formats
Authors use redeven-service-template.json,kind:redeven.service-template,schema_version4,template_id,service_family_id,positive revision,default_locale/locales and complete display/execution declarations. Branded filename requires branded document. Supported source→input→effective matrix:
- template.json v1→TemplateSpec3→7.
- template.json v2→TemplateSpec4/5/6→7.
- branded v3→TemplateSpec6→7;v4→7→7.

Old syntax grants no privilege. SDK publishes types/schemas/acquisition,never execution/migration. Reading old directories/upgrading cannot rename files,rewrite scripts/locales,change modes/digest/commit or add normalized rows.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
- RuntimeBinding v2/SHA-256 binds Host paths, Container name or Compose project/root. [Opening](managed-web-service-opening.md) separates entrance failure from health.
- ServiceView actions/status/primary action own presentation; old errors cannot disable healthy instances. [Recovery](service-management-recovery.md#management-recovery) owns explicit actions.
- portforward_registry_v2 schema 8 preserves v1 lineage: template/configuration/release/binding/digest, workspace/resources, desired/observed state, protected Forward/artifact/failures; no executable template snapshots or duplicate deployment; Git source metadata, personal-template base references and per-instance digest bindings retain original directories. Schema 2 added ordinary-forward paths; managed open-session follows [session policy](web-service-browser-sessions.md#browser-sessions).

## Install admission
Preflight and Create inspect local template/input, notice, family, workspace and reviewed-plan contracts only. Create atomically persists service/forward/operation and returns 202 without Registry requests or Docker probes under the request lock. The operation begins at `release_validation`, verifies its persisted exact selection, then performs `environment_check` and runtime work. Failure/cancellation remains queryable before any workspace or runtime creation. GET `managed-web-services/install-requests/{request_id}` requires lifecycle permissions, is uncached and returns the durable receipt or null without executing work.

## Host release application
Update installs/verifies, resolves final installed metadata into one digest, replaces the process and health-checks before commit. Launch/journal/registry share the final digest; enriched trust creates no false pending changes. Originally stopped services return to stopped after verification. Failure retains rollback/recovery.

## Image pull feedback
Container pulls publish the executed command and ordered output through the existing operation reporter, including success, failure and cancellation. The reporter owns redaction and the 400-line/128-KiB output bound. Transfer rate derives from observed downloaded bytes over a short time window, retains the previous sample across sparse updates and decays when subsequent observations show no download. Layer completion is independent of byte progress.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Redeven owns personal definitions and their immutable base references; published upstream readers, formats and runtime policies remain authoritative. No new GitHub repository or format fork is required. Official/community detail actions expose **Create my template**. A remote selection passes through the same owner-scoped pinned source review, then naming, creation, and immediate editing in My templates. Accepted Git sources and personal templates support the same copy action. Cancellation releases the preview; environment changes fence the response without sending cleanup to another environment. Copies have independent template/family IDs and workspaces; they never copy instances, secrets or application data.

Registry migration v7-to-v8 adds a foreign-keyed personal-template base reference. Definition, retained source version, reference and request receipt commit atomically. Replay reads the receipt even after the review expires. Original files, executable modes, notices/translations, icons, access defaults and runtime-file identity survive source-library update/deletion, copying a copy and restart. User names/descriptions override original display translations. The custom spec remains editable while immutable auxiliary source files are verified on every load; external tampering fails closed. Garbage collection protects personal references until their final owner is deleted.

Interactive-desktop copies retain the exact audited runtime definition and capability. Only name/description are editable in their template editor, with a visible explanation and disabled runtime fields; instance settings remain the existing customization path. Edited images/scripts cannot inherit the reserved capability. Other Host, Container and Compose copies preserve undisplayed spec fields during form edits, including startup rules, multi-argument entrypoints and resource identities. concepts.title: Plugin background entries
concepts.summary: ReDevPlugin owns headless Worker lifecycle and durable intervals. A plugin may declare runtime_start, on_demand or interval. The first two use the platform background manager: starts are idempotent, scoped to the installed instance and environment, and independent of visible Activity or Workbench surfaces.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Interval requires background.method.v1 and background.interval.v1, an explicit method and parameters, an environment-scoped job Worker, synchronous execution, no confirmation or preflight, a 1,000–86,400,000 ms period, and a 1–300,000 ms execution budget not exceeding the period.

The platform persists and claims each due invocation before dispatch. One instance runs at most one interval invocation; separate plugins remain independent. The first run waits one period, then each next run follows completion plus the period. Missed periods coalesce. Restart preserves completed plans; an unfinished claim becomes unknown and is never replayed. A later period is new work, not proof of the earlier result. Disable, uninstall, package replacement and revocation fence and cancel exact current work. Host close drains execution before closing state. ReDevPlugin owns contiguous control-store migration and unknown-outcome handling.

Redeven's background policy snapshots the validated runtime LocalMax intersected with the Env App application cap, then applies the existing method-effect rules. It does not depend on an online session, borrow a user's cached authority, or apply a per-user override to an environment-owned job. Admin and unknown effects are denied. The platform separately verifies owner, installed package trust, current grants, revisions, runtime admission and the durable claim. This policy grants no filesystem, process, secret or network resource: adapters requiring a live user session continue to reject background access. Selected-file and connection approvals retain their existing lifetime and owner rules.

An explicit install/enable action authorizes the declared environment lifecycle through the ordinary product review and platform APIs. Permission removal blocks future dispatch without changing the user's enabled intent. The existing disable action stops work. No separate scheduling switch is introduced.

sections.title: Presentation
sections.body: Installation review shows the localized cadence for interval entries. Method identity, exact period and execution budget remain inside existing expandable technical details. Installed details consume the authoritative background_interval projection: scheduled, running, stopped or blocked, with next-run time only while scheduled. A prior failed or unknown result remains visible without a retry button that could replay effects. A previous background diagnostic cannot override current interval status; separate process diagnostics remain available. Refresh uses the existing owner-scoped inventory path.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: The platform owns durable plans, claims, authorization fencing, dispatch, cancellation, recovery and schema migration. Redeven owns only its product policy, localized review/status, and existing management controls. Business protocol state remains application-owned. See [Plugin platform integration](plugin-platform-integration.md), [Plugin process sessions](plugin-process-sessions.md), and [ReDevPlugin boundary](redevplugin-boundary.md).

concepts.title: Plugin market consumption
concepts.summary: Redeven consumes one complete public market representation. Official and community are display classifications, not admission privileges. Packages remain ordinary `.redevplugin` assets in GitHub Releases; every installation uses the released Host inspection and durable installation APIs.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
- Startup reads the validated local cache without waiting for the market. Refresh uses ordered pages, one generation, complete inspection-derived previews, and atomic last-known-good replacement. No client capability headers, compatibility variants, per-plugin latest fan-out, or incomplete-entry fallback exists.
- Discovery uses the `redevplugin` GitHub topic plus rechecks of already indexed repository identities. A fixed-commit `.redevplugin/index.json` selects ordinary packages in independent `<release-key>-v{version}` namespaces. No developer registration, plugin signatures, publisher trust, declaration approval, or separate third-party client path is required.
- GitHub publishers are generated as `github.repo.<numeric-repository-id>` and plugins as `<publisher-id>.<slug>`. Source manifests use `redevplugin.source.v1` with `plugin.slug`; raw index entries use `slug`. Neither contains numeric repository IDs or generated identity. Offline local development needs no Git repository. `build --release` resolves the actual source and compiles identity before bindings/build/hash, without mutating source or index; the market and Host independently check that source. Forks receive distinct IDs; rename/transfer retains the same repository identity. Local/upload/direct-URL declarations never acquire GitHub provenance.
- Ingest uses the released verifier and rechecks repository, release, tag commit, asset identity and bytes. Reject cross-repository plugin-ID takeover and same-version replacement. Failed scans retain the last valid projection. Market schema 11 retires old non-derived current listings while preserving ingest/audit history; it never renames package bytes or creates aliases.
- Market retains one release per plugin/channel and bounded verified presentation/icons. It never proxies packages or grants lifecycle authority. Unavailable listings constrain discovery without revoking installations.
- Inspection matches publisher/plugin/version, package/security/contract hashes and repository/release/asset identities. Both classifications share review and commit.
- Repository selection displays the returned short slug and submits the exact generated plugin ID. It never parses labels into identity; verified package presentation becomes authoritative during review.
- Installed presentation and permission requirements come from the installed package and Host-verified contracts. Newer market metadata cannot replace installed declarations or authorization facts.

## Network behavior

Market and package requests use the product network adapter, current environment/system proxy policy, and OS DNS/VPN routing. Startup stays cache-only. Singleflight, bounded backoff, jitter, cancellation, and generation reconciliation avoid request storms. Network failures cannot remove installed state or block ordinary Runtime startup. The service closes only transports it owns.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Ownership and isolation
Every session binds plugin instance, user scope, environment scope, plugin invocation/session, and client key. Start requests contain an executable and argv array; ReDevPlugin never parses an implicit shell command string.

Secret references are resolved by the Host adapter and values do not cross the UI, error, audit, or diagnostic projections.

For one owner and client key, ReDevPlugin reuses only a field-equal launch request. It snapshots argument and environment collections before starting; later caller mutations cannot redefine an in-flight or running launch. Changed launch fields return a launch-conflict error. Redeven delegates this decision to the platform.

## Streams and lifecycle
The first contract supports non-PTY stdin, stdout, and stderr only. Each output stream has an independent cursor and bounded ring buffer.

The platform removes the session after close and prevents access after owner revocation.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Ownership
Published schedule/agent.work own cadence, claims and capability contracts; Redeven owns workflow admission, business context, review and canonical Flower adapters ([workflows](automation-workflows.md)). StateDir/apps/plugins/platform follows [storage](storage-ownership.md) offline relocation/admission rules.

Upstream owns validation, hashing/identity, registry/inspection, permission/confirmation, tokens/assets, sandbox/bridge, settings/intents, executions/events, storage/network/secrets, IPC/WASM/supervision, quotas/revocation, control state and releases. Manifests/tests pin the coordinated release; frontend cannot independently downgrade. Bootstrap credentials stay bounded before readiness. [Packages](redevplugin-package-lifecycle.md) owns admission/cache; [adapters](redevplugin-redeven-adapters.md) owns product placement/display.

## Availability and network
Plugin failures stay local and preserve ordinary sessions, files, terminal, Notes and Workbench. PLUGIN_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE executes nothing; rejected writes report not_committed. Unreadable inventory is not empty. Initialization has a 10-second budget, cancellation fences late results/closes integration, and errors/panics unwind without hiding host cancellation. Incompatible opaque state remains unchanged.

Released single-hop transports honor explicit proxy, macOS proxy/PAC, OS DNS/VPN for market/package/release. Private/synthetic addresses alone are not denial. Upstream validates URL/redirect/origin/size/cancellation/hash; downloads grant no execution. Platform checks target/method/grant/revision, quotas and revocation; private prefixes, literals and other protocols retain address-bound rules. Resolve configuration at request time. Granted HTTPS hostname connectors without private-prefix binding use the released factory.

Current admission requires Web v9. Retained data stays upstream-owned; unknown/corrupt roots fail unchanged. Product mounts origins/handlers, never interprets declarations, translates DOM/VNodes, rewrites packages or supplies ambient parent credentials.

## Runtime build and Web communication
Prepare complete Rust/C/archiver/link tools before exact published-source builds. [Build tooling](../operations/redevplugin-cross-build.md) owns pinned Zig, real probes, cache identity, cancellation and Desktop acceptance. Upstream owns containment and semantics: one actor/job path, fresh invocation state, bounded compiled-module reuse, finite fuel and signed deadlines. Immutable manifest caches never replace permission/revocation checks. Cold preparation and warm latency remain distinct.

Pure Web uses the released browser sandbox without Worker forwarding. Defaults declare no unused methods/intents; resource templates retain required declarations. No Surface methods means no receiver polling; removing the last drains claimed calls/cancellation before stopping. Opening/authority/resource/business traffic remain separate. Each simultaneous container has a distinct slot/frame/origin. Zero receiver requests proves neither zero network nor latency; qualify private resources, sibling closure and fresh authority through real SDK/product routes.

## Authoring and execution
Platform owns config/manifest validation, bindings, build/test/package, diagnostics/watch, persistent previews, update candidates, connection review and dev runtime. Product owns intent, placement, review/install approval and release proof; version-derived skills invoke published CLI. Authoring grants no execution permission.

Use authoring.WorkspaceStore and isolated authoring.Environment. Retain only opaque workspace/artifact/inspection/install-request/instance references. Upstream owns initialization, immutable artifacts, build reports, preview Host state, exact inspection and durable committed/unknown/not-committed outcomes. Status-read failure never means absence or permits a new install identity. Preview and installed stores/grants are separate; deleting drafts preserves installed plugins.

Admission/execution resolve cwd from current owner-bound SourceScope, never retained paths. Idempotent recovery preserves request evidence and uses that same source. Missing source fails before admission as PLUGIN_WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE, without fallback or widening. Authenticated draft source access still uses Flower approval. Admitted reads/builds use released user/environment ownership, live tool policy and user/application caps rather than browser-channel lifetime; no Host session is minted. Preview/install require a fresh channel; disconnected builds retain artifacts for later review. Preview success alone does not qualify continued authoring.

Platform author locks are atomically close-on-exec: child terminals/services must not retain them after Runtime shutdown. Never delete state or bypass locks to recover. desktop/scripts/check-plugin-author-restart.mjs verifies a real restart with a surviving terminal child and the same draft. Preview refresh preserves selected actions/JSON drafts and single-flight work; unknown effects require review. Project-relative tools resolve from project cwd through published CLI.

Released direct Surface KV/SQLite/files/settings need no Worker forwarding. Dedicated-origin binary/WebSocket handlers require exact handshakes; Host checks session ceilings/scope/grants/quotas/revocation. Product only mounts/presents. Conflict/unknown cannot replay; coalesced watches are not logs. Private-file migration remains upstream and separate from author/control schemas; snapshots/recovery stay opaque. Trusted parent query/event/cancel binds exact current gateway/plugin scope through authenticated handlers; malformed/stale/plugin-origin calls cannot widen to management. Read-only ceilings precede process effects; compiled SQL excludes host paths and bounds values/complexity/concurrency.

## Visual review and distribution
Opt-in context menus are upstream capability: bounded hints/normalized geometry, validated source/port/frame/handle/sequence. Product owns annotations, artifact binding, comments and Flower submission. Metadata is untrusted context, never permission, parent DOM access or another dispatcher.

Ordinary plugins need no publisher trust, signature, registration or manual admission. Official/community is display-only. Upstream derives GitHub identity; product validates market evidence then delegates independent inspection. Authors provide only plugin.slug/index slug; local work needs no GitHub. Published build --release compiles repository identity before bindings/build/hash without rewriting inputs. Local/upload identities cannot claim GitHub provenance. Every source needs exact inspection/consent/receipts and independent permissions. Product updates use current authenticated sessions/upstream eligibility, not a second install state machine. Signed platform releases, product identity and runtime leases remain separate protections.

concepts.summary: ReDevPlugin owns package inspection, installation, source identity, durable receipts, runtime readiness and retained data.
