## Input, cursor and lifecycle acceptance
Require app receipts/exact saved bytes, not dispatch/DOM focus. REDEVEN_TEST_DESKTOP_COMPONENT_STATE selects owned published combined resources. Missing CJK/emoji fonts neither invalidate bytes nor qualify glyphs. TestInstalledDesktopApplicationTransport covers input/save, invalid clipboard canceling dependent input, manager recreation/same helper, read-only rejection and live first-window waits beyond40s.

Published Native/Floe maps Linux seat keys, confirms Unicode for other layouts and orders clipboard before paste. Never paste stale selections, replay text or release composition after scroll. macOS retains native authority. Shared canvas changes need first-frame/toolbar/reconnect/stale-target and real input tests. Physical pointers require physical observation; synthetic touch/composition proves no OS candidates, keyboard or pinch.

Fixtures independently establish:
- Mac single-instance reuse survives lease release;48s first-window wait does not relaunch. Picker counts/literal titles preserve focus. Canceled close/quit preserves app/pixels/sharing/retry.
- Unreadable/replaced surfaces do not expire into closure; confirmed last-window closure ends viewers. Linux dialog-only apps show native-size decoded dialogs.
- Stale quit rejects the whole set before termination; unknown retains error without inferred exit/retry. Read-only lists cannot quit/detach.
- Reload/network preserves process, suspends input/capture and frees buffers before same-session/current-credential reconnect. Successors revoke old input/release held keys/suspend capture.
- Permission/lock recovery is distinct. Helper failure is sharing failure, not app exit: retire route/credential/buffers/helper before terminal state; fence callbacks and preserve unknown pages.
- Unknown foreground/window rejects without replay/retarget. Missing decoder negotiates images from the same process.

Toolbar has fixed bar/resizable content,320/390/1000px popovers, keyboard menus, separate close/confirmed quit and late-dismissal fencing. Native quit covers windowless/visible apps, cancellation and stale generations. Run pnpm --dir internal/envapp/ui_src test:host-application-browser for three-engine pointer/appearance. concepts.title: ReDevPlugin target build toolchain
concepts.summary: Redeven prepares target C compilation and archiving alongside Rust before building the exact published ReDevPlugin source crate. macOS builds Linux static PIE with pinned Zig and the existing Rust LLD wrapper. `scripts/redevplugin_build_toolchain.json` pins Rust 1.98.0, Zig 0.16.0, official archive checksums and build-input files.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
The unified preparer selects the actual builder and requested target, prepares Rust, downloads Zig only when missing with HTTPS/checksum/bounded retries, then compiles C, archives it, links it into a Rust program and validates the resulting executable. Darwin native uses Apple tools; Linux native uses its C compiler and static libraries. A failed probe prevents costly package compilation.

macOS maps Linux amd64/arm64 to x86_64/aarch64 musl. Target-specific cc-rs CC/AR settings use private wrappers; the CC wrapper removes only the exact Rust triple injected by cc-rs, supplies Zig's target, PIC and disables Zig's implicit undefined-behavior instrumentation. Rust LLD remains responsible for static PIE; existing ELF architecture, interpreter and dynamic dependency rejection stay authoritative. No ambient target GCC or installed PATH Zig is assumed.

Desktop preflights before copying source or building UI/Go. Staging independently invokes the same owner. Development Cargo identity binds exact published crate digest, compiler versions, Zig archive/binary, target flags, wrapper and validation inputs. Desktop package-cache v2 binds host, target, input inventory, release manifest and source identity; older disposable entries rebuild. `REDEVEN_REDEVPLUGIN_TOOLCHAIN_CACHE` selects an absolute tool cache; `REDEVEN_TOOLCHAIN_OFFLINE=1` requires cached tools. Rust's narrower offline setting remains available.

Release-cache pruning recognizes only the namespaces generated by the release-source cache-key owner. It never descends into sibling toolchain, Cargo, source-package, plugin-manifest or unknown cache namespaces, in either startup or package-preparation mode. Toolchain preparation owns its temporary download, extraction and probe directories and removes them on completion or cancellation. This prevents another package request from unlinking an active Zig download or compiler input; disabling release temporary-file cleanup alone does not provide that protection.

Preparation distinguishes unavailable tools/cache, network acquisition, source compilation and artifact validation. Shipped locales provide the concise summaries; diagnostics retain original output. Compiler errors never trigger a network retry. Cancellation/timeout terminates the task-owned command group, escalates after two seconds, waits for close and cleans temporary state. Target replacement begins only after a complete package is prepared. Helper/package uploads use the existing bounded transfer budget rather than the short command budget. Checksums, signed release consumption, SBOM, provenance and product signing remain required.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Redeven owns compiler preparation, target packaging, cache isolation and product signing. Published ReDevPlugin owns execution, containment and Worker contracts; cross-compilation cannot qualify an upstream runtime defect. Native target execution and the production Desktop update path require separate acceptance; architecture emulation and main-process harnesses do not certify native containment or GUI interaction.

## Published preparation

C01 is historical counterevidence. C02 receipt batching has no production benefit; C03 exhausted-window timer is rejected. C04 supports optional Linux six-frame throughput, not parity, recovery or causality. Git retains older procedures; C05 owns current outcomes.

## Comparison criteria
Official baseline: RustDesk `1.5.0`, source `fada664df7a294d1d1a9ca3e7cd3637069122f17`. Three paired alternating rounds retain physical output, resolution, refresh, content viewport and delivered detail quality, with one measured Viewer at a time.

concepts.title: Gateway v6 independent device protocol
concepts.summary: Gateway v6, authority epoch 70, defines independent client-device trust and Runtime attachments. Cloud machine management and publication are absent. Client public routes are pairing/challenge, pairing/complete, identity, catalog, access/open and access/service under /gateway/v6.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Identities and wire fields
The stable gateway_id is independent of Desktop connection_id. RuntimeAttachment uses attachment_id and attachment_version. Catalogs contain attachments; Gateway metadata contains endpoints and tls_root_pem shared by clients and Runtimes. Device identities are not user memberships. Internal package/file names do not add a Cloud or user authority.

Runtime-owned routes use /v6/attachment for invitation-exchange, join, cancel-join, update-endpoints, rotate, leave and connect. Current attachment certificate/version and signed Runtime service identity are required.

Host-only routes issue invitations/client codes, list/revoke devices, update addresses/network/egress policy, remove or reevaluate attachments and query operation results. They are not registered on the public listener. ManageAttachments and ManageNetwork are request capabilities from verified host context, never device roles. Host proof grants both together; network settings, shared endpoint edits and attachment egress reevaluation consistently check ManageNetwork. Client trust administration requires current private host proof. OpenAPI declares each route surface explicitly. This alignment changes no route or signed payload, so protocol v6, epoch 70 and attachment schema 6 remain unchanged. Trust schema 4 retires historical host classification without replacing identities. Private host authentication is independent of device access; supplied signatures must still verify and address proofs retain their requested binding audience.

## Freshness and state
Runtime metadata versions do not gate attachment admission. Wire/authority mismatches fail explicitly; no old protocol translator or Cloud fallback is installed. Schema 6 attachment state rejects unsupported input unchanged. Expected attachment and policy versions fence relevant mutations; operation IDs recover known results and preserve uncertainty.

The focused plugin gate covers:

- Host construction, authenticated owner/session mapping, direct authorization,   explicit origin/CSRF/action policy, and stable observability; - market release install/update and exact publisher/plugin/instance identity,   market preview digests, stable progress, and no duplicate package parser; - public HTTPS URL, GitHub Release, and local `.redevplugin`   inspect-confirm-install admission, process-local TTL inspection identity,   strict source provenance, exact owner/session/bytes/hash revalidation,   enabled install state with no implicit grants, permission-attention handling   for missing access, and no durable receipt/query lifecycle; - runtime path/target/hash, ProcessManager health, persistent lease replay, and   Host storage/network/Event services; - canonical AppServer route reservation/delegation and Local UI access checks; - generated UI lifecycle DTOs, management revisions, production Plugin entry,   generic permission requirements, exact inventory-key selection, full external   security and source-provenance review, exact generic permission ids, FIFO   confirmation, and close-before-placement lifecycle; - Shell-root multi-window Activity chrome, standard `redeven.plugin` Workbench   persistence, released interaction ownership, exact-surface close   reconciliation, and cross-placement serialization; - static absence of legacy proxy/bootstrap/base64 package and copied platform   paths.

Mock containers do not satisfy this check.

## Native retained-state qualification

`desktop/scripts/check-plugin-storage-recovery.mjs` requires an explicit verified Desktop bundle. Published owner APIs seed an isolated legacy installation and author workspace. The native lane reproduces unavailable admission, stops the isolated Runtime, relocates opaque bytes, verifies exact package/instance retention, executes a real WASM worker through the dedicated-origin sandbox, commits an inspected update and repeats execution after restart. Creation history remains reachable over the live plugin window. Its report records bundle identity, assertions and owned-process cleanup. A passed synthetic seed does not certify an arbitrary user profile: inspect its actual relocation inputs, including dependency links and conflicting targets. Never report that profile recovered without applying and verifying its supported transaction.

The existing author-restart lane separately verifies composer/draft continuity and retained terminal state. On failure it preserves the visible readiness diagnostics and isolated Runtime stderr before owned cleanup, so a hidden composer cannot be mistaken for lost draft data. Both lanes are explicit acceptance, not additions to the pre-push gate.

## Publication
Use go.mod/Env lock coordinated version. Boundary scan rejects sibling/Go workspace/replace/npm links/copied runtimes-contracts/Rust paths/duplicate platform-core, excluding generated/dependency output and failing on scan errors. Exhaustion deletes partials and stops before Rust with release-specific error. Validation never retries. --manifest-file validates identically offline. Node CLI emits validation evidence on canonical/symlink paths; empty success invalid.

## Native artifacts
Build Linux/Darwin amd64/arm64 from exact published crate/packaged lock/Rust1.98.0; no alternative first-party paths. Check target/tools first. Warm caches avoid servers. Transient install retry default3/max5; integrity/signature/manifest stop. REDEVEN_RUSTUP_OFFLINE=1 restricts Rustup cache, not manifest/Cargo validation. Honor Cargo/Rustup/proxies; no probe auto-install/TLS weakening. Recheck installs, preserve exact Cargo. Download120s/backoff2,4s cap60s; cancel stops/cleans diagnostics.

Linux static PIE has no interpreter/dynamic deps. Darwin exact native64-bit Mach-O receives Developer ID/hardening/timestamp before evidence; dev ad-hoc. The runtime alone carries exactly com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory=true for Wasmtime executable pages. Keep hardened runtime and library validation; do not grant the exception to Desktop shell or plugin documents. Staging and macOS consumption verify the signed entitlement dictionary and hardened flag, not just the source plist. Development Cargo cache identity includes signing profile and verifier bytes. Emit binary/SPDX/resolved provenance/notices/signature/certificate. Release Sigstore binds tag workflow; ephemeral Ed25519 fails --require-release. Cosign3 flags --new-bundle-format=false/--use-signing-config=false retain workflow/OIDC/transparency checks.

redeven.redevplugin_runtime_build.v1 binds publication/product files/target/tools/source/workflow/signer. Consumption rechecks descriptor/target/profile/signature. Startup uses expected marker digest, never self-hashed trust. Runtime archive exactly Redeven/ReDevPlugin runtime/six evidence files/license/notices.

## Desktop/collector
Before .bundle/<target> replacement validate name/closed flat inventory/Go target/native policy. Gateway separate; full evidence beside Redeven. macOS exclusion matches only independently signed runtime; preserve its bytes/evidence while Redeven/Computer/Sparkle/bridge remain signable. After Electron assembly copy full Computer resources/licenses. Validate startup before signing and after refreshing only signer-visited Runtime/Computer descriptors, just before outer seal.

Inspect final DEB/RPM/read-only DMG; emit v2 installer-bound runtime/six-file receipts. Upload installers/receipts/latest-linux*.yml only. Apple tools/system text suffice without rg; consume full pipefail pipelines. Require Team/signature/hardening/updater key/staple/distribution; Sparkle lipo places binary before -verify_arch. Linux relink source/object archives separate. Derive epoch/windows from reviewed contract, normalize feeds before signed inventory.

DEB: POSIX ustar/GNU regular files/directories,bounded long names,metadata-only root. RPM disables build-id symlinks. Bounded no-follow snapshots reject noncanonical/duplicate paths, links/devices,privileged modes,sparse/PAX,malformed trailers/trailing bytes/oversize.

sections.body:
## Trust and acquisition
Initial HTTPS bootstrap's reviewed fixed digest authenticates installer. Upstream Cosign Blob API verifies exact repository/workflow/OIDC/tag using authenticated TUF roots/certificate transparency/Rekor. Only detached.sig and PEM/base64PEM; no format guessing/trust overrides/bypass/fake markers. Failures never execute Runtime.

TUF requests are bounded/cancellable, without user trust cache. Bound log replies before SDK parsing; admit only detached X.509 hashedrekord/0.0.1, rejecting OpenPGP/other types before generic parser. Crypto receives unchanged bytes.

Default resolves GitHub latest, exact version overrides. Explicit managed channel uses public manifest/GitHub-first acquisition; self-upgrade environment semantics remain. Automatic resolution cannot downgrade known version; explicit rollback can.

## Activation transaction
No-follow nonblocking root lock and closed bounded archive reject links/duplicates/traversal/missing-extra members/trailers/changed bytes. Published artifact-cache owns verified acquisition.

Stage complete .redeven-runtime-suites/<archive-sha256>, sync/read back inventory/digests/version, prepare pinned ripgrep before atomic symlink switch. Linux uses musl ripgrep15.2.0 both architectures. New/reused binaries must execute/report exact version; loader/timeout/version/output failures preserve old activation. Detect concurrent change; restore/verify old entry after post-switch failure. Distinguish unchanged from committed-unconfirmed.

Keep published suites/legacy flat resources for live old processes; deletion needs explicit unused/rollback assessment, with disk growth disclosed. Fresh install uses writable user directory, no sudo. Idempotent bash/zsh/fish PATH blocks affect future shells; print current-shell/direct-path guidance. Upgrade edits no profile and starts no service; Runtime owns maintenance/re-exec.

## Publication and promotion
Since0.13.13 signed redeven-installer-contract.json declares minimum installer/closed targets/archive; older installers stop before incompatible acquisition. One template renders GitHub/Portal using four actual pins, signed aggregate checksums. Portal uses official mirror fallback, not another implementation.

Publish --latest=false. Before promotion, check-distribution authenticates inventory/contract and full bootstrap digest/tag/channel/four pins independently of default. After promotion, --check-active-entry requires GitHub byte equality; Portal validates its active bootstrap's own signed release/candidate minimum, allowing older recommended Runtime. Independently read default back. README selects generated GitHub bootstrap; Portal UI/endpoint redirect to generated channel entry, without signature authority. Missing/placeholder assets cannot activate. Deployment is explicit. Rollback uses compatible immutable signed releases, never obsolete external-tool installers/duplicate shell logic. Historical/native/page qualification stays explicit outside push gates.

## Dependency security
Use verified published Cosign/Rekor, go-jose>=4.1.6 and released gRPC1.83.1 fixes; preserve identity/signing time/roots/transparency. Qualify official releases/tamper/cross-tag denial. No imported legacy golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp path; the general SDK's distinct deprecated OpenPGP implementation remains reported as GO-2026-5932. Reject those formats before SDK parsing. Nonzero symbol scans are not clean audits; no blanket suppression or removal of boundary without upstream replacement review/fixtures.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Network exposure
### HTTPS certificate ownership
[Certificates](#certificates) owns explicit creation/import/replacement/removal/validation/trust. Startup never creates/repairs identity or falls back to HTTP. Replacement is next-start; running TLS/sessions remain.

### Listener and origin boundary
Accept only canonical authorities derived from actual bound addresses. HTTP loopback routes exact current parent/port-derived plugin child origins exclusively to released Web resource handler, stripping parent credentials and excluding management. Removed parent/different port/network-only/HTTPS cannot use that route. Platform still verifies asset session/origin/ticket/lifetime. flowersec-private-loopback/1 never grants public access.

### Native Desktop default-port recovery
Only native launch with saved localhost:23998 and no explicit one-start bind may opt into --local-ui-default-port-fallback. Custom/numeric/network/wildcard overrides and other errors cannot change ports silently. Old bookmarks do not follow temporary ports.

### Network changes and current reports
Enabled exposure refreshes eligible interfaces every2s with explicit list, including empty. Private endpoints cannot fill absent public addresses. Failures affect availability, not process status, and never expose private management URLs.

### Admission and lifecycle
Network listeners require concrete nonloopback or wildcard, fixed nonzero port and effective password. Occupied explicit ports fail. Flowersec owns admission/session/liveness/dispatch/close/lease loops; no copied host lifecycle.

### Server-owned access configuration
[Two-factor](runtime-two-factor-authentication.md) owns credential authority, verifier migration, TOTP/recovery/replay/revocation. Password change is next-start only when MFA disabled; enabled MFA blocks clearing/replacement and HTTPS downgrade. Catalog-save failure rolls back verifier initialization/replacement/clearing.

## Certificates
### Identity and trust
User explicitly runs local-authority device-ca generate/status. Public export contains certificates, never keys; startup never generates/replaces/repairs them.

### Explicit certificate changes
import/regenerate/remove require --confirm. Reject malformed/extraneous PEM/trailing text/encrypted or mismatched keys/dates/chains/missing SAN/server-auth failures. Process-interruption recovery promises neither OS trust rollback nor power-loss durability.

### Coverage during network changes
Two-second refresh atomically publishes public snapshots. Startup and explicit saved-identity preflight remain strict.

### Desktop interaction and private input
Compact panel separates validity/expiry/system trust; paths/fingerprint/bounded selectable diagnostics are expandable. Saving unusable next-start identity remains possible with explicit startup warning.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Sessions and permissions
process.local is an explicit high-risk grant, rechecked by method on every Worker Process Broker call. Hosts inherit neither the complete Redeven environment nor session cookies/plugin tokens/credentials. [Process sessions](../architecture/plugin-process-sessions.md) owns lifecycle.

No guessed owner sweeps or local teardown registries.

Resolve method effects before local policy clamps; shared runtime management stays admin-only. Plugin Center reads grants and explicit policies via released APIs, never registry writes/default catalog grants. Catalog identity is not permission. Official/community classifies repository origin for display only.

## Package and network admission
Install/update validates source policy, publisher/plugin/version, exact package hashes and Host capability contracts. Plugin signatures, trusted-publisher admission and release references are absent. Reject malformed content, fabricated provenance, owner/scope mismatch, unapproved source changes and same-version content replacement. Explicit consent and durable request receipts bind installation; permissions and runtime revocation remain independent.

VPN/proxy/enterprise DNS is routing, not evidence of malice. Package downloads retain source/redirect/integrity checks through normal host routing. Authorized HTTPS connectors use released transport after grants; routing grants no extra destinations/methods, private-prefix bypass or ambient credentials. Proxy discovery/timeouts/TLS failures reject only their operation. Construction performs no discovery; plugin readiness cannot gate core Runtime. Keep TLS validation; proxy credentials stay on that hop. Never retry writes with unknown outcomes.

## Confirmation and runtime trust
Validate capability preflight against the Host-known response schema before confirmation. Reserved redevplugin.capability.risk_plan.* values must satisfy strict v1: reject unknown/malformed reserved versions without generic fallback. Replacement/replay needs new confirmation.

Descriptors bind version/target/IPC/WASM ABI/artifact hash. Darwin Developer ID signing precedes product digest/Sigstore evidence; Desktop signing preserves those nested bytes. Startup cannot trust a digest computed from its own field binary.

Business adapters run only after platform lifecycle/permission/confirmation/lease/quota/revocation/audit resolution. Never expose raw errors, tokens/secrets/cookies/query strings/absolute paths/full URLs in public or durable diagnostics.

## Web isolation
Plugin documents use distinct product origins and the published surface handler. Local UI/AppServer strip parent auth before delegation. Desktop binds private bridge credentials to actual frame origin. Frame-less workers instead require Electron's initiator origin in the owning Runtime partition, matching the exact private origin; missing/opaque origins fail. Present frames remain authoritative. Workers inherit no frame-only host-access/Tessiven claims. Center binds child routes to authenticated parents and cancels preparation on revocation; Gateway checks expected namespace/target.

Plugin DOM/rendering freedom grants no product-session/filesystem/process/credential/management authority. Released platform owns asset sessions/bridge/permissions/revocation.

Main-process session.fetch also enters Electron's hook. Contextless other requests retain authorization only with exactly one already-present matching private bridge token from the owning Runtime session and no frame/WebContents/initiator. Missing provenance grants nothing; destination must still be the exact private origin. Renderer/worker provenance remains authoritative; never inherit frame-only claims.

## Session authority and lifetime
The gate alone decides channel authorization when registering the channel and its lifetime cancellation callback under one lock. Callers supply verified private-management identity or an ordinary login session ID, never an `unlocked` assertion.

Runtime restart clears in-memory sessions and incomplete operations; it preserves committed authentication state.

Protected Terminal catalog loading consumes this readiness, never transport connectivity alone. Local transport retains its Runtime-authorized channel admission contract.

Local UI alone issues, reads and clears `redeven_local_access_<http|https>_<port>`. Forwarded headers cannot select the scope.

Only an incorrect password or factor produces input validation feedback; transport failures and cooldowns retain their own messages.

## Desktop consumption and forwarding
Desktop Flower retains the complete Runtime-issued access-cookie `name=value` pair and returns it unchanged. It never derives the name from a bridge or forwarded client port.

No upstream platform capability changes are required for this product authentication policy.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Enrollment and management
Desktop Environment Settings / Access presents one two-factor row. If a different environment password has been saved for the next start, restart before configuring MFA; the old running verifier cannot overwrite the newer saved authority.

## Session authority
[Runtime access sessions](runtime-access-sessions.md) owns ordinary session deadlines, browser Cookie scope and refresh continuity, challenge binding, native editor delegation, and revocation. MFA management changes revoke ordinary authority through that single gate; they do not create a second browser or Desktop authentication lifecycle.

## Persistence, replay and recovery
`access-auth.sqlite` is a versioned, private SQLite authority, separate from the transport authorization database. The committed database and initialized key become the sole authority; deletion, malformed data, unsafe modes, symlinks, unknown schema, or key loss cannot fall back to the retired verifier.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Setup/storage
Owner redeven-center setup --state-root issues a mandatory15-minute credential. Password/verified TOTP/recovery-code confirmation commit atomically; partial setup grants nothing. Passwords:12–72 UTF-8 bytes; recovery codes replace only factor.

Unsupported peer checks fail.

Back up key/database together. DTOs omit secrets/private keys; only owner commands print temporary credentials. Audit keeps closed sensitive-action categories, never payload/credential-derived digest. Expiring challenges/grants alone bind exact actions; bcrypt verifies passwords. Schema2 atomically redacts v1 audit refs before readiness, preserving events/unrelated state; damaged/future stores stay unchanged.

## Authentication
Password creates a five-minute browser/action/session/revision challenge, <=five factor failures; password alone grants nothing. Atomic TOTP-step/recovery consumption survives restart. Login rotates device/browser sessions; security changes revoke sessions/challenges/grants/connections.

Limit16 devices, one-hour idle/twelve-hour absolute sessions. Only trusted visible input renews idle, never frozen pages/output/polls/heartbeat. Revocation preserves other devices; restart invalidates sessions but retains credentials/directory/audit.

Sensitive changes need fresh password/factor and ten-minute action/target/payload/revision grants. Password-change bindings use PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256,600000 iterations/32 bytes, domain-separated random login-device-ID salt, mirrored in Web Crypto; no raw-password SHA256. Recheck expiry/revision/session after derivation. Bounded same-session/request receipts prevent repeated effects. Viewing/opening valid sessions needs no extra MFA.

## Admission
Bound auth concurrency and persist administrator/direct-peer budgets through restart. Failures back off/expire, never permanently lock. Forwarded headers cannot select identity. Revocation/recovery cancels catalog/pairing; limits2/device/source,8/device,32 global preserve logout/other sources.

Limits:16 Gateways,128 routes,128 receipts (<=32/device),16 live root/child operations/device; concurrent proxy16/access-owner,48/device,192 total. Reopening cannot monopolize receipts. Revoke live admission immediately; five-minute tombstones retain outcomes. Bound JSON/headers, stream files, restrict egress to signed approved endpoints.

Child reopen makes fresh browser handoff and reuses authority only for exact parent/resource-kind/ID/Runtime-instance/login-cookie-name/value; paths may vary within resource. Cancel/expire repeated handoff preserves existing owner; owner revoke invalidates pending reuse. Reuse consumes bounded receipts and cannot bypass resource limits.

Runtime accessgate owns login/channels. Binding/revision/device scope prevents cross-route/device replay; children add resource scope. Binding revoke fences admission/channels, not unrelated paths. Children cannot invoke Env APIs, spend sibling artifacts or set parent cookies. Changed proofs fail without downgrade. Deny portal framing; child framing follows Runtime.

concepts.title: Adaptive desktop and mobile navigation
concepts.summary: Desktop and mobile remain distinct interaction modes; narrow desktop regions use temporary drawers without rewriting saved placement. Files/Git navigation begins with its mode switch, without a separate Files title row or reserved header space. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Desktop adaptation
### One interaction mode
Desktop Welcome and Desktop-hosted Env App configure `mobileQuery: 'not all'`; the Env App recognizes its native host through the existing Desktop bridge.

Resizing a desktop browser cannot rewrite its saved Activity/Workbench choice or activate mobile terminal input.

A hidden toolbar action must retain an explicit reachable entry.

### Temporary desktop navigation
Shell, Flower conversations, Files/Git navigation, and Terminal sessions measure their own shared navigation/content region. When that region cannot fit the current sidebar width plus 480 CSS pixels of main content, the sidebar becomes a transient left side drawer.

The mobile close action shares that row; desktop drawers retain their accessible dialog title and dismissal. Sidebar resizing and local tree scrolling remain available.

File filtering and entering or leaving idle path editing never add header feedback or change toolbar height. The shared bottom status bar owns the filtered item count and view indicator. Path editing keeps Enter submission, Escape cancellation, and blur cancellation without an instruction row; pending navigation and errors retain their accessible header feedback.

Mobile navigation retains its product-specific bottom/side panel behavior under the [mobile Shell](#mobile-shell) and [Flower](#mobile-flower) contracts.

## Mobile Shell
### Persistent navigation and tools
The existing ordered page tabs remain horizontally scrollable.

Download counts and failure attention derive from the same download manager used on desktop. A newer panel request cancels an outgoing handoff.

### Panel boundary and dismissal
One transient requested state selects closed, plugins, More, or a tools subpage.

No drag, snap, or persisted geometry is owned by the product.

## Mobile Flower
The bottom Flower tab enters Flower and opens its conversation drawer.

Background summaries cannot open or close the drawer.

A later focus choice, especially returning to the composer, wins; restoration must not reclaim focus, scroll the page, or interrupt the keyboard session.

sections.title: Boundaries

### Flower welcome
Desktop Flower retains its mark, title, introduction, working directory, four complete starter suggestions, and keyboard hints even when the chat region is 767 CSS pixels or narrower. Container queries adjust spacing and the suggestion grid; they cannot hide content or switch interaction mode.

Narrow layouts may ellipsize selection titles; explanations remain normal prose and mobile suggestion cards retain their compact presentation.

The shared local dialog has no global aria-modal claim. Initial focus goes to a close button, never search.

Desktop transitions close mobile navigation and restore the framework toolbar without recreating the active business page.

The [Activity companion](flower-activity-companion.md#companion) owns product placement. The shared [floating boundary](env-app-floating-layer-order.md) owns visible viewport geometry and safe areas.

Custom headers and title JSX must not recreate the removed explanatory subtitle.

The Env Settings header contains category navigation and close in one row, using the same background as navigation and content. Env Settings permits backdrop dismissal through Floe's topmost-modal behavior and its existing retained close path. Generic read refresh belongs there only for categories using that owner; domain resource refresh belongs beside its selector. A category root never uses Back as a disguised close action. Embedded settings supply section content and one category scroll owner; standalone page wrappers and nested navigation rails must not be copied into the modal. See [runtime settings](runtime-settings.md) for the exact feature boundary.

The category title appears in the header only; body headings distinguish actual subgroups. Embedded page sections use Floe's public heading visibility API while retaining accessible identity and meaningful metadata/actions. Do not hide headings through broad CSS rules or replace them with empty toolbar spacing.

This contract changes no application connection, process, or window lifecycle.

## Header-safe bounds

The shared Redeven stylesheet applies the larger of the native
Desktop titlebar and Floe's visible shell top bar plus its top safe inset, followed
by the published presentation gap. Floe owns the visible viewport, keyboard
response, remaining safe edges, panel maximum height, focus and dismissal. The
single product top-padding override is intentional because the published Dialog
sets that padding inline. Do not reintroduce per-dialog viewport subtraction or
minimum heights that can overflow short windows.

The shell header contract is Floe's `h-10` content plus its one-pixel border. A
headerless mobile shell adds no phantom header; inactive KeepAlive views do not
count as visible headers. Surface-local dialogs and Workbench window confirmations
stay within their existing host below the shell header without subtracting it a
second time. Side drawers keep their edge-attached presentation.

Headers, close controls and footer actions remain reachable while long content
scrolls inside the body. Flower settings, nested editors and conversation rename
use the published Dialog. Preserve the bounded loading geometry defined in
[page-loading continuity](page-loading-continuity.md#page-continuity).

Published Floe reserves a stable scrollbar gutter when the default Dialog body
owns scrolling. Panel and body widths stay fixed as content crosses the scrolling
threshold during the existing smooth height transition. Custom layouts that
replace body scrolling retain their full width without an empty gutter. Floe
continues to own height observation, animation and reduced-motion behavior.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Persistence and authentication
The Runtime opens apps/filesystem/directory-favorites.sqlite through sqliteutil before service readiness and closes it with Code App. Schema v1 is initialized transactionally; existing tables, objects and records are verified and unsupported or future schemas fail before a writable open.

There is no ten-item cap, automatic deletion, move tracking, grouping or custom naming.

## Client ownership and interaction
One in-memory client per authenticated environment supplies every mounted entry.

Initial load failure offers retry; refresh failure retains displayed paths.

No separate title card, second path line or persistent favorite star occupies the sidebar.

All entries share filtering and scrolling; roots are not pinned separately. Short lists use their natural height, capped at the smaller of 16rem and 45% of the sidebar body. The directory tree owns a separate viewport. Filtering appears above five entries, matches labels or full paths, holds the viewport height while active, and restores the previous list scroll on clear. Refresh retains rows, focus and the query. Arrow/Home/End navigation reveals only the local target, including in scaled Workbench windows. Menu invocation retains the captured directory and published focus ownership.

Quick access marks only the exact active destination, never its containing root. The existing navigator supplies pending intent: selection and busy semantics update immediately; the progress icon appears only after 150ms of uninterrupted waiting to avoid fast-refresh flicker. Current-page semantics identify only the displayed path. Hover is weaker than selection; a leading marker distinguishes selection from focus. Selection never changes font weight, size or text geometry. Filtering never promotes another row to active.

The entire 32px-high shortcut row is a native navigation button, including padding and permission badges, except for the separate trailing 32px menu button. No dead gaps or overlapping actions divide these targets; pointer, keyboard and touch retain the same navigation/menu ownership.

Published Sidebar owns the outer width; the Files/Git body fits its content box without a second fixed width or outer scroll owner.

Flower exposes favorites inside its directory picker. Conversation transcript and thread-list menus do not mutate directory favorites; their directory actions follow [working directory navigation](flower-working-directory-navigation.md).

## Compatibility
Runtime compatibility epoch 69 requires this exact authenticated resource and Desktop route allowlist. Floret APIs, domain schema, conversation lifecycle, file-operation authorization and Runtime Service protocol version remain unchanged.

sections.body:
## Drag-region synchronization
Desktop projects iframe-relative native drag regions. A settled snapshot must not schedule another frame by rebuilding itself; native pointer/geometry ownership remains upstream.

## Global bands
Ordinary windows use 1000–1099; expanded Flower 2000; its context previews 2100–2199; plugin Panel 3000 and plugin context menu 3100; product modals 4000; command palette 5000. Local menus, tooltips and recovery UI stay within their surface's global band.

## Dialog placement
Mobile plugin/tools navigation belongs to Shell content, not a global Launcher. Backdrop clicks close only the Dialog without reaching Activity beneath it; titlebar controls remain no-drag.

## Visible viewport boundaries
Published Floe owns visible viewport/safe areas, Safari fixed-origin conversion and projected-surface intersection. Do not bypass it with fixed positions, uncapped viewport heights or transforms. Temporary constraints preserve preferred size.

Dragging a maximized header restores preferred size at the grab point and continues the gesture; controls, double-click and mounted body remain independent. Redeven supplies safe-area insets and persists only settled geometry.

## Movable window order
A Shell-lifetime provider registers stable IDs, retains multiply registered IDs until all owners unregister, and assigns bounded MRU order within each window band. Minimized Debug Console is a base-band launcher, not an open window.

## Flower dismissal
Expanded Flower sits above ordinary windows; owned previews sit above Flower and below plugin Panels. Dismissal never restores composer focus, which would expand it again. Host pointer/focus and trusted plugin bridge activation/focus/action events collapse Flower without consuming destination interaction, including cross-origin iframe interaction.

Published Floe keeps resize handles on the outer geometry surface, outside rounded content clipping. All eight handles remain pointer-reachable; compact and maximized windows expose none.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Viewport and formats
### Viewport
[Floating layers](env-app-floating-layer-order.md) owns clamps. Keep title/close/toolbar reachable with local scroll. Fit uses local CSS pixels minus padding/scrollbar, not Workbench transform. Attachments keep nativePDF/contained images/shrinkable wrappers. Lazy Floe PDF owns layers/CSS; one PDF/PPTX renderer/page fences identity/cancel, local errors/Retry.

### Text search and retained overlays
Text/code/Markdown/PDF/DOCX/PPTX/HTML/spreadsheet/delimited previews share localized More/Mod+F Find; media-only has none. Published createTextSearch/TextSearchBar owns literal case-insensitive rendered matches, counts, previous/next, Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape. CSS highlights preserve nodes/selection and scroll only owner, excluding hidden controls/line numbers. Header targets active document; Desktop shares Floe theme instance. Queries reset on replacement, inactive/unselected views have no authority. Escape closes Find before window, including mobile.

Markdown controls hide without reflow; Monaco uses native overlay. PDF/spreadsheet use renderer search; PPTX searches all slides without mounting them and reveals result bounds; HTML uses private sandbox channel, DOCX ranges. CSV mode changes rebind same action; sheet panel floats. Floe owns Monaco hover and inactive paint suppression with retained model/draft/geometry/scroll; no host patch.

### Office/delimited
Adapters preserve attachment image/PDF/text and Env edit/selected Workbench wheel authority. Legacy XLS/DOC/PPT never enter OOXML. Exact official @silurus/ooxml@0.89.7 lazily renders copied XLSX/CSV/TSV bytes via XlsxWorkbook.load/metadata/getWorksheet/XlsxSheetViewer.fromWorkbook/activation. Read before activate for errors, enumerate all visible sheets only. Engine owns styles/merges/cached formulas/comments; no ExcelJS or200row/50column cap.

One toolbar owns sheet/optional value/zoom/info; Find stays More. Published floating layer/mask owns narrow isolation and Escape focus before parent. findNext activates first result, setSelection selects, matchIndex/total reflect engine. Current blue outline/fill differs from readable amber matches. Serialize search, fence query/sheet/file. CSV keeps table/source/encoding and literal zero/longID/formula-like cells; edit/truncation requires source, encoding affects table only.

Bounds20MiB/100000rows/1000000cells/64MiBUTF8/128MiBJSON. No GoogleFonts/hyperlinks, XLSX-only comments. Resize ignores transforms. Fence replacement/unmount and destroy viewer before workbook; resolved promises cannot erase error. Distinguish unsupported legacy from render failure.

DOCX commits off-DOM after identity check; published PPTX owns navigation/external-content warnings. Rich previews keep20MiB/localRetry/original bytes. Use original-author releases, no fork/vendor/patch/model rewrite/fallback. Office fidelity may differ; migration requires upstream repair/Word math proof. Verify licenses and graph-router/XLSX WASM hashes against installed bytes; unknown/altered fails. Build size is not installer size.

### HTML/Markdown
[HTML](#html) owns isolation; [diagrams](markdown-diagrams.md) owns Floe/Pele theme/lifetime. Contents starts closed in retained right drawer, heading jump closes/file change resets/no headings disables; main sidebar stays. Semantic colors ensure text/inset-title>=4.5contrast, dark hue floor, selection/focus/forced colors. Theme changes no DOM/geometry/scroll/focus.

## HTML
### Page rendering
Case-insensitive HTML/HTM/XHTML renders in floating/mobile/Workbench/attachments using opaque allow-scripts/no-referrer frame, never shell DOM/authenticated navigation. Existing Activity/same-file reuse owns placement.

### Placement and interaction
Fill reading area with internal scroll; unselected frame is inert to pointer/keyboard/wheel. Unrelated updates retain document. Revision-fenced load/render opportunities prove presentation, not idle. Shared localized pending presentation delays feedback only, never content. Loaded tab switches do not reload; replacement fences callbacks/messages/link failures. Inactive media pauses, no autoplay on return or forced script/canvas suspension. Preserve CSP/size; attachment snapshots keep2MiB and no editor authority.

### Source editing and snapshots
Existing source editor requires write. Attachments stay on attached bytes/read-only, never live reread.

## PPTX
Lazy published Floe/pptx loads only for slides. Open directly; warn only actual incomplete/disabled resources. Verify/distribute original licenses, ECMA geometry/dependency notices and MPL source.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Window actions
Use Floe titleContent/WindowTabs/headerActions. One document has a title; multiple documents use scrollable closable tabs without replacing other controls. Tabs never drag/maximize the window. Blank header/grip/inactive feedback/separators move it; real and portaled controls retain pointer ownership. Labels do not select text.

Alt+Shift+Left/Right sorts; Escape cancels sorting before dismissal. Arrow/Home/End/Delete stay local with visible focus and full-name tooltips. Preserve selection, panels and iframes. Header holds Ask Flower, More and fixed controls; More owns Find/Copy path/Edit/Save/Discard/Download under existing policy. No extra path row.

One controller/panel per normalized path serves every filesystem entry. Reopening selects without reread/discard. Switching preserves nodes, drafts, position and mode, pausing inactive native media. Floe RetainedPanel keeps panels laid out at current viewport size, hidden/inert/ARIA-hidden rather than display:none; DOM order is independent of tab order. Each tab owns actions/loading/errors/Retry. Closing inactive tabs preserves selection; active selects adjacent; last closes window. Window close confirms all unsaved edits together, cancellation preserves all, saving prevents discard until settlement.

Attachments use source-identity tabs with independent loaders/retry/cancel/object URLs; repeat selects the same source. Snapshot inspectors, Workbench widgets and conversation-file back navigation keep separate ownership. Workbench content begins below header except sync notices; keyboard/Escape/Tab cannot leak to canvas/shell focus. FilePreviewActions owns availability/feedback; downloads preserve draft mapping and use [product Downloads](../ai/flower-task-files.md#downloads-and-panel), including child previews. Writable PDFs use Edit and PDF.js Unicode saves/NeedAppearances without replacement-font embedding. Live links open current objects; snapshots retain bytes; failed targets offer Retry/Open parent.

## Ask Flower context
The preview frame owns one active-file context reader, including titlebar and portaled actions. Tab changes update that reader; a menu freezes the file identity and explicit selection before focus changes. No selection submits only the file reference. Preview/editor wire validation admits a file reference plus explicit text snapshots; file-browser actions remain path-only. Selected text is a separate snapshot with the source path; preserve indentation, line endings and unsaved status. The file remains an authorized live resource, not a substitute for the frozen selected text. Read-only standalone previews use the same global source capture and intent builder, including the menu anchor; they do not replace the request with a no-argument callback. Monaco's shared adapter reads its model selection, never its hidden DOM input. Preview buttons capture selection on pointer down. Floe owns focus preservation for embedded menus, including Shadow DOM: window activation must not blur the menu between pointer press and release. Redeven must not patch Monaco menu timing.

## Separate preview
More opens the active saved filesystem file in a separate Desktop window or browser tab. Busy/loading disables it; unsaved edits show localized save-first feedback without autosave/discard. Retain original document and drafts. Separate previews are read-only, with Ask Flower, Find, Copy path, Download, rendering and Retry. Attachments do not gain this filesystem action.

Ask Flower opens locally in the invoking preview and reveals one retained companion after admission. Native titlebar/context menu/shortcut share that renderer; browser requests create no extra tab. Preserve iframe/scroll/focus through cancellation/completion. Canonical file context/cwd feed the normal launcher. Screenshots require explicit capture. Model/runtime settings and directory browsing have local surfaces; unsupported terminal/app/plugin/navigation commands are absent. Register only supported preview commands, not invisible main-shell shortcuts.

Used downloads expose local progress/error/retry. Task/mobile panels load lazily with localized pending feedback and retain mounts through close presence. Route detection remains separate from lazy implementation and initial-build budgets. Authorized HTML links open another native preview or navigate the browser tab with history, never invisible accumulated panels.

window=file-preview&path=... uses the existing access gate, recovery, controller and sandboxed renderers, filename title and no shell chrome or URL credentials. Invalid/ambiguous paths load nothing. Reads/media retain Runtime authorization; the route grants none. Browser opening is synchronous with click, preserves session bootstrap and clears opener; blocked opens fail without retries.

Desktop's dedicated IPC accepts a bounded absolute identity. Main validates live session, top-level sender and trusted Env entry, deriving URL/partition from that session. Independent OS windows share theme/language and native reading bounds. Session+path deduplicates: repeat focuses without navigation, close retires identity, reopen creates fresh. Native failure never falls through to browser. Session shutdown owns children.

## Preview retirement
Accepted close immediately cancels/fences reads and disables new edits/retries/probes. Keep document/title/resources through Floe exit, releasing on unmount. Tab switches do not close controllers. Reopen reverses the same presence owner; stale release cannot clear newer content. Store constant-size presentation references, not copied lifecycle/timers, blank iframes or extra reads. Disposal fences late replies.

## Files window retirement
Explicit close clears requests/restores focus immediately while host retains last title/key/browser through inert exit. Reopen cancels that exit; old completions, detached browsers and timers cannot survive. Later actions do not wait for animation. The 1,000-entry/five-cycle fixture checks synchronous close, focus, underlying action and <50-ms frames.

## Companion
### Companion ownership
Published BottomBarCompanion owns geometry, viewport/safe-area clamps, presence and Escape/outside dismissal in the explicit Activity overlay host, never body. Centered collapsed input grows bounded detail upward without moving body geometry. Running work cannot prevent collapse or destination input.

### Activity Terminal footer
Desktop Activity Terminal provides a 24px anchor in its 28px footer, centered with shrinkable 360px maximum width; Workbench/mobile provide none. Only collapsed input uses terminal colors, restrained tint/border and monochrome Flower icon; expansion keeps shell theme. Palette changes retain editor/transport/input ownership and one Flower instance.

### Stable Flower placement
Retain one EnvAIPage/FlowerSurface after first access readiness. hidden/aria-hidden/inert change together. Available unfiltered Workbench placement survives deselection; selection owns focus/input only. [Settings](flower-setup-and-settings.md#retained-panels) owns retained forms.

### Contextual Ask Flower
Explicit new companions may capture Activity through a read-only reader; [launcher](flower-turn-launcher.md#submission) owns sending. Ask Flower suppresses only floating Activity companion. Full-page/mobile/Workbench preserve conversation/editor/transcript while the card owns focus. Dismissal/failed admission retains the source; success hands off once to the new task in captured host. File previews keep their own prompt/conversation even when narrow, without activating parent shells.

### Presence and summary
[Presence](flower-companion-presence.md#presence) owns collapsed priority, tails, completion, composer precedence and observation.

### Dismissal, focus, and reads
Shell, anchor and classified Flower portals count inside. Trusted cross-origin bridge input participates without consuming destination actions. SSE summaries carry activity only; baseline/read envelopes retain UserPublicID. Direct preview resize retains companion; unrelated windows dismiss it.

## Contextual window
### Shared input card
Both hosts use published PromptCard/shared launcher, not another conversation manager. Width<=384px fits viewport; actual notes, bounded references/editor and errors determine height. One opaque frameless plane contains references, editor and attachment/model/Send toolbar; no divider/wash/ordinary border, while contrast modes retain a boundary. Reference chips use opaque inset wells via data-floe-prompt-reference.

File/model selection restores insertion. Searchable grouped Select shows provider brand/full model/availability with stable request-local IDs, not reasoning shorthand. Stage attachments once; uncertain admission retains exact model, attachment IDs and request for explicit retry.

### Host boundary and motion
Measure visible Shell header/Desktop safe area in client coordinates. PromptCard anchors at the supplied point, flips/clamps through Floe observeViewport including keyboard/zoom. File/Git preserve menu points across preparation; previews use their control; other entries capture origin before focus moves. Only source-less openings use upper center. Measure layout, not animated bounds.

Published createFloatingPresence owns 280ms entrance/140ms exit, 12/6px lift and restrained scale. Clamp preserves direction; reduced motion settles immediately. Commit initial styles once, even in rAF; input works in opening task. Exit immediately revokes input while retaining intent/anchor/draft until unmount; reversal retains editor/request identity. No product motion recipe.

### Interaction continuity
Autofocus unless disabled. Escape/Close restores origin; outside dismissal preserves destination input. IME/nested previews retain Escape ownership; related previews/direct geometry controls count inside. Before admission, paint busy state, prevent duplicate sends/dismissal and make references inert. Shared launcher owns exact retry/uncertainty, removal, localization and footer rules.

sections.body:
## Content and identity
Permanent folding gutter aligns prose/activity/progress/Goal before grouping. Details align with summary; tool/thinking metadata follows text with compact gap/full-row activation. Chevrons derive right/down solely from aria-expanded, including initially open screenshots.

Collapsed fields preserve intent/result shape without hidden payload. Disclosure reads selected values:16KiB chunks/128KiB windows with selection pins. Close/hide/navigation cancels. Markdown keeps exact UTF-8/whitespace, yields between batches, and retains complete selected working set rather than fixed preview.

Thread Query:/Thread Read: remain technical labels with model intent in user language; [queries](../ai/flower-thread-queries.md) owns privacy/limits/failures. Web search uses one localized visible/accessibility title; details show actual per-call results/errors, including URL-only sources, without repeated query/URL/pattern/status.

Registered/hosted/source/MCP/unknown tools share compact glyphs/leading edge with prose/progress. Composer/status shares native scrollbar gutter. Existing resize observer reads only inline-size changes; existing layout scheduler publishes changed geometry. Row growth adds no width reads/observers/schedulers; embedded hosts retain ownership. Collapsed titles describe intent, never supply input/authority. Computer tools omit absent-observation filler but retain typed failures, uncertainty, blank pages and unavailable targets.

Authorized Activity source rows preserve exact host-authored text without path guessing; Floret v7.105.0 retains credential protection. Redacted/invalid_utf8_replaced/truncated facts have separate localized notices. Historical altered content is not reconstructed. Computer completed_reads describes requested scope independently of current snapshot authority; context reset and failed operation index stay visible in details. Structured result rows retain validated invalidation scope/event/frame, interrupted-wait measurements, and completed read identities; these facts do not authorize retries or establish application readiness.

## Observation interruptions
TARGET_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE keeps canonical error/completed actions, but visible/accessibility copy says page read unavailable, distinguishing confirmed effects. Unknown effects/user decisions retain attention. Keyboard technical disclosure keeps original message/code. Published ActivityError.Code and bounded computer_observation=unavailable chips retain category without hidden-body reads. Exclude these interruptions from group/turn failure counts; confirmed time/operation budget exhaustion uses neutral completed-work-retained copy with canonical diagnostics. Permission/unknown-effect failures retain attention; other errors stay failures. Never infer old records from English, rewrite history, mark recovered from unrelated success or auto-retry.

## Viewport/input
One controller owns position; layout/focus/motion/growth cannot resume paused reading. [Sequence geometry](flower-tool-sequences.md#geometry-and-input) owns native nested scroll/inert controls; [SubAgents](flower-subagent-detail.md#task-presentation) owns child viewport.

Prose continuously approaches actual bottom; chunks retarget without restart. One line settles≈160ms with fractional positions/no overshoot. Share one geometry frame; motion-only frames reuse measurements and skip history scans until settled scroll. No idle polling/delayed output. Native input/selection pauses immediately; clearing selection does not resume. Initial positioning/navigation/resize/shrink are immediate. Explicit latest arrives220ms; automatic folds follow real content without trailing space/competing scroll. Exclude paused insertion room from latest distance. Reduced motion skips; hide/rebind/dispose cancels.

## Thinking and motion
Canonical first/last chunk receipts survive hydration/reconnect/restart/Fork. Continuation reopens interval, last chunk ends it. Tooltip distinguishes receipt vs compute; show<1ms/localized Not recorded, never infer neighbors/totals. Legacy observations remain memory-only.

Live petals fill clockwise then center, hold/fade2.4s. Sealed/canceled/disconnected static; CSS handles theme/reduced-motion/high-contrast/forced colors without lifecycle. Disclosure uses one reversible Web Animation,180ms open/140ms close, stale completions ignored. [Sequence handoff](flower-tool-sequences.md#disclosure-and-bodies) owns260ms geometry/crossfade/stationary prose.

Fresh tool/argument/thinking titles reveal once168–360ms,<=32 width-adapted steps; full text/geometry/accessibility/actions exist immediately. After sequence placement, make viewport room220ms before reveal; growth retargets without extending deadline. Scroll interrupts, paused reading remains; reduced motion skips. Delivery/results/controls never wait. Independent arrivals/shimmer preserve typography.

Accepted receipt/selection provenance gates execution arrivals. History/body restore/queued reads consume claims and settle statically; post-ready live snapshots/deltas qualify. Two visible receipts retain only restore revision/live flag, no copy/scheduler/timer/row observer. Claims exclude navigation/reconnect/hidden disclosure/>450ms delayed mounts; observe closure before lazy mount and survive preview promotion/remount/replacement/completion. Final snapshots may reveal new tools from previously active execution.

Auto-fold awaits admitted title motion then reading protection. New prose awaits sequence close; manual actions/delivery immediate. Title node survives trigger change, call identity transfers remaining time. Failure/approval immediate. Navigation/dispose/hide/reduced motion clears clipping; no character timers/per-frame reactive state/durable animation facts.

The [Flower approval surface](#approval-presentation) owns the approval list, bounded layout, disclosure, focus, exact batch membership, and presentation contract. It shares the interaction submission guard and canonical reconciliation boundary described above.

Runtime restart recovery is quiet unless content cannot be recovered, in which case the affected row offers a nonblocking retry. All shipped locales provide the same distinction; keyboard users can focus the circle and dismiss its details with Escape.

Published Floe Markdown parsing owns GFM syntax with CJK-aware emphasis boundaries for completed and streamed text. Display parsing never writes back to canonical messages or provider cache input. New messages preserve complete sources; old records lacking sources remain readable without rewriting historical data.

## Inline-code references
Inline Markdown code consumes the published Floe `--inline-code-foreground` and `--inline-code-background` pair directly, without desaturating assistant references. Prose and table references use `0.96em` and medium weight so compact identifiers remain readable beside CJK text. Linked references retain navigation affordances.

Porcelain Light uses deep burgundy ink on a pale rose inset. Normal and selected code text clear 7:1; the fill stays restrained while separating from the canvas by 1.14–1.2:1. The latter is a product design budget, not a control-boundary accessibility threshold. Acceptance includes dense mixed-language tables, both materials, desktop/narrow widths, native selection and theme-switch continuity.

Fenced code, copy behavior and canonical content remain independent.

Theme changes preserve focus, selection, DOM and geometry; see [message appearance](flower-message-appearance.md).

## Source-card presentation
Sources start collapsed, showing the count and a deduplicated stack of up to four website icons plus an overflow count. Sources never expose their own copy button. Inline citations retain their existing links.

## Website icons
The shared Flower UI bundles 27 common website marks from pinned theSVG assets with audited per-icon licenses. Icon enhancement runs independently after Markdown rendering; collapse/expand never restarts it.

The renderer receives image bytes, never a third-party tracking URL.

## Authored bibliography
Assistant Markdown can already contain an explicit bibliography inside an unlabelled, `text` or `plaintext` fence. This is display-only authored content: it neither fabricates canonical source annotations nor binds numeric prose references to provider metadata. User messages and fetched external Markdown do not enable this assistant-specific presentation.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Presence
### Status and live output
Canonical priority is running, queued, attention, unread failure, unread cancellation, unread completion, unavailable, idle. Reduced motion disables flow/tracking/arrival effects while retaining semantic text/color. Live tails use matching current-run facts without exposing raw thinking. A collapsed Activity companion uses stable localized status and thread-title copy for running work; it does not render continuously changing assistant output or live-tail motion. Expanded and full Flower presentations retain live progress.

### Completion acknowledgement
Only a matching successful run previously observed running while collapsed may temporarily replace an idle editor with localized completion feedback. Exclude history, queued-only work, failures, cancellation, attention, expired/mismatched runs and completion while other running/queued work remains. Feedback is ephemeral, not canonical presence.

### Observation and transport
Use the shared workspace SSE; summaries cannot invent personal read state. Expansion requests current selected detail without a second stream; disconnect uses existing recovery.

### Composer precedence
One derived entry owns rendering/target, in this order:
1. Current-thread pending decision, regardless of question type or draft.
2. Ordinary editor for draft, attachment, reference, focus or IME; inspection if editing unavailable.
3. Eligible running, queued, unread-failure or ephemeral-completion target button.
4. Ordinary editor or read-only/unavailable inspection.

## Composer
Settings recovery stays inside the collapsed row, with a reachable Retry and unchanged height. It replaces compact summary copy until recovery; active Stop remains available. The published shell cannot clip recovery outside its bounds. Expanded recovery uses the existing floating notice stack.

### Retained editor and explicit entry
The same ordinary editor moves between compact/detail presentations. Specialized decisions retain separate controls; input/approval/work priority follows [presence](#presence), never converts a decision/status entry into an editor.

### Editor layout and growth
Toolbar left stays empty; permission/model/reasoning remain in More during loading/errors. Recovery/guidance sit above the editor. Short input leaves no blank space beneath the toolbar; multiline growth moves it without replacing the editor. Dedicated pages retain complete starter suggestions.

### Motion and surface treatment
One shell grows upward/outward in width and height, preserving bottom edge, border, background and clipping. Close dissolves detail before compact layout; reversal follows current phase. Exit keeps fixed coordinates and Activity height, without origin flashes. Published forced-color and focus indicators remain. Composer disclosures follow [shared surface material](surface-material.md): portaled nested menus retain More ownership, Escape returns focus one level at a time, and exits stop accepting input immediately. Collapsed content uses only its compact composer inset; transcript/activity gutters apply to expanded content and cannot push the entry icon away from the left edge.

sections.body:
## Reference drafts
Launcher/Tessiven chips wrap/scroll inside bounded input. @ discovery requires whitespace boundary/collapsed caret, immutable thread cwd or new-thread directory, and bounded global matching for slashless queries. Root failures offer Retry; inaccessible descendants skip within limits. Focus changes color without geometry/shadow shifts and preserves candidate/action focus.

Queue previews bind ThreadID/QueueID/ReferenceID and reauthorize on submission. Outbox retains launch context only through confirmation/terminal cleanup; later reads use authorized canonical references, never another mapping.

## Origin page
Capture submits exact visible authorized text, including terminal's current screen; it reads no hidden resources or replacement editor. Activity captures origin only on explicit New/open without selection, including close reversal. Page changes/existing-thread opens add nothing. Automatic references never enable empty Send. Draft/canonical previews share presentation, not authority.

## Global Ask Flower
Floe resolves nearest declared right-click/keyboard owner and compact icons. Unavailable targets never borrow active-page identity. Navigation publishes itself, blank shell publishes region only; rows/cards/groups/details expose existing visible facts while parents supply identity. Workbench owns widget/title; dialogs fence portals. Exclude stale selection and hidden terminal buffers; Files/terminal/processes retain specialized routes.

Palette/Mod+Shift+J uses valid active source or none, with no extra header icon. Repeat focuses draft; secondary menus retain it. Explicit retarget preserves text/model/manual files, replaces automatic references and cancels capture. Sending/unknown admission locks target. Local/global menus share action identity; changed editable targets get new request IDs. Opening creates nothing; fresh Send creates a task.

Shared FlowerContextSource and flowerPageContext supply identical bounded text to preview/Send, without DOM/state wrappers. Freeze binding/facts before focus changes; navigation cannot rewrite them. Subject-resource changes invalidate screenshots; geometry alone does not. Uncertain Retry retains immutable request/staging. No source watcher or automatic model capture runs during answers. Owned Desktop children forward credential-free title/URL through their session, gaining no shell IPC; external apps/browsers are excluded and opaque embeds expose host-known identity only.

### Web Service identity
Managed rows freeze managed_web_service, runtime_ref, owner=managed_service and exact resourceId plus allowlisted deployment/status/cwd/port facts. Workspace need not be source/install cwd. Manual port_forward uses distinct sanitized identity, never same-name service substitution. Context grants no effects. Inspect exact binding directly; explanation may use supplied facts without private reads.

### Explicit screenshots
Only camera captures removable ordinary attachments. Errors preserve draft; close/reopen/retarget cancel and fence late results without substitution. Desktop validates exact WebContents/visible region before/after, privacy markers and PNG limits. Browser requires picker/matching handle/Region Capture, drains pre-crop frames and accepts fresh cropped output at required frame rate; missing capability is unavailable. Always release frames/tracks. Prompt remains mounted/focused but hidden for capture and returns before encoding. Cross-origin pixels convey no DOM authority or automatic secret-redaction promise.

## Reference previews
Show frozen selectable/scrollable text, never fake paths. Screenshot preview uses the staged File's object URL; close/replace/dispose release/fence without draft changes. Other formats use bounded renderers. Header retains identity/close/explicit navigation, omitting synthetic path/download rows, boilerplate and duplicate Close. Preserve actual truncation/errors and constrained flex viewport.

## Thread references
Menus append without selecting/sending source. Shared dispatch owns identity/serialization; threads never become paths. [Thread tools](../ai/flower-thread-queries.md) authorize later reads; draft owns dedupe/preview/removal/recovery.

## Context actions
One privacy-checked mapper emits ordered references/UserInput.Context. Malformed, forged, unknown or projection failure rejects without draft loss. Builders admit fields before serialization, omit composer detail/file root_label and unsupported fields even if undefined; test actual builders through strict parser/launcher.

assistant.ask.flower carries target/source/presentation/items. Runtime accepts file_path, terminal_selection, process_snapshot and bounded Git/environment text_snapshot; never reconstruct from product copies. Routing independently authorizes Environment. Missing thread/reference is absent; other Floret faults stay unavailable.

Plugin authoring guidance belongs to authenticated model context, not repeated user references. Explicit source conversation accompanies only first new-thread Send and clears on acceptance. Canvas comments submit their own reviewed context; repair may submit text alone. Neither inherits ordinary composer contents. Active execution queues through durable outbox with handler/storage/permission/input/admission guards.

## Context-menu discovery
Freeze target/anchor/selection before focus. Compact background menus coexist with rich Workbench/file/terminal/Git/preview/Flower owners and one Ask action. Viewport portals sit above retained cards; unrelated transcript scrolling cannot close shell menus. Native forwarding validates clicked owner. Remote pixels/third-party iframes remain independent; host chrome/commands are entry points. Selection captures no image and attaches nothing to existing tasks. Lazy file staging preserves startup budget.

## Ownership and persistence
`ai_conversation_preferences` belongs to product schema v11. Transactional v10→v11 validates source/target shapes, preserves data and never infers preferences from old threads. Missing stable scope cannot read another user's defaults.

## Global settings
Env App Settings → Flower exposes personal defaults separately from the runtime model profile. It reuses the composer adapter and CAS endpoint, model directory, reasoning control and scoped directory picker. Opening never writes effective fallbacks; each explicit selection patches only its chosen field. Scope, connection generation and current permissions fence late completions. Composer choices remain direct shortcuts to this same memory.

## Selection events
Patch only the chosen field. Existing-thread edits must succeed before saving memory; memory failure cannot roll back confirmed thread state. Explicit Default differs from absent memory; Default/budget and Off/budget semantics remain.

## Drafts and admission
Draft overrides remain distinct from effective model/directory admission values; old selection cannot seed a new draft. Without explicit/remembered reasoning, root launch freezes explicit Default so retries cannot acquire later memory. Server [canonicalization](../ai/model-reasoning-runtime.md#runtime-capability) owns model capability. Existing busy/queued/unresolved-input edit restrictions apply.

## Concurrency and failure
Adapters serialize captured patches and load latest revision; the store atomically merges with compare-and-set. Stale writes return 409 without auto-retry. Captured target/model identity fences late responses against navigation or retargeting.

Catalog refresh is reserved for configuration changes, preventing model/reasoning selection from replacing the composer with loading UI.

Schema3 has one decoder. Base64<=32KiB binds ID/index/count/total,scope/revision,contiguous version/UTF8 offset. Constant-storage coalescing preserves base/semantics;started frames immutable,byte coverage suppresses duplicates. Limits16pending batches,32MiB envelope/subscriber,32MiB global refs. Separate summary/private/child mailboxes. Pending controls page64 authorized items to user boundary,check leaf/version;oversize items individually,no full View/body. Broken sequence/authority invalidates.

## Retention and recovery
Keep DOM/height/accessibility for live/visible/focused/selected;partition near24rows after prose without splitting groups. Keyed subscriptions dispose with owners;replace thread identity only. Equal/empty replacements retain membership;matching tools reproject. Thinking keeps block;presence tracks empty;empty coverage ignores leaf. [Streaming](flower-streaming-stability.md) owns reactive/structural/token reuse,not historical field/title/follow rescans.

[Activity](flower-activity-interaction.md) owns inspection/before-paint placement;Fork inherits no disclosure. Body readiness cannot alter restoration provenance/unrelated motion. Full baseline/hydration admits history;cold sealed Markdown survives reconnect/reveals final geometry without entrance. Navigation suppresses arrival until placed. Count objects once,avoid reactive recursion;current run/visible anchors guide compaction,paging restores decorations.

Inactive cache12threads/32MiB estimated protects selected/retained/in-flight/summary owners. Byte census only for eviction;baseline replacement/leaving retained documents invalidates estimate,sole displayed live document gets none. Append logs256chunks/256KiB,absolute cursors/exact-source catchup;active documents/selection uncapped. Delay catchup notice200ms,never publication. [Composer](flower-turn-launcher.md) owns captured input.

Detail, body, parent-event and baseline reads belong to visible demand until cancellation. An intact session has no elapsed/header/idle failure deadline. Actual transport/availability failures retry with capped 200/600/1200/2500/5000/10000 ms backoff; backoff releases physical read slots. Authorization, malformed contracts and foreign identity stop. Navigation/disposal cancels pending I/O and fences late results; accepted content, draft, DOM and scroll remain stable. Live observation reconnects only after actual transport loss, 408/429/5xx or explicit synchronization invalidation. Unknown command effects are never automatically replayed; canonical admission wins over late transport errors.

An authority-corrupt historical summary publishes explicit `summary_unavailable: {code: "authority_corrupt"}` with read-only settings identity, zero timestamps and no runtime facts. This is the only zero-timestamp summary shape. The decoder remains strict for normal summaries; one damaged thread cannot invalidate healthy workspace observation. Cached canonical title/time/content survive, cold selection does not issue a fabricated detail read, and a later healthy summary clears the marker. Accepted sends display localized “Received, syncing” until their canonical observation arrives.

Floating notices above companion expose interrupted updates/Resync/minimizable details without moving content/header;minimize preserves center. Shared Button/presence owns feedback;hidden details inert. Preserve reduced-motion/forced colors,44px targets,focus-preserving Escape/outside dismissal,drafts/selection/bounds. Coalesce busy recovery;empty explanation immediate without task-pause implication. Restoration needs current connection/selected authoritative detail,not collapsed reads. Dismiss after2.6s unless focused/hovered/expanded. Cancellation owns Stopping;timed-out Stop restores Resync after read settlement. Initial exit may finish after readiness.
