concepts.title: Flower message appearance
concepts.summary: Shared Flower uses Floe colors for compact reading and contrasting sent-message selection. Answered receipts retain every complete question followed by its answer in canonical order, without disclosure or choices. Questions use regular weight, answers medium weight, and a quiet check accompanies the localized status.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Transcript reading scale
Assistant/user text uses `0.875rem` and unitless `1.75` line height. Composer controls retain published control scale.

## Assistant reading roles
Body/headings retain the chat foreground. Presentation does not rewrite Markdown or infer metadata from authored bold text, dates, identifiers or citations. [Citations](flower-citations.md) own destinations/copy.

## Filled messages and content
Sent text/answered-question receipts mix 4% theme foreground into the published `floe-well-on-plane` fill for clearer separation from the content canvas, with `floe-radius-group` corners and 16px horizontal padding. Reading ink derives from the theme foreground with stronger light/dark luminance; ordinary text, full questions and answers share that ink and the transcript reading scale. Across published presets and both materials, body ink clears 7:1 and is no weaker than assistant ink on the same capsule surface. Only status/redacted metadata is secondary. Queued input retains its separate paint and spacing.

Spacing and thin neutral separators distinguish multiple responses. Short receipts fit their content without a minimum-width panel.

Text, placeholders and actions share the right edge; the full-row history wrapper makes the 78% desktop bubble limit relative to the transcript. Short text fits intrinsically; narrow views retain the full-column limit. Error/code insets use readable foreground and selection roles over their own backgrounds.

## Queued input beside the composer
The shared Flower component owns queue presentation in both hosts, using published Floe theme roles. A queue is a borderless, shadowless list of 32px single-line rows with a quiet neutral fill, 2px between rows and 4px above the composer. Long labels retain their complete text through truncation and the native tooltip. The list scrolls at the smaller of 10rem or 30% of viewport height. Host styles must not duplicate the retired queue-panel layout.

Drag, edit, send-now, delete and attachment/reference previews retain their existing authority and behavior. Action hit areas remain at least 24px, reserve their width and reveal on hover or keyboard focus; touch controls remain visible. Focus, pending feedback and stream updates must not move neighboring controls.

## User media and resources
Order is image thumbnails, wrapping resource cards, text bubble, then timestamp/copy. Resource/image-only messages omit empty bubbles. Canonical previews use exact thread/turn/reference identity; queued actions retain their separate authority/click guard.

## Native text selection
Filled text, including transparent table headers, reverses capsule ink and fill for visible native selection; code and queued insets retain their own selection roles. Selection never changes parsing, copying or transport. Browser checks require 4.5:1 supporting/selected text and a visible selection surface across all presets/materials. Copying answered receipts retains complete ordered questions/answers and the localized hidden-answer placeholder. [Highlighting](flower-code-highlighting.md) retains its own stable-content contract.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Forced colors map sent bubbles to `Highlight` / `HighlightText`, pending input and insets to native reading surfaces, and selection to contrasting system roles. Palette and material ownership remain with [Desktop shell theme state](../desktop/desktop-shell-theme-state.md) and [shared surface material](surface-material.md).

concepts.title: Flower latest user message editing
concepts.summary: Edit the latest eligible user message in the existing composer. Opening the editor is read-only. Sending creates an immutable replacement branch inside the same thread, preserving the original version. Floret owns conversation admission and history; Redeven owns authorization, resource preparation and presentation.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Interaction

The latest canonically eligible user row exposes a pencil action. The existing composer becomes the editor, containing its complete text, captured references and admitted attachments. Keep the interface to one input control and its existing action row: no additional heading, instruction banner or duplicate Stop control. Cancel is a compact accessible X beside Send; Escape cancels. Preserve the ordinary unsent draft independently and restore it after cancellation or confirmed submission.

Editing remains local until Send. For a running turn, Send means stop the exact source turn gracefully, recheck authority and submit the replacement. Opening, typing, inspecting previous versions and canceling never stop execution. Waiting-input interactions use the same edit submission path; Enter does not answer the old question. IME composition never submits. Slash-prefixed replacement text remains literal. Reference suggestions retain their ordinary keyboard behavior; prompt-history recall does not replace an edit draft.

A clock action opens the previous version read-only. Use this version restores its input into the editor and still requires Send. Switching threads retains each independent draft; late responses update only their originating edit. Read-only surfaces expose no edit capability.

## Canonical ownership and admission

Consume published Floret v7.111.3's optional `runtime.ThreadMessageEditor`. The request identifies the thread, source item, exact complete expected input and an immutable request key. Floret validates eligibility, cancels if explicitly requested, and atomically appends the revision boundary, new turn marker and replacement user entry. Original journal bytes remain intact. Execution uses the normal provider pipeline with fresh TurnID/RunID and an explicit prompt-lineage boundary; superseded responses never leak into the new model context.

The latest source is not guessed from a visible text match. Applied steering, Goal submission, unknown effects, outstanding bound host work and open children from the discarded turn can make the source ineligible. No automatic tool replay, child cancellation, file rollback or fallback to an older input is permitted. Goal, Todo, queue and accumulated usage survive; deleted-Goal suppression names the replacement input consistently in full and bounded reads, after restart and Fork. Host shutdown fences replacement admission after the asynchronous Stop transition.

Floret domain migration 37 to 38 and logical storage fence 12 to 13 preserve the released migration lineage. Hosts treat these records as opaque; there is no Redeven transcript or lifecycle mirror. Fork provenance never authorizes reading another thread's revision history.

## Product transport and resources

`GET /_redeven_proxy/api/ai/threads/:id/message-edit` returns the canonical draft, full-input fingerprint and storage generation. The optional single `revision_request_key` selects an immutable historical version. `POST` submits a strict JSON command with source identity, frozen generation, stop intent, optional restoration key and complete edited content.

Both Env HTTP and Desktop IPC require fresh product authorization. Desktop allows only exact GET/POST methods and exact bounded history query parameters. RWX and interactive endpoint authority are required. Captured reference text remains intact; retained resource IDs must belong to the selected original or restored input. New uploads use the existing scoped staging capability in headers/IPC metadata, never in the JSON body. Runtime facts, opaque resource locators, credentials and supplemental context never enter draft/history DTOs.

The immutable command includes every retained and added resource. Canonical lookup precedes resource preparation on replay. Same-key identical payload returns the original acknowledgement; changed payload, stale source or changed storage generation fails. Confirmed admission does not depend on a subsequent UI refresh.

The v7.111 dependency also introduces the explicit provider-context v12 boundary for interruption history. Upgrade acceptance preserves canonical prose, immutable released fixtures and native fragments when their canonical prefix is unchanged. Changed interruption context resets incompatible state; newly produced native fragments survive restart and remain isolated from Fork.

## Failure handling

A rejected request keeps the editable draft and displays the actual error. A lost response or 5xx result freezes the exact payload and key; explicit Retry resends that command once per user action. No hidden retry, new key, cancellation or resource removal can discard an unresolved command. Detached UI state does not authorize task replay. Edit drafts are browser presentation state, not a durable pending engine operation; process restart never automatically resubmits them.

History lookup is explicit and can read the complete retained source projection; ordinary live token updates do not reload eligibility or history. Eligibility refreshes only when selected thread, latest user identity, status, access or confirmed edit changes. The version dialog presents the prior source turn rather than inserting its output into the live thread.

sections.title: Decisions and comparative evidence
sections.body:
The comparison uses pinned source snapshots, not a claim about the latest binaries:

- Codex `ba0d0e1f74ee0f41c27ef24b37ed5fc030b487e7`, `codex-rs/tui/src/app_backtrack.rs`: backtrack previews select a user prompt, request revert-before-turn, and restore the prompt into the composer. Flower adopts composer reuse and explicit selection, while postponing canonical mutation until Send so cancel is genuinely local.
- OpenCode v2.0.32 `843a6c514e606b436a7fe713422ace0a93ad3d61`, `packages/core/src/session.ts`: separates revert stage, clear and commit. Flower uses one atomic revision admission instead of adding an independently durable staged-revert lifecycle.
- DeepSeek Harness `ce7073d51254c26cd63b22a60835b8f948deb447`, `packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/apply.ts`: branches at an explicit sequence and opens the child session. Flower retains immutable historical provenance but keeps latest-message editing in the existing thread; explicit Fork remains a separate user action.

Non-goals: editing arbitrary older messages, undoing real tool side effects, branch trees in the composer, automatically replaying failed tools, or changing Goal/queue semantics. These would require independent product decisions.

concepts.title: Flower model and navigation presentation
concepts.summary: Flower separates Desktop/environment sources, unavailable models and first setup. Transient action failures use notifications; canonical failures remain in their timeline. The model picker aligns to the logical start edge of its trigger through the published Floe anchored-layer API, retaining surface boundary clamping.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
The composer always keeps its model label visible without an availability spinner or busy status.

Its bounded scroll viewport exposes the complete configured catalog; selection and recent thread activity never reorder provider groups or model rows. Alias folding retains the selected identity in the original catalog slot. Closing retains the displayed selection and rows until unmount. Search, keyboard navigation, unavailable rows and management remain available. Selection focus restores only after saving and exit settle, to the visible model entry or More button, without overriding a newer focus choice.

Runtime status distinguishes no Desktop provider (`not_configured`), configured but unavailable keys or catalog (`missing_keys` or `empty`), and actual connection or protocol errors.

## Model identity and recovery
Thread snapshots, list items, and patches carry `model_id` and `reasoning_selection` as thread defaults. The last is a disabled, ungrouped display of a thread's missing model; Flower never silently replaces it.

See [reasoning selection ownership](../ai/model-reasoning-runtime.md#selection-controls) for loading, draft, and submission rules.

## Web search presentation
Model choices display the shared search badge from the server's readonly `web_search` projection. A provider brand or frontend model name never enables search. See [model directory ownership](../ai/model-directory-and-selection.md).

## Permission and navigation
Below the 768px viewport breakpoint, the composer keeps permission status and selection in its own More panel, alongside any other overflow controls.

Saving disables only the permission control, prevents duplicate requests, merges the authoritative settings response, and restores the confirmed value on failure.

Warm sessions switch without provider or transcript remount and stale loads cannot replace the current thread.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Flower does not treat the global model or permission as an existing-Thread launch override. After creation, its `model_id`, `reasoning_selection`, and `permission_type` are authoritative; Thread changes write to its settings, while new-thread overrides stay connection-local and never update environment defaults.

The header switcher is only a product-specific compact presentation; it does not create a second selected-thread owner or change the requested, committed, and content-presented ordering.

frontmatter.title: Flower progress and provisional edit presentation

concepts.summary: Floret request facts drive output indicators; frozen tool schemas drive bounded provisional names/counts. Actual result names and counts replace previews on settlement. A failed patch shows only confirmed mutation diffs before its error, retaining the error status and stable disclosure row.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Output progress
### Model request
Each logical request and attempt has its own start, first-output time, last semantic-progress time and estimated received output tokens. Local tools, approvals and user input never use this model-pause presentation.

Only phase text is a live region; numerical updates are readable without repeated automatic announcements.

### Indicator geometry
A live run indicator holds one width while it reports. Inside a host that gives it a bounded track, the mark and phase label keep a constant start inset, the token-and-clock metric keeps a constant end inset, and digits grow only in the free space between them. Reveal dots reserve their full width instead of animating it, so no tick resizes or recenters the indicator. The [subagent detail window](flower-subagent-detail.md#detail-window) supplies that track in its footer rail.

### Progress symbol
The shared Flower mark retains its five-petal geometry.

The symbol is decorative beside the existing localized status text and does not create another live announcement or execution state.

### Edit arguments
The frozen tool definition supplies one optional argument preview parser per call. Their input budget is 1 MiB per call, with bounded JSON depth and field counts.

[Confirmed file Activity](#confirmed-file-activity) remains the durable outcome.

## Edit preparation
Tool schemas are the single declaration-order authority. For `file_apply_patch`, Redeven observes complete canonical Add/Update/Delete headers and optional Move headers before the body finishes.

Validation failure shows no completed-edit preview. A partial Move presents the confirmed destination create/update, not a rename. Confirmed local mutation targets support the existing authorized file navigation;
preview paths and unconfirmed operations never acquire file actions.

## Confirmed file activity
[Task files](../ai/flower-task-files.md) add explicit verified delivery results and a
shared Files panel. The structured result links to the confirmed user destination;
intermediates remain in a separate expandable working-file section.

Published Floret v7.30.0 owns the product-neutral file Activity payload. A read carries bounded content and line metadata.

[Preview recovery](file-preview-window-actions.md#window-actions) keeps unavailable targets actionable without changing historical content.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Floret owns request accounting and ephemeral thread snapshots. Redeven's pure argument parsers supply only display names and optional counts; they cannot authorize or execute edits. Canonical tool results remain the only durable change facts, and supersede every provisional count.

Candidate names never create file actions, authorize paths, admit tool execution, or become durable conversation state. Current views use the existing [Flower live timeline](flower-live-timeline.md) transport and publication owner.

Activity presentation is not a filesystem authority or a second mutation record. The canonical tool result and Floret Activity lifecycle remain the owners of execution and persistence. Display names are not paths, line counts cannot prove current workspace state, and the UI never fetches a file or recomputes a diff merely to populate a historical row.

concepts.summary: Provider dialogs keep explicit access methods, keys, accounts and model selection independent. Use short names and access labels. Explain keys, quotas and saved methods in the access tooltip; model limits in the model tooltip. Icon links open official guidance.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Provider configuration
### Connection setup
OpenAI offers API keys or verified local ChatGPT accounts. Registration and model selection stay independent; endpoints stay flat and permissions unchanged.

### Kimi
One Kimi choice offers API or Kimi Code. Drafts isolate keys, endpoints and models; close clears them. Switching rejects stale discovery. Saved methods stay fixed; add another connection to change service. Cards label methods; IDs, aliases, selections and history stay unchanged.

Code keeps regional endpoints and reviewed IDs; billing never falls back.

### Search and secrets
Provider and model search switches must both be on; preferences remain editable when provider search is off. Backend policies own availability. See [failure recovery](flower-failure-recovery.md). Stored keys use fixed dot placeholders. Null removes a key; omitted/blank patches preserve it. Catalog refresh never selects new models.

### DeepSeek Fetch
Omitted Fetch configuration uses direct GET fetching. DeepSeek Fetch is opt-in
inside the DeepSeek provider dialog. Explicit existing DeepSeek selections are
preserved; this does not disable the separate search capability. HTML Preview
is described as an available rendering capability without recommending its use.

## ChatGPT selection
Verified signed-in accounts differ from saved connections. Sign-out retains a compact summary; explicit removal forgets only a signed-out local registration. Host owns protected persistence/admission.

### Account selection and recovery
The shared dialog offers ChatGPT account and API key methods. Selecting an entry never starts OAuth or saves a provider.

Account persistence, renewal and cancellation belong to the [account lifecycle](../ai/chatgpt-account-lifecycle.md#account-lifecycle); local admission belongs to the [authentication contract](../ai/chatgpt-account-lifecycle.md#local-admission).

### Connection feedback and continuity
The connection panel groups account identity, state guidance, and actions. Background reads of known accounts never remount a loading picker. All stages use the shared Desktop and Env styles and explicit localized copy.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Global Settings deep links focus the exact provider/model. Category/host hiding only suppresses nested portals and preserves the provider draft; explicit provider close retains its existing reset behavior. Permission revocation/disposal fences account discovery and save results before success publication.

Brand grouping is presentation only; both connection types remain in catalog/serialization. Floret mechanics and storage are unchanged.

Account removal does not delete an OpenAI account or provider configuration. The dialog never treats account selection as OAuth intent or an implicit provider save.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Flower read state is a Redeven-owned per-user activity watermark. A separate loaded-content revision prevents metadata or private confirmations from qualifying stale body content as current.

No storage format or historical watermark is reset.

Neither a detail response nor a hidden measuring transcript qualifies as
presentation. Selection telemetry and read acknowledgement wait until the
[destination presentation boundary](flower-thread-selection.md) releases its
prepared viewport, then retain the existing visible-document and content-revision
checks.

Foreground visibility is an input, not a second asynchronous readiness lifecycle.
The selected detail loader and destination presentation boundary own readiness;
returning to the foreground only requests their existing coalesced refresh.
Navigation, reselect, canceled reads and failed refreshes must not strand a
surface-wide readiness flag or prevent another presented thread from confirming
its content revision. Hidden, covered, loading and failed content remains
unacknowledged through the presentation checks themselves.

This boundary adds no polling, detail payload, list refresh, or backend storage.
Acknowledgements retain one in-flight request per thread, monotonic confirmation
and the existing retry policy. Repeated presentation of the same confirmed
revision sends no additional acknowledgement.

concepts.title: Flower setup and settings
concepts.summary: Shared setup/settings serve both Flower carriers. The unconfigured surface is one open, canvas-level composition using published Floe ink and Button interaction, with no card, icon tile, heavy heading or filled call-to-action. It contains the Flower mark, setup title, one short explanation and the available settings destinations.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## First-time setup
Welcome setup requires no selected thread, configured provider or usable model, and absent/`not_configured`/`empty` Desktop source. Desktop `local_host` opens the current surface's settings, never another Welcome window or a remote destination. Artwork has no glow or continuous animation.

Local setup has one text action; remote Desktop setup keeps distinct Desktop and environment text actions with concise localized labels. No model-sync control or starter-task previews appear before configuration. Existing settings updates restore the retained composer and draft when a model becomes usable; configured-model recovery remains in its existing settings/menu owner.

## Starter tasks
Four editable drafts cover current-folder understanding, connected computer, installed applications and folder organization. Names/dates alone never justify deletion. The [companion](flower-activity-companion.md#companion) omits the grid.

## Settings composition
Settings edit the environment profile even with a Desktop model source. Flat sections preserve identity/drafts. Immediate switches block duplicate edits and roll back on failure.

## Provider configuration
[Provider configuration](flower-provider-configuration.md#provider-configuration) owns authentication, layout and connection-before-model sequencing.

## Retained panels
Product settings commands enter the global [Settings host](runtime-settings.md#host-and-destinations), preserving Flower chat, composer, thread and extension owners. Standalone Flower retains its bounded fallback modal. Covered transcripts never acknowledge reads through modal exit. One canonical FlowerSettingsPanel/FlowerSettingsSurface owns provider/default edits; host adapters cannot duplicate its account or secret controller.

## Saving and ownership
Independent adapter operations save permission, model profile and default model. Permission uses a serialized 700 ms coalescing controller, fences older responses and restores the last confirmed value on failure. Computer-use failures restore the confirmed switch and expose errors.

sections.body:
## Incremental owners
Indexed records initialize from snapshots. Text/extent updates preserve window/turn/decoration identity;structural changes alone recompute membership. Argument previews touch one block,never completed tools. Validate counters/retire withdrawn attempts. Real removal restores adjacent action/composer focus unless navigation moved it.20appends over100/10000archived items must read zero historical ordinals.

Placement touches changed membership/registration,retaining borrowed DOM/focus/selection/prepend anchors. Tail inspection checks blockers without old-row geometry;immediate disclosure avoids unused measurements.

Reuse block classification while final/intermediate/live/outcome stays current;Computer candidates subscribe to relevant targets only. Observed wire window is distinct from retained reading document:wire-only changes cannot rebuild archive/rescan ordinals. Actual ownership/order/coverage/lifecycle publish atomically. Canonical order needs linear check;out-of-order receipts/decorations stable-sort with uncommitted tail intact. Compare unchanged source ranges before copying groups/partitions. Sparse keyed facts visit fewer source keys rather than broadcast absence;updates/removals synchronous. Regressions:2400rows/100partitions,reversed input/decorations,600sparse subscribers,600groups+append.

DOM mutation reads no offsets/extents. Nested-tail/disclosure joins existing before-paint pass;explicit reopen restores follow,transferred anchors retain offset. Capture native input offset before default action. Same-run snapshots retain presentation/equal collections;wire replacement cannot rebind every retained layout controller. New execution gets prefix-validated presentation. Content advances on text owner.

The shared Flower scroll controller consumes native reading movement exactly once before either scroll-event or before-paint layout processing advances its offset baseline. Offscreen range contraction cannot undo downward input or expire observed momentum before `scrollend`. Reading-anchor movement and tail-follow admission are separate: preserve the existing strict bottom/extent checks. Late content still corrects the same reader after input ends. These product-specific anchors belong to Redeven's shared Flower owner, not Floret storage or an unused Floe chat hook.

Measure history gaps after accepted membership in same batch while old DOM mounted;only removed interior rows contribute height,preserved/appended rows need no historical geometry. Keep gap/virtual anchors. Running turns cannot fold;inspect protection runs when eligible,retaining terminal focus/selection/manual choices. Row registration cannot enumerate unchanged groups.

Published createIncrementalMarkdownParser owns Marked/CJK/GFM:reset full baseline,append regions,finish complete correction. Changed snapshot resets;reuse only exact token identity/offsets,same-source metadata retains regions. Completion/collapse/replacement retains all authored blocks. [Code](flower-code-highlighting.md),[diagrams](markdown-diagrams.md),[media](flower-inline-media.md) keep separate ownership.

## Text/layout
New prose fades currentColor320ms through20fixed CSS highlights,no node splits/layout/delivery delay. History/corrections immediate,links/code/media keep ink. No stylesheet/computed-style/per-frame inline work. Bound32groups/owner,diff8192chars/128nodes per region;larger immediate. Completion settles;reset/dispose/hidden/reduced-motion/forced-colors clears. Hot drag/resize settles ink while text/selection/DOM stay live;only later arrivals animate. Historical/unsupported APIs schedule nothing.

Both hosts pin Tailwind's Lightning CSS optimizer to 1.33.0 through matching npm/pnpm overrides. Version 1.32.0 warns on valid `::highlight()` selectors. Keep all 20 phase colors through optimization and minification; do not suppress warnings or disable optimization. `scripts/flower_streaming_css.test.mjs` exercises each installed Tailwind plugin's optimizer in both modes; host gates select their own cases.

Cold sealed bodies stage across reconnect then reveal final geometry without height motion;sample table/code/list/text from first frame. Other prose stays incremental. Font completion/error listeners dispose,not detached ready promises. Companion reads latest relevant record/bounded Unicode tail. Measured offscreen sections retain DOM with content-visibility:auto/intrinsic height;near/live/focused/selected explicitly visible. Intersection controls measurement,never paint admission:scrollbar jump must paint before callback,including compositor/native-wheel blank-frame checks. Existing scroll owner corrects before paint.

## Queue/verification
One ordered queue applies reactive batches;cooperative4ms includes reactions,yields between envelopes,never preempts one. Catch inside batch to publish recovery before rethrow. Ready waits drain,other reads pause16frames/1MiB;epoch/failure/dispose releases/fences.

Coalesce contiguous one-item append only with exact thread/item/turn/run/reading revision/same attempt except time/monotonic progress. Keep semantic boundaries/clears,join once preserving UTF8/version;gap rejects pending batch/one sync error. Bounds64frames/4MiB/250ms or75ms hot interaction. Semantic timer may replace stalled rAF,never overtake growth. Accept one32MiB envelope+reserve with backpressure. Diagnostics timing/kind/structural counts only,including slowest envelope;no content. Copy success1.6s,denial never success.

Real-Service qualifier freezes history/cadence,measures Runtime/Electron CPU/allocation/wire/frame/input/click/output then verifies every prose/thinking item via actual disclosure against canonical content. [Long-thread](../operations/flower-long-thread-gate.md) owns sustained/floating acceptance;explicit suites outside unified gates. Synthetic post-timing mutation samples prove no provider/encryption/peak-memory guarantee.

Structured response_validation after response.completed retains arrived content with localized final-verification failure,collapsed copyable safe conflict details. Peer text stays literal,no automatic retry. Accepted source-only hosted-search variation creates no error card. Both hosts retain complete identical catalogs.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Task presentation
The parent header replaces the numeric robot badge with at most three circular canonical portraits and a separate `+N` remainder.

Loading and read failures stay in that slot; long names truncate without wrapping. Touch targets and enlarged fonts retain stable row geometry. Creation failures retain their error details.

The existing field reader remains the sole read owner. Header rendering adds no request, polling, measurement loop, or child-detail prefetch. Portraits use bundled SVG selected by canonical `thread_id`. An identity without authorized parent membership remains informational; only the existing parent inventory enables child navigation. Name-only targets use the same compact capsule without inventing a portrait or navigation identity, including deferred fields and creation failures. Creation titles contain only the action; the capsule owns the task name and its full tooltip.

[Subagent detail window](#detail-window) owns complete current-view reads, live replacement, Activity rendering, child navigation, and queued-input controls.

## Detail window
The detail GET returns exactly `{ summary, current }` and accepts no paging query. Child currents use the same bounded unsent-text coalescing and transient browser-frame rules as roots, described by [live current transport](flower-live-timeline.md).

The window stacks three in-flow regions: a facts band, the transcript region, and an optional run-progress footer. The footer is a sibling of the transcript region, never an overlay, so a live run indicator can neither cover message text nor change the transcript's measured top and height. The footer centers one fixed-width pill under the window's inline center; [received output progress](flower-output-progress.md#output-progress) owns the pill's stability rules.

Floret remains the lifecycle owner described in [Subagent runtime](../ai/subagent-runtime.md#child-runtime).

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Flower must not recover a missing child identity from activity sidecars, a title, a delegated approval alias, a fallback thread id, or local state.

The dropdown lists tasks only. The empty trigger uses Floe's outline Workflow
icon; canonical portrait stacks remain for existing agents. Empty dropdowns use
a compact text row without an oversized illustration or placeholder card. The published
SurfaceAnchoredLayer owns measured placement, local surface boundaries and
viewport updates, with a six-pixel gap. Never position from an estimated menu
width. Shared floating presence retains entry/exit motion and disables exiting
content; shared overlay masking owns outside dismissal. Arrow/Home/End navigation
and Escape focus restoration remain product task-list semantics.

The detail window must not infer membership from activity, poll for updates, switch the selected parent conversation, persist a second transcript, or replay uncertain effects. [Subagent detail presentation](#task-presentation) owns parent membership, task labels, dropdown and operation capsules.

concepts.title: Flower terminal activity presentation
concepts.summary: Flower renders canonical Floret Activity with host task labels and safe details for every terminal operation, including writes/empty reads. Disclosure/scroll are ephemeral; no stdin/private paths/effect internals or invented lifecycle. An omitted output field is pending content, never an empty canonical frame with a nonzero first sequence.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Terminal facts
Floret owns the nested `ActivityItem.presentation` contract and merges results with their stable call presentation. Labels and descriptions are authoritative; the typed operation supplies localized fallback text.

The five-line independently scrolling output viewport retains its existing owner.

Wait for small-field hydration before polling or installing its sequence; large fields use source-bound ranges, then acknowledge their watermark before adding process deltas. Existing output and selection survive handoff.

Published Floret v7.95.0 atomic activity reads own the bytes, sequence range, process identity and deferred source together. Flower never stamps a newer summary's range onto previously accepted bytes. Canonical activity status remains current independently. Check execution identity and range before publishing optional details; retain accepted output on failure. One in-flight read coalesces revisions; failure latches until explicit Retry, visibility reentry or connection change. Collapsed/offscreen rows do not read. No additional backend scan, transcript snapshot or transport contract is introduced.

Malformed process output stops its local poll and exposes a localized read-only Retry without raw diagnostics; other messages and stream observation continue. Canonical stream validation still fails at its existing connection boundary. Write acknowledgements never apply hidden output frames. Equal-watermark snapshots may fill an empty frame or extend its earlier coverage, but duplicate/older snapshots cannot replace a newer live suffix.

Inactive output caches have 200-entry / 8 MiB estimated-byte limits. Mounted outputs remain retained until release; frame metadata coalesces after 128 records without changing sequence checks. These cache limits do not truncate an active process output or its canonical history.

## Output, completion and restart
The model keeps four tools: terminal_exec/read/write/terminate. Read/write/terminate
descriptions are optional; read uses the last returned sequence. Each page is
bounded without an outer second truncation, and chunk boundaries preserve UTF-8.
The process retains at most 1 MB; gaps and invalid source encoding remain explicit.

Redeven binds the process identity to Floret before Start. Confirmed completion
seals bounded output and result facts through Floret, then supplies one bounded
notice at provider preparation or a natural idle continuation. Explicit final
reads suppress duplicate delivery. The original execution's model, tool scope,
reasoning and budgets are retained; cumulative budgets still apply per run.

Shutdown suspends new execution, reaps owned processes and persists observed
results before closing Floret. Abnormal exit preserves unknown outcomes without
replaying commands, resending stdin or adopting PIDs. Historical output reads
use authorized thread/process identity. Unknown observations stop UI polling;
readable sealed output remains paginated. Final Activity updates the original
item through Floret's canonical presentation sources.

## Interaction boundary
[Activity disclosure interaction](flower-activity-interaction.md) owns stable triggers, manual choices, animation, transcript following, and floating controls across all renderers. Approval state is never a row badge, chip, metadata line, title suffix, tooltip, detail, or ordinary activity ARIA label. Completing a decision removes that dock without inserting an approval outcome into history.

Floret v7.103.0 exposes unknown as a terminal Activity status and attention reason.
Flower preserves its count, keeps the row outside successful/active sequences,
uses a localized warning label, and retains readable historical output. The row
does not imply success or authorize command retries. An unknown observation is
not active polling work; available retained pages may still be read to completion.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:

Presentation never changes Floret status, ordering, persistence, read acknowledgement, audit state, or terminal settlement.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Selection and navigation
Rail feedback precedes commit by two animation callbacks plus a task; hidden documents skip frames. Latest intent supersedes work; summaries cannot bypass it. Reveal after baseline/handoff, measurable layout and visible history settle, never runtime quiet. Cached windows renew bounded interest only when needed. Cancellation cannot release newer selection.

No smooth initial positioning/timer fallback. One cancellable200ms feedback deadline spans reads/layout without delaying ready/error. Navigation/new chat/disposal cancels feedback; frame/composer persist, body failures retry locally. Cached destinations flush effects and check contentVisibilityAuto. ResizeObserver corrects above-viewport growth before paint; rAF/visibility handles reveal. No polls/per-row observers. Explicit wheel/touch/scrollbar/keyboard pauses follow, not mere scroll events. Two slots prioritize visible/margin bodies, cancel stale demand and reuse ThreadCache immutable content. Growth/refresh/completion preserves text/selection. [Live delivery](flower-live-timeline.md) owns retry. Open Latest; restoration is separate. Sort creation descending then ID ascending.

## Continuous history and concurrent activity
Native scrolling reads bounded canonical windows, preserving visible/focused/selected rows, details and anchors through live updates. Collapsed short tails retain prepend room until outside view/filled; resize corrects anchors, destination preparation clears temporary geometry. Attach observation after mount and correct before paint without new reads/disclosures.

Latest sits above composer away from actual tail, including historical-window bottom, and hides during preparation. Installed tail scrolls smoothly and retires room on arrival; otherwise cancel old demand, install one bounded tail interest and reveal without page walking. Root/child share this owner. Reading/observer revisions admit baselines; equal canonical versions cannot deduplicate distinct membership. Full-view watermarks cannot suppress reading baselines; retire stale refresh markers without touching newer interest/budgets.

Collapsed skip-and-retain lets one gesture cross advancing folded-only pages until readable dialogue/canonical edge. Preserve page item/byte caps; stop on no progress, failure, disclosure or newer navigation. Explicit disclosure immediately shows cached rows then completes only its sequence with one request/document,40records/page, finite horizon. No replacement observer/full-content button. Delay geometry-neutral indicator150ms; cancellation hides it, only failure exposes Retry. Disclosure/thread/child/Latest cancels obsolete gaps; headers follow canonical order and transfer focus.

Tools/reports retain previews. Existing owner reads authorized bodies; collapse/navigation/disposal cancels unused demand, reconnect restores consumers. Empty Activity uses upstream defaults/source order. Unknown tool outcomes stay localized/readable, never success/retry/malformed. Published source-backed summaries avoid full tool enumeration; Runtime document owns live records/versions. No universal latency/expanded-output memory guarantee.

## Detail read ownership
Floret owns summaries/windows/bodies. ThreadCache has12entries and one bounded coordinator for navigation, command confirmation and reference preflight; cancellation never reconnects workspace stream.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Published Floret source locators reduce execution preparation reads. Host retains windows/visibility/input state; older-history first-use preparation yields between cancellable transactions, separate from transcript readiness and never permission for full-history UI reads. Qualification uses checksummed published modules, no sibling wiring. Vocabulary-scoped digest-only token cache changes no attribution/budgets/storage.

[Sidebar](flower-thread-sidebar.md) owns rows/rename/pending/pins; detail completion never marks unseen content read. View/Summary remain upstream. summary_unavailable preserves known history read-only; cold selection invents no detail/title/time, late marker cancels preparation, healthy replacement restores selection. Transient failures retain demand with capped backoff; elapsed time cannot fail connected slow reads.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Resizing
One220–380CSSpx desktop preference updates grid at most once/frame; overlay/mobile/companion/embedded sizes remain separate. Primary-pointer gesture settles on release/cancel/capture loss/blur/layout/unmount, cleans resources and saves once; keyboard saves immediately. Storage failure cannot break input or reparse Markdown/history.

## Rename from the conversation header
Pencil edits existing ThreadID during loading/execution with selected canonical title. Header/sidebar share save/cache ownership.

## Selection and detail reads
[Selection](flower-thread-selection.md) owns commitment/bounded reads/cancellation; sidebar reserves feedback, ThreadCache owns committed detail.

## Reference action
Right-click/More/Shift+F10 share a ThreadID menu; [references](flower-composer-references.md#thread-references) owns dedupe/preview/admission.

## Context menu response
First-frame complete menus use compact published tokens/44px touch targets. One ResizeObserver provides client border box; SurfaceFloatingLayer clamps without replacing focus. Truncated paths keep hover text. Destructive text uses error ink/10% tint; disabled stays disabled. Links/editors/previews/terminals retain their menus.

## Pending replies and approvals
Localized labels sit beside title within bounded progress width; updates require no selection.

## Pin ordering
Stable .flower-thread-rows owns actual/skeleton inline size; movable cards are not size containers. Keyboard/search/overlay order matches. Both views have one globally ranked pin region spanning directories; never duplicate pins. Heading identifies pins without permanent decorative pin. Leading slot remains for work/unread; hover/focus/touch exposes pin. Retain row/focus, expand required batches; failure reverses only its own presentation and reconciles via stream/one command read.

## Directory view
One title row has time/directory control, workspace and refresh. At header content widths up to18rem (22.5rem for coarse pointers), both modes show only centered icons; wider headers restore localized labels. The published SegmentedControl label slot controls native and selected ink together. Full accessible names/tooltips, focus, selection and44px touch targets remain. Thresholds reserve title space and follow the local container, never window width. Groups contain unpinned rows; pin-only directories still support New. Fixed folder slot reflects aria-expanded without arrows/tree rails. Full-path search distinguishes names; counts/loading align. Six initial/six more/reset on collapse. One summary pass aggregates collapsed unpinned running/stopping waves, including unloaded batches, without header scans/polls/history. New uses directory without changing personal defaults.

Disclosure moves one measured edge through height/opacity using280ms Floe motion, correctly handling minified ms/s; early/middle frames travel and following groups stay below. Departing rows retain slots but immediately inert/hidden, then unmount. Reversal reuses height/opacity/identity; reorder motion is independent. Retain work/focus. Search/removals are immediate; mode change only brief opacity/no remount; reduced motion disables transitions.

Preferences use host storage; migrate renderer values only if absent, preserving usability on failure. Drag title (no grip/focus stop) shows folder/count and whole-group insertion line; one rAF owns geometry/preview/edge-scroll, release saves once. Escape/cancel/blur/teardown/outside release discards resources. Drag settles motion. Alt+Up/Down and touch long-press work; swipes scroll, search disables reorder.

Workspace uses published Dialog/Card/theme, independent desktop columns with no batch rebalance, fixed search and sole results scroller; narrow one column/44px. Pins participate in search; directory cards own unpinned loading/New. One owner moves rows preserving focus/waves. Selection clears obstructing filter, expands only needed group/batch and scrolls; unpin expands destination before focus transfer. Mobile reveal waits for reopened drawer; background updates never scroll.

## Stable presentation and convergence
Key rows by ThreadID/labels separately. Publish each summary batch once under revision/title rules; retain focus/menus/waves.

Require>=2 nodes in same thread/turn/run with a tool. Preserve canonical row/call/error/preview/output order; thinking moves in place. Singleton may settle prior work without overriding inspection. First canonical node owns DOM; loaded anchor preserves choice through paging. Omit thinking counts but retain content. Localized failure counts stay concise.

Exact uncertain tool errors join with complete-coverage unconfirmed counts; invalid success-with-uncertainty/uncertain parent breaks. Empty placeholders are transparent, unknown text proves no continuity. Answered input splits even latest settled group. [Read interruptions](flower-activity-interaction.md#observation-interruptions) keep grouping without failure counts; unknown effects retain unconfirmed.

Only exact boundaries/items/events permit counts in partial windows; otherwise generic localized name without partial/latest/loading totals. Known failures stay; no count-driven history/body reads. Sparse islands need accepted upstream endpoint proofs or <=8indexed reads/baseline with shared maximal results; streaming does none. Hidden prose/compaction/interactions/unknown/active/unsafe/scope changes break proofs. Ephemeral proofs retain surviving endpoints; expansion fills<=40items/page without tail resampling/retransmission.

## Disclosure and bodies
Historical defaults settle statically; only live admitted arrivals fold before prose after placement. Folded outer turns skip inner placement. Choices key Runtime/thread/tool through reconnect/navigation until refresh. Focus/selection/gestures/details/away-tail protect expansion, not reopen closed groups; only explicit disclosure/navigation does. One observer/group.

Live260ms fold ends at2rem/2.75rem coarse summary. Summary fades last100ms after140ms; pending prose stays mounted/inert/hidden then reveals160ms. Delivery continues; historical/existing/inspected/navigation/reduced-motion prose never waits. Finish titles first. Terminal outer turn owns motion and interrupted inner opacity/transform. One pending map binds prose; reversal/new motion retain choice, disposal/reduced motion release. Measure once, no per-tool timer/observer/frame-reactive state.

Closed groups mount summary/shell; first open mounts bodies, later folds keep them inert. New closed members wait; outer folds keep inspected bodies. Borrow existing DOM at first-node viewport preserving focus/selection/state. Reproject membership/status/disclosure/order only. Sealed thinking reads only visible explicitly open content via displayed node. Two-slot queue prioritizes interaction/cancels obsolete/reuses text; unopened tools read/mount none.

## Progressive completion
Only explicit opening revealing an open group completes boundaries; live groups never traverse history. Transfer anchors/focus/detail ownership before paint if first node changes; reopen positions latest tools. Immutable pages cannot overwrite new facts/bodies; mutable IDs join bounded tail. Fence thread/connection/navigation/document. Collapse cancels publication but abort-ignoring transport holds slot until settlement. Sample finite tail once; exhausted empty ends, no-progress fails, slow connected demand persists. Parent receipts reuse interval events without hidden bodies.

## Geometry and input
Titles/summaries/times13px/18px; aligned prose/icon/progress edges and permanent gutters avoid shifts/blanks, including children. Full-row target places time/chevron after intrinsic text; only long text shrinks, CSS not measurement loops. One outer left bracket/button24px/44px coarse collapses; folded summary/chevron is button. Rail remains outside scroller/before prose without row connectors/hit loops. Rows2rem/2.75rem; sequence<=8rows/65%transcript, thinking<=20rem/45%window/transcript. Short content remains natural with thin scrollbars/keyboard.

Nested native scrolling consumes local then chains at edges for thinking/tools/read-only terminal/file/diff/code. Upward wheel/touch/key pauses follow, actual bottom resumes; zoom/canceled/contained stays local, editors own input. Shared controller distinguishes user/programmatic/geometry and retains anchors. Explicit open positions latest before paint; navigation waits for destination. History is static, manual folds closed; collapse focuses trigger, thinking keeps offset/completion. [Motion](flower-activity-interaction.md#thinking-and-motion) owns arrivals.

Expose viewport IDs/localized counts without folded gaps/ineligible headers. [Turns](flower-turn-process-disclosure.md) owns automatic anchors; manual retains trigger. Both hosts support narrow/touch/focus/reduced-motion/forced-colors.

concepts.title: Flower turn submission, outbox and input recall

frontmatter.title: Flower turn submission, outbox and input recall

concepts.summary: One immutable transport outbox captures ordinary submitted text and resources before asynchronous admission. Product admission uses published SendAck and narrow canonical summaries. HTTP and RPC return admission identity without a post-commit history read; authorized window observation supplies presentation separately.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Submission
Core commands reject missing, duplicate, invalid or conflicting IDs; only the legacy RPC adapter may fill a missing one. [Goals](../ai/flower-goals.md) share the outbox. Empty-thread creation retains text/reference/attachment authority; first Send binds staged resources to the authorized canonical thread. Unknown effect outcomes are terminal with safe explanation and no replay action.

### Immediate send feedback
The immutable transport outbox owns submitted text, references and attachment
metadata before IndexedDB or HTTP completes. Ordinary sends render a pending
user row immediately and consume only the captured draft; newer edits stay in
the composer. Request-key message and section identities survive canonical
admission, including receipt/live ordering and prepended history. Images reserve
the same thumbnail geometry and use the authorized staged preview until admitted.
Failed and unknown outcomes retain the frozen request for explicit recovery;
server 5xx responses never prove rejection or authorize a fresh request identity.

Composer-origin failures remain under their original transcript row with a
visible explanation and persistent recovery actions; they are not duplicated in
the queue dock. Queue-origin failures keep their existing dock placement.
Workspace-unavailable codes receive localized copy without internal paths.
Retry retains the request identity; copy, restore and removal never auto-submit.

Agent preparation binds the
already persisted execution authority to the admitted turn. No duplicate
post-admission authority write or second conversation lifecycle is introduced. Full model history remains an engine execution requirement, not a prerequisite
for painting the submitted message.

### Restored data and preserved inputs
New submissions capture storage generation immediately, even behind paused dispatch. Rejected input stays copyable/restorable; running it requires explicit new submission, never resumed old approvals/effects.

### Context preview presentation
A new contextual invocation restores editor focus even when the card is already open, preserving its draft and insertion point while raising it above the reactivated source window. Mobile file dialogs use the product-modal band; Ask Flower and its reference inspector use successive higher bands below the command menu. Do not fix ordinary desktop activation by giving all cards a permanently higher layer.

One Env App `FlowerContextPreviewWindow` uses existing preview/text components for launcher and draft/canonical snapshots. Launcher owns attachment IO, sequencing and URL cleanup; Flower owns validity. Related-surface markers preserve input ownership; Escape dismisses preview before companion.

## Input recall
### Candidates and ownership
Only selected-thread canonical ordinary user messages qualify, never metadata, secrets or structured answers. [Composer references](flower-composer-references.md#reference-drafts) owns draft scope.

### Keyboard interaction
Unmodified ArrowUp in an exactly empty textarea recalls newest eligible text. Whitespace counts as a nonempty draft. Thread changes reset history browsing while retaining each draft.

### Presentation
Contextual PromptCard has no placeholder and opens with the real editor caret; ordinary conversation composers retain their localized concise placeholder. Recall restores no attachments or canonical mutations.

## Latest sent message editing

[Message editing](flower-message-editing.md) reuses the composer with a separate draft, preserves complete resources and submits an immutable canonical revision. Opening or canceling does not stop execution; unknown submission retains the exact key for explicit Retry.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Composer drafts and the transport outbox own only unconfirmed browser input, stable request identity, and presentation-only launch settings. They never become authorization evidence or canonical queue, interaction, effect, turn, Thread settings, or Agent lifecycle state. Secret answers bypass the outbox, and canonical confirmation or terminal cleanup removes transport state instead of projecting a second durable command.

Recall never submits, changes canonical messages, restores attachments or overwrites a nonempty draft. Scope, availability, candidate or external-draft changes end browsing while preserving current text.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Facts and eligibility
[Published turn kinds](../ai/flower-upgrade-compatibility.md#turn-kind-consumer-contract) distinguish host-work completion from user turns. Retain its answer/identity/timing through paging/observation. Diagnostics expose safe field/reason only. Unknown prose stays visible.

Headers show total elapsed including waits; terminal descriptions retain work/wait durations, <=two nonzero units and subsecond copy. Thinking-only work has its own disclosure, not whole-turn toggle. Interleaved answers default open. Settled questions/answers fold with process rows, preserving choices and viewport-contained decoration without rails/gaps. Counts require complete membership/events/boundaries; otherwise omit. [Sequences](flower-tool-sequences.md) fold independently on each side.

## Ownership
Canonical admission shows a noninteractive header for preparing/running/retrying/finalizing/waiting before provider output. Politely announce status, never ticks. Exact terminal outcome/end permits toggle and one automatic process/intermediate fold, including latest failed/canceled/interrupted turns; final/trailing partial output stays.

Focus/selection/gestures/details/open thinking/away-tail reading permanently protect inspected work from automatic folding. Capture an unaffected anchor at fold start. Explicit choices survive paging/reconnect/regrouping; newly classified inspected rows remain until explicit toggle without opening siblings. Only disclosure/navigation reopens. Retained folded bodies are inert with offsets/choices intact. Main/embedded/child views share rendering, never scroll owners.

## Placement and motion
Place header after loaded request or before first loaded response independently of membership; retain both during arrival. Engine owns cross-run intermediate supersession; Goals are turn-owned, finals run-scoped. Confirmed prefix facts survive; overlapping windows replace classification. Partial presentation never fetches history. Prepending request moves header but preserves focus/choice.

One-line status/time/detail slots retain geometry, tabular digits and narrow overflow. Followed folds align actual bottom before paint without stale offsets/synthetic tail/competing motion; long-to-short ends at zero with final visible. Finals remain mounted during260ms fold; reduced motion is immediate. Paused/manual reading keeps anchors/insertion room excluded from Latest distance. User input cancels follow; settlement cannot reclaim it.

Fresh visible labels fade0.68→1/180ms, later labels0.88→1/160ms. Keep full label readable without clipping/blank/overlap/character queue. Fast completion joins current transition; one JSX text owner and at most one opacity animation survive wrapper→button. Accessibility/control/geometry update immediately; ticks never replay motion. History/restoration/reconnect/urgent/reduced-motion states are immediate. Hide/interaction settles motion.

Terminal outer folds own pending prose release/nested geometry, adopting interrupted inner painted opacity/transform. Manual reversal preserves preferences. Canonical Path, never timestamps, orders dialogue/receipts; retain final segments/redaction.

## Elapsed time
Current server samples establish monotonic browser anchors across waits/continuations. Without a sample show status only; wall/queue clocks grant no timing. New samples reanchor after sleep/reconnect without moving live time backward; canonical terminal time wins. Store only in bounded detail cache, not summaries/wire/storage/events.

Only visible active headers subscribe to existing one-second clock. Hidden/offscreen/disconnected/terminal headers unsubscribe. Ticks change time only, never projection/counts/folds/network. Reconnect waits for transport confirmation, without extra polling.

## Outcome
Use13px/20px labels and decorative16px Floe warning/circled-stop/circled-alert, quiet color and wrapped-first-row alignment. Keep localized accessibility; do not duplicate outcome in diagnostics/recovery.

## Header and new-conversation entry points
The full-page header has a borderless folder/name browse button; new-conversation welcome selects the draft directory without persistent full-path secondary text. Only picker confirmation remembers a validated real directory. Browsing, cancellation, suggestions and destination navigation never write it; created-thread directories remain immutable.

## Directory and menu ownership
Right-click captures its row's thread/directory without loading, selecting or acknowledging it. Updates cannot retarget actions; handled child events cannot open outer menus. Copy/cancel restores valid triggers without scrolling.

They never expose directory Favorite or Unfavorite actions; thread pinning remains a separate conversation action. Directory favorites belong to filesystem surfaces and the directory picker.

Menu actions use concise localized verbs without repeating the conversation or working-directory context: "Reference", "Copy ID", "Open folder", "Open terminal", "Copy path", "Copy", "Pin"/"Unpin", "Stop", and "Delete". The directory section retains its target path; permission explanations and deletion confirmations stay explicit. Env App and Desktop share the same labels in every shipped locale.

Directory actions retain real icons and aligned labels. Their current labels fit one line in every shipped locale; longer future labels can wrap within the menu instead of introducing horizontal scrolling. Browser visual acceptance uses the published icons and floating layer.

## Destination behavior
Activity Files reuses its singleton window/geometry; Terminal creates a new session. Workbench creates the matching widget. Request IDs, lazy loading, terminal admission and layout persistence retain ownership. Created-thread browsing includes ThreadID; menu/terminal actions require it.

## Availability and recovery
Browsing and Terminal availability are separate. Disabled reasons/errors are explicit; rejected terminal paths cannot silently fall back to Home. Existing transport, process, authorization and persistence owners remain; Flower adds no queue, lifecycle mirror or retry owner.

frontmatter.title: Git workspace generations, diffs and visual state

concepts.summary: Exact client capabilities and monotonic generations fence Git inventory/diffs/filesystem decoration. Retain shell/navigation with panel-local loading/errors; Files navigation never waits for Git. Nested file references and effects use JSON-only transport.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Generations and effects
Use workspace-v1 only after exact client confirms revision/path-status/directory-scope/stash-section capabilities. Replacement retires old generations/replies. Files avoids unbounded legacy reads; Files→Workspace starts fresh generation before section/scope. Committed repository/path identity fences facts; bound replacements while retaining committed decoration. Distinguish index/worktree/untracked/conflict/stash identities.

One `GitWorkspaceInvalidationBus` invalidates every dispatched effect in finally, including failures/unknown transport; validation/preview never invalidate. Encoders omit absent optional fields before Flowersec JSON-only APIs, preserving false/empty strings/literal paths; later JSON serialization does not excuse undefined fields. Do not relax upstream validation.

Actions retain directory and section scope. Totals cover descendant files; browsing omits repetitive folder counts. Commit review always loads staged root because commit affects whole index; incomplete line counts are not zero. Deletion previews every consequence, including branch-only entry. Any worktree blocker disables safe/force confirmation before merged-state checks. Localize primary/locked/nested blockers; retain removal/discard authorizations, including ignored-only files.

Public codes produce localized permission/stale/resource/rejection/unknown guidance without private diagnostics. Unknown outcomes require refresh/review, no automatic replay. Keep legacy code 41304 reserved/localized: retired full-tree deletion-inspection limit differs from transient pressure and waiting alone does not fix oversized trees.

## Diffs and persistence
Inline/Activity/Workbench/dialog share one diff owner. Snapshot patches are previews; refresh/authoritative empty/failure cannot revive them. Runtime owns first-parent meaning. Workbench persists placement targets, not summaries; equal target fields preserve requests/full context/expansion/scroll through unrelated updates. Workspace refresh retains same-request patch/full-context paint until authoritative success/empty/error; client changes never retain it. Other inspections retain fresh-summary semantics. Disconnect is not missing file; confirmed absence settles empty, errors retain recovery.

## Tree workspace
Files/Git switch keeps one native button pair; Solid Portal moves it between matching top-row slots and restores trigger focus. Forward slot callbacks through wrappers and resolve JSX once before testing/rendering; detached duplicate slots cannot own controls. Narrow Files keeps it above directory drawer. Repository/sync shares top row; full-width Git navigation spans both panes, never separate sidebar/drawer. Divider resizes rail and matching mode slot. One published Floe Tabs owns all four items, keyboard navigation and sliding indicator; immediate activation delegates timing to the host. Embedded stash content has 12px toolbar separation. Branch/history selectors follow navigation; narrow detail uses retained list/detail/back. Pending navigation hides stale content until destination commit; stash dismissal joins that commit, including same-view returns. Narrow navigation scrolls without overlap.

Changes defaults All over bounded Changes/Staged/Conflicted pages. Filters preserve scope; same-path index/worktree selection stays exact. Initial All reads serialize through existing owner; refresh revalidates nonempty or invalidated sections, mutations join the invalidation refresh owner, client/repository replacement cancels remainder. Errors offer retry. Rail owns search/collapsed trees/scope actions/commit draft; draft never bypasses whole-index review.

Stashes opens within full-width workspace navigation using existing owner/review/draft; contextual stash inspection may float. Unified/side-by-side and patch/full-context are independent retained choices. Replacement pairing preserves blank sides/line numbers/context without changing authoritative reads.

Workspace/worktree/history/comparison/stash share tree adapter. Folders start collapsed. Collapse-all uses inward-chevron, is enabled only for expanded folders and clears forced-expansion filtering. Mouse rows 24px, indent 12px, headings 28px; coarse controls >=44px. Exact paths/rename targets/section/stash identities own actions; expansion never retargets. Arrows move/expand/collapse, Enter/Space opens; keyboard/menu handoff captures target. Modified/added/deleted/renamed status inks remain separate from selection.

Expansion reads bounded pages without replacing root/scope or inserting skeleton rows. Busy state remains accessible; errors retain retry. Client/repository/worktree/generation/section/path/revision fence replies. Refresh retires read authority while retaining painted nodes by section/path and revalidates expanded pages at offset zero. Section generations avoid unrelated reloads; repository/client changes clear retained state. Never append stale offsets. Stale revisions refresh without replay; failed pages retry the same offset. Search matches loaded paths, leaving unread folders navigable; no silent full scan.

Native constrained tree viewport owns both scroll axes, allowing natural indentation/full names. Floe persistent horizontal scrollbar stays reachable; tabs/filter/draft/diff do not scroll with tree. Mode/narrow navigation retains tree DOM/scroll. Draft heading shows staged count and optional whole-index line totals; unavailable totals remain absent. Commit always opens whole-index confirmation.

## Presentation
Navigation/branches/history/summaries/files use ring-derived interaction roles independent of text selection or semantic status. Neutral hover never masks selection. One measured owner fits graph rails/connectors/nodes/columns without moving summaries or changing selection/actions. Shared retained file/diff navigation retires stale targets after filter/remove/section/commit changes. Branch refresh is not append loading; pagination uses one retained control without decorative skeletons. Narrow/workbench scrolling stays contained.

All themes define full interaction roles; forced colors expose focus/selection/Current boundaries. Select whole rows with no colored left rail; keyboard/system-color states use inset outline. Files/Git disabled reason appears below tabs through Floe floating layer, unobscured from first animation frame in normal/projected hosts; wrap within viewport and dismiss on exit.

Avoid decorative rails/empty subtitles. Branches expose selected state; shared typography/dialog/button/input/textarea own sizing/material/focus/presence. Dialog has one footer divider/padding; window-local stash supplies equivalent. Narrow bodies scroll with actions reachable. Nested desktop diff modes stay 28px; toolbars wrap complete controls and coarse targets remain 44px. Restrained warning/danger tint meets 4.5:1 in every built-in theme. Deletion has one consequence summary/localized safe-delete guidance, technical diagnostics disclosed. Exact-name confirmation has one field/copy action. Keep confirm button identity; pending deletion retains reviewed fields/consequences while disabling edits/dismissal. Reduced motion removes row travel, preserves shared modal rules.

Layout persistence proves no freshness and cannot change inline/Activity/Stash semantics. Themes may vary hue, never substitute status colors/fixed foreign palette or Current for selection.

Ordinary inputs, textareas, and native selects consume Floe's default rule. Focus never changes border width, padding, or dimensions.

Flower's transcript viewport retains keyboard focus for scrolling and its context menu, but paints no outer focus outline or shadow: the clipped scroll boundary must not turn Floe's generic focus ring into a horizontal line above the composer. This exemption belongs only to the transcript viewport; its interactive descendants retain their keyboard indicators.

Desktop Welcome, Env App, and Flower consume the same released Floe dependency. Product selectors may define normal and hover appearance without duplicating Floe's focus rules. Flower's persistent chat composer maps the published `--floe-input-focus-color` token to its existing field edge, keeping focus handoffs and thread switches visually quiet, including forced colors. Approval and input-request fields retain their ordinary focus behavior. It does not copy CSS rules or load the full renderer stylesheet into that document.

## Type roles and boundaries

Buttons take their height, padding, radius and type size from the published `size` primitive: `icon` for square icon actions, `md` for ordinary text actions, `lg` where a 36px target was already intended. Do not re-impose heights on top of `size`, because the merge helper lets a passed class silently defeat the primitive and neighbours diverge. Ordinary rows use 30px, with the terminal navigator retaining its documented 32px rows. Coarse pointers use 44px rows/targets, 14px body and at least 16px fields; focus changes only the existing border color.

Mixed-script Markdown at 434px/758px must fit within 90% of the frozen reference height. Compare matching content/dimensions; another product's screenshots do not establish CSS measurements.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Lazy imports and visibility scheduling keep diagram engines out of initial assets and avoid rendering offscreen history. No Mermaid.js runtime, alternate-engine fallback, private renderer, sibling import, package link, patched Pele or copied upstream implementation. Shared fixes land in Floe and reach both hosts through a new published release.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Page continuity
Retain initial presentation until authoritative data or actionable error; inventory loading is separate from mutation/attachment/maintenance/plugin execution. Use existing action indicators, accessible out-of-flow status or geometry-neutral overlays. Pending/stale/failed/recovered states add no rows or width changes; an empty reserved status lane is not a workaround.

Use structural placeholders and bounded responsive bodies with reachable header/close/footer, published Floe components and no arbitrary delay/height animation. Runtime/resource/source identity scopes retention; replacement/access loss fences late replies. Preserve same-resource drafts, but submit only with current readiness/permission. Unknown Runtime is pending, not missing. Library initialization cannot erase a selected canvas card before arrival. Failed preview shows the requested path/retry, never previous-file content.

Host Apps/Services/Containers/Codespaces use shared frames and [resource snapshots](env-resource-cache.md). Files keeps workspace chrome until first directory response. Terminal/Monitoring retain content after initial catalog/sample/error; metrics are not inventory. Settings/Flower/Tessiven/Plugin Center/plugins share module status with feature-owned readiness. ENV_PAGE_PRESENTATIONS exhaustively maps Activity/Workbench BuiltinActivityPage loading/reload; [filesystem navigation](filesystem-picker-navigation.md) retains security.

## Connection continuity
Admitted same-resource workspaces stay mounted and locally usable through recoverable transport loss, including drafts/panes/plugin drawers. Compact accessible status exposes stop/resume/retry and optional details. Current session/permission still gates remote commands; unavailable HTTP never queues a later mutation. Initial loading, revoked access and terminal recovery failures remain blocking. No completion-overlay delay.

## Asynchronous layout
Published Button owns spinner/icon; StableText includes every localized transient/result label. Preparation body scrolls independently of fixed actions. Unknown images use bounded 16:9 contain regions; diagrams/errors scroll in reserved viewports. Template refresh retains label/icon slot, uses warning/spinner, and exposes failure details out of flow plus live description; Retry is the same button. Empty catalogs stay empty during refresh. Reserve scrollbar gutters, not status lanes.

## Reload geometry
Install independent Floe reload-placeholder in HTML head before modules/styles. It stores no HTML/content/images/inputs/URLs/permissions and invents no resource count. Shared page registry and [Activity restoration](activity-navigation-restoration.md) own eligibility/selection; fresh data may change final layout.

## Asset recovery
Published createDocumentAssetRecovery captures entry URLs and exposes unobtrusive updated/unavailable notice with explicit reload. Preserve authenticated route; never retain old bundles, rewrite names or serve HTML as JavaScript.

Import/build failures cannot auto-reload over drafts or change authentication/process identity.

## Proposed experience
Use canonical Flower/source activity and actual platform phase/elapsed time. Before an artifact, show one quiet placeholder; Checks exposes bounded logs. No estimated percentage, permanent console, extra header or focus change. Only an admitted sandbox-ready artifact replaces it. Later builds retain the working iframe/input; Apply respects unsaved-data close authority and exact comment artifact/frame binding.

Distinguish failure, interruption, cancellation, approval and stale/disconnected observation. Reconcile the same attempt without replay; elapsed time proves no hang. Existing cancellation retains the good preview. Keep 12–13px theme-aware text, 44px phone actions, stable focus/panes, polite phase announcements and reduced-motion meaning. Hidden views stop rendering and reconcile on return.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
## ReDevPlugin owns progress
Publish upstream before consumption; proposed fields are not final API names. Bind opaque attempt identity to authenticated owner/workspace, monotonic revision, timestamps, actual/completed/skipped phases, outcome and exact artifact. Emit real boundaries with bounded output/queues/flush frequency and explicit truncation; buffering is not failure.

Persist snapshots/outcomes, coalesce logs, isolate slow observers and mark unfinished work interrupted after restart. Start with authenticated snapshots; add cursor observation only for measured latency needs under platform Execution/Event conventions. Gaps reconcile from snapshots; stale/duplicate/reordered events cannot roll back state. Preserve cancel/delete/process authority, exact package admission and complete validated milestones. Render diagnostics as text; protect credentials without promising arbitrary-secret detection.

Release Go APIs, author schemas, generated clients/DTOs, fixtures, compatibility metadata, tests and signed proof together. Review Rust without another IPC/ABI axis. Platform owns migrations/recovery; no copied pipeline/local links.

## Redeven consumes and presents
Pin published artifacts and map verified facts into existing Checks/status/all locales. Flower owns edits/approvals; platform owns builds/artifacts. No derived percentage or new dispatch authority. First-artifact apply is the only automatic preview transition. Request useful milestones, not per-edit builds; finish the original task. Measure cold/warm paths before latency promises or caches.

## Acceptance and delivery order
1. Ship canvas/milestone guidance against existing APIs; prompts alone prove no delivery.
2. Qualify upstream phases, bounded output/backpressure, owner isolation, cancel/restart/concurrent reads, exact binding, failures and cursor recovery; publish.
3. Qualify first preview, slow/failing later builds, retained iframe/input/comments, reconnect, responsive themes.
4. Real model/sandbox: interact with the first milestone while work continues, comment, Apply and review install. Record request, actual work, phase, artifact and interaction separately; compare cold/warm timings. Screenshots alone do not qualify this journey.

At ReDevPlugin 3.24.1, WorkspaceStore.Build persists running status before Project.Build, then copies completed stages/commands. No progress observer exists; faster polling cannot reveal absent events. Product polls at 2.5 seconds; first artifact auto-applies, later artifacts require Apply. Checks shows completed stages/bounded logs. Decorative motion proves nothing; generation, build, sandbox readiness and acceptance remain separate.

## Open-source comparison
The November 6 comparison informed design only: bolt.diy separates actions from server/port readiness; Dyad separates refresh/restart/diagnostics; E2B Fragments executes before results; Sandpack composes preview/tests/console. No runtime/storage/sandbox/bridge/permission copying is authorized.
