sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Management
Applications uses Floe's bounded viewport portal above retained windows, anchored to the original trigger; Workbench retains local Dock material. Launching never remounts/reparents documents. Center is a lazy retained Applications page, not new Activity item/modal/drawer. It fills existing content/chrome; mode changes resize the same page. Back returns to prior surface; shell navigation leaves; Escape closes narrow details/nested dialogs. Preserve search/filter/selection/scroll through history/navigation.

Center owns catalog/install/update/remove; exact installed/preview configuration opens global Settings then returns. Lock/recovery hides retained pages for unlock; covered content remains mounted/inert, yielding Flower/plugin windows. Open leaves only after exact placement succeeds. Settings gates input/portals through exit; global confirmations sit outside transformed/inert Workbench ancestors.

Use released controls/cards/Tags/fills, no resting contours/lift/custom shadows. Floe owns focus/busy/disabled/Tabs/modal sizing. Keep primary details/actions outside scroll and disclose evidence. Source tabs equal width with ellipsis/full names; mobile targets>=44px. Progress never moves cards; long locales/themes/reduced motion remain usable. Filters retain identity; refresh stays outside grid.

## Creation and persistence
Creation/history are addressable lazy content with shell chrome, awaiting authenticated readiness. Dedicated threads stay outside ordinary lists; Back traverses detail→history→Center. Resize stable container/iframe across modes; ordinary Flower stays retained/hidden. Navigation awaits close/persistence and respects cancel. One ordinary Send; no synthetic creation prompt. Refresh preserves embedded selection.

After Send conversation width defaults280–328px; released keyboard/drag separator permits280–720px while reserving360px canvas. Save preference through Desktop bridge/browser storage without overwriting on clamp. Mobile uses tabs/named44px pane controls. Fit/phone resize same iframe. One toolbar owns sizing/comments/build/install; low-frequency permissions use overflow. Only shell header owns native drag/insets.

Embedded HTML remains source, other media/file actions remain usable; other conversations keep inline HTML. Titles prefer user, then verified preview, then localized untitled without draft rewrites. Checks expose actual stages/logs.

Cards use13px titles/12px summaries-padding/32px icons without status growth or duplicate refresh. Managers see Add plugin only in unfiltered installed/discovery grids including empty, not loading/error/update. Published menu routes creation, marketplace with cleared filters, or source review and restores focus.

History is bounded, modification-ordered with mark/title/localized time/Continue and localized-untitled search. Refresh retains records/query with explicit states. Verified artifact icons bind digest/authenticated URL before installation; absent icons are neutral. Five-second visible/focus refresh preserves keyed focus/composer. Initialize/rename persist title; legacy verified names project without durable rename.

Create is idempotent and URL-durable. Authority-free IndexedDB stores unsent text/File bytes with transaction status. Navigation awaits create/capture/save; errors/missing bytes retain page. Uncommitted snapshots protect unload. Restart flushes bounded exact-session drafts/files/comments/route across private origins, restoring before ACK/mount then authorizing reads. Never transfer grants/credentials/ports/targets or replace on failed read. Revision-bound rename/delete await the same pending create; restart resumes cleanup/admission.

## Preview and installation
Released isolated author sandbox survives conversation loading. First verified artifact may auto-apply; subsequent Apply uses normal unsaved close review. Failed build keeps good preview/accessible diagnostics. Every artifact/platform generation gets a fresh container even for equal bytes. Confirmed close plus failed update rereads authority before reopening; canceled close keeps original. Back/Forward await close/persistence. Open installed retains author route/composer/thread/preview and opens a separate creation-owned surface; stale/missing targets fail in place.

Primary action is Install, Update for newer artifact, Open for current. Inspect exact pending bytes against formal instance before preview close; successful close applies those bytes and opens same review, otherwise stop. Conflicts offer explicit localized Flower repair via outbox; preserve composer and overflow Open. New builds cannot replace reviewed bytes. Metadata/draft observers preserve composer; equal scope/revision cannot restart save feedback. Changed release bytes require higher SemVer.

Reload reconciles original install identity; unknown blocks replacement. Committed installation survives inventory-read failure; later artifacts update that instance. Only authoritative not_committed permits fresh review. Installation and grants remain separate.

## Decoration
Stationary two-scale lattice/traveling theme illumination under type specimen, three samples, strokes/chart; neutral ink plus one warm accent, no fake window/paper/cursor. Four-second clip/opacity reveal-hold-dissolve changes ink only. Actual status is separate, never inferred progress. Hidden/inactive/failure pauses; reduced-motion/forced-colors is static/fully inked. Pointer illumination settles then stops; leave/drag/scroll/blur/lifecycle clears it. Touch/pen has no hover. Decoration intercepts no input and yields to sandbox.

## Comments and recovery
Released same-channel context-menu callbacks supply reviewed artifact/generation/frame and normalized geometry, never cross-origin DOM. Noninteractive pin/outline plus measured/clamped Floe popover retain anchor; busy Send keeps height. Provide keyboard/whole-preview alternatives and44px controls, without permanent cover/header. Comments open preview; accepted submission returns conversation without iframe unmount. New text during Send keeps editor open; close retains text/focus.

Same-thread durable outbox queues independently of ordinary composer, including active runs. Submit only explicit reviewed visual context; repair/comments inherit no unrelated files/references. Pending/unknown never resubmits; handler/storage/permission/input/admission guards apply. Selectors/text are untrusted; source editing/build approval/Apply/install remain explicit. Persist only authenticated-draft text; navigation/reload/replacement/resize/app input invalidates selection, not text. Send rechecks identity. Persistence errors block unsafe leaving; deletion clears snapshots after close.

Details discovers retained data read-only, even while enabled. Date/instance suffix identifies recovery; Disable and continue requests exact Host review with retention warning. No automatic enable/hash wall. Bind owner/instance/current RW-admin rights. Refresh retains review, close aborts reads. Unknown recovery checks status; unknown disable rereads inventory without repeating writes. Completed recovery survives list failure. Native radios/Floe Dialog own focus/isolation/keyboard and mobile targets.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Package review

Multi-plugin repositories expose one selection step. No plugin signature, publisher trust badge, official-only wizard or separate client protocol exists.

Updates inspect the installed original source before presenting a candidate. Changing source requires explicit consent. Same-version changed contents and downgrades are blocked in update review. Changed revision/identity or expired inspection invalidates consent. Missing or changed security evidence requires explicit review; no market preview substitutes for current Host inspection.

Lead with verified localized identity and versions. Show access changes and saved-data conversion once; collapse technical declarations, limits, hashes and source facts. Worker/storage methods imply no broad host access.

Dialogs provide scrollable content, visible actions, keyboard focus, localization, touch targets and reduced motion. Progress retains identity. Cancellation fences late replies; source edits clear repository selection and market expectations.

One concise consent confirms the exact package. Installation enables the plugin without granting permissions. Both official and community packages direct later access decisions to installed details. Surface launch targets come only from Host `action_state` and per-Surface authority; missing permission leads to permission review, never a synthetic Enable/grant sequence.

## Installation progress

The Shell observes owner-scoped durable receipts and Execution progress. First installations can be recovered without an installed inventory row. Closing Plugin Center does not cancel admitted execution. Owner changes clear observers; reconnect restores receipts. Concurrent submits share one request, and lost replies query the same request ID.

A committed receipt remains committed even if post-commit execution or inventory refresh fails. Refresh retries only reconciliation. Unknown outcomes neither replay nor erase data. Definite failure requires a new review. Retained data uses the dedicated released recovery APIs, never automatic deletion followed by install.

Inventory refreshes share a queued read within the same turn and serialize later reads so post-mutation reconciliation cannot reuse a pre-mutation snapshot. Each result remains bound to the authenticated owner. A successful authoritative refresh retires committed-operation refresh warnings, including historical receipts whose installation is now absent; it never clears unknown effects or definite installation failures. Explicit refresh rereads installed state even if the market generation is unchanged. Completed installation stages retain their normal success presentation when a separate inventory read fails.

Both update paths close affected slots, retire authority, preserve layout and reconcile inventory through the placement coordinator. Completion offers opening only when current inventory permits it.

## Discovery and surfaces
### Discovery and pinning
Activity Bar Plugins opens Shell-root Launcher without navigation. Search intersects categories with NFKC/locale-folded names, canonical keywords and explicit locale aliases. Desktop/tablet details overlay without grid reflow. Center cards/details/pinned context menus offer Activity pins with44px touch controls; floating windows show identity/window controls only.

Environment-scoped independent Activity/Workbench pin preferences synchronize selection/accessibility, granting no launch/enable/authority. Activity unpin must finish exact retirement first; failure keeps pin/error. Other surfaces keep lifetimes.

### Recovery, installation and policy
Session-ready invokes idempotent Host recoverEnabled, no timer. Placements consume action_state; grants/source/policy/recovery cannot infer can_open. [Installation](plugin-package-review.md#installation-progress) owns durable observation and [review](plugin-package-review.md#package-review) external packages. Failure retains placement. Center joins inventory/grants/requirements/policy; effects cannot rename capabilities. Failed mutation reloads authority and needs fresh confirmation.

### Activity pages/windows
Center opens/focuses installed plugin above retained Activity page, preserving search/filter/selection/scroll and origin focus on close. Existing pinned page keeps separate slot/edits; never move its iframe. Queued opens capture placement without reversing later navigation. Workbench opens exact widget before leaving Center. Creation opens independent project-owned window in either mode, retaining route/composer/preview when hidden; mobile isolates until close. Queued creation rechecks project; eviction closes exact window only.

Allocate fresh slot only for visible placement/document; hidden unopened layouts need no iframe/authority/open/revoke. After opening starts, hiding retains independent slot/draft/selection/undo/work. Concurrent visible opens capture current context revision and deliver later changes once. Windows use openSurfaceInSlot. Bridge/open failure replaces iframe with local recovery; timeout offers Retry. Restart restores shortcuts, opens built-in page.

Equal metadata preserves container/iframe; lifecycle owns visibility. Instance/surface/management revision/runtime generation changes retire lease. Cold opening has one themed accessible wait then ready/recovery, no cycling labels. Published3.23.2 waits for replacement parser/module graph/initial SDK context before reveal; host adds no timers/paint requirements/DOM inspection.

Stable pinned component functions own wrappers; metadata/order cannot remount siblings. Published Floe retained views own isolation/order; moving an iframe can reload it. Assert inner document/draft plus container, no second keep-alive stack.

### Workbench and teardown
[Continuity](#layout-continuity) owns bindings/removal/recovery. Overlays cannot forward input/guess focus/create bridges. Workbench unpin removes shortcut only. One abort-aware FIFO confirmation starts on Cancel; hidden/retired/revoked surfaces cannot approve, retired surfaces cannot download. Shell never uploads/retains export bytes.

## Layout continuity
Open captures mode/independent slots; neither creates Center widget. workbench/actions/open_plugin atomically reuses/creates exact instance/surface. Late requests cannot lower revision/substitute surface; failed cleanup retries reconciliation, never uninstall. Containers retain identity as leases retire. Committed/unknown platform effects invalidate registry first; no close after revoke. Shell owns disconnect; authenticated inventory restores layout. Failed initial load leaves canvas unready/autosave off with Retry; saved cards require explicit reload/fresh authority.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Host and destinations
One global dialog sits beside definite-size retained work root/Flower portals, inert and accessibility-hidden through exit. Owners originate inside placement provider; moving DOM transfers no Solid context. Opening neither navigates nor starts Runtime. Desktop<=1060×760, narrow viewport-sized.

One header owns breadcrumb/mobile selector/close/generic refresh; domain refresh stays at resource. Search filters categories; roots omit Back; every resource target exposes a header Back action that clears only the resource, retains drafts and never starts or saves a runtime. Errors offer read-only Retry. Published slots/focus/Escape/dismissal apply to Welcome too. Retire mobile popup when wide breakpoint removes trigger; never measure detached header/add environment strip. Authority stays adapter-bound.

Env covers appearance/language, connection/status, terminal/browser, apps/desktop, containers/services, shell/workspace/Codespaces/tooling, permissions, Flower/extensions, plugin configuration, storage/Flower diagnostics, config/logging/debug. Center independently owns plugin catalog/install/update/remove; Settings only exact installed/author-preview configuration. Desktop groups model/defaults/extensions/browser/desktop under Flower, including search/mobile. Storage and runtime diagnostics are separate. Contextual gears share owners; Welcome setup is separate, access-gate language works before authorization.

settings/settings_resource URLs restore selection; unsupported identity shows unavailable, never substitution. Exact editors retain category drafts/unregister on domain close. Inventory needs no work surface. Closed sessions cannot revive via stale link; nested modal lifetime follows presentation/resource separately from draft/work.

## Authority and durable owners
Authority change cancels reads/fences replies; current admin/connection rights gate writes. Provider saves need no parent load and acknowledge once. Settings covers Flower read visibility through exit. Admitted installation retains Environment/incarnation across navigation; stopped/replaced Runtime rejects it.

Existing stores own appearance/language/themes/Markdown, terminal fonts/history, browser profiles/access/rate, host grants/picture, container CLI/proxy/helper/formats and Flower model/permission/directory/reasoning defaults. Shortcuts share owners; creation/session/navigation remains on work surfaces. Opening/category changes read only; Terminal settings never attaches/takes control. Font edits freshly read/CAS exact widget without moving session. Reconnect keeps drafts, invalidates confirmation. Container refresh cannot rebase edited revision; save requires explicit preflight. Exact operation lookup never permits replay; only authoritative pre-admission rejection unlocks, storage admission clears rejection marker.

Author previews bind exact workspace/preview with no installed grant/resume/replacement. Identity gates writes/portals. Viewers use authenticated preference/native opener; forwarded window cannot switch environment.

## Controls and stable interaction
Header/navigation/body share background. Published backdrop/X/Escape close without save/discard/underlying activation; nested closes top only and Flower stays expanded. Use32px controls/identity squares,12px text/quiet fill/field corners; Floe owns validation/keyboard/focus/menus. Scalar labels align without decorative icons; meaningful navigation/action/resource marks stay.

Category owns spacing/scroll. SettingsSection/List/Row forms have no extra inset/fixed viewport; hosted headings omit duplication but retain semantics/status/actions. Toolbars identify target; service/extensions use Tabs/reduced motion. Resolve JSX slots once. Compact SettingsRow language shares canonical owner. Published ThemePicker owns intrinsic/responsive choices/keyboard/theme; adapter owns persistence/admission. Leaving retires unadmitted appearance writes and reconciles admitted ones; no old popovers. Activity navigation and mobile tools open Settings; Env top bars have no settings/theme entry. Filled selection has no rails, including contrast. Model save feedback sits beside Models/host padding; stable feedback slots and truly empty headers disappear.

Narrow permission rows place identity/removal above complete checkbox labels. Edits/ceilings/deletion/resize retain surviving rows/focus; acknowledge captured revision only, newer edits dirty. Normalize without reordering, append sorted additions, retire removals, preserve focus when trimming. One identity/group, no generic introductions; retain permission/restart/zero/default/error consequences at decision, optional detail disclosed/full names accessible. Invalid container JSON stays editable with stable fields but disables preflight.

Host rows show identity/status/current action, removal in menu. Off needs feature-named confirmation and remains authoritative until success. Hide/authority loss retires intent; fresh action required on return. Current mutation owners gate grant/Wayland unattended/forget. Published SettingsDisclosure owns rounded groups/height-chevron motion/reduced motion/lazy mount/inert retained collapse/focus. Open state gates portals/permission/recovery; collapsing parent/recovery retires restart intent. Expansion grants/writes nothing. Granted state pairs success/check/text beside trailing action, readable in forced colors. Violet-window/blue-monitor SVGs distinguish app/desktop with themed instance-safe gradients.

Containers, Services and Plugin configuration use grouped lists with owner icons. Exact selectors and refresh occupy the retained category header, never repeat in lists, and retire with that category. Docker/Podman share audited theSVG brand assets with the work surface. Resource buttons have a zero minimum width so long workspace identities truncate without pushing out the fixed chevron. Duplicate service names expose workspace/instance identity; narrow headers wrap without squeezing names. Unsupported engines omit empty tabs and Save. Commit/discard require the selected source's dirty draft. Refresh preserves tabs and draft revisions and reconciles exact operations without replay. Service panels have one title; technical locks use disclosure. Idle footers are absent; dirty metadata/runtime retain save/review/apply. Plugin fields use published rows, selectors and checkboxes; Plugin Center stays independent.

Picture choice serializes complete authenticated-user record, preserving unrelated fields, no Save. Equal-width fields/stable feedback avoid movement. Failure halts queue with Retry; scope loss retires queued/late work, reopening/reads never replay. Narrow safe-area/keyboard/header bounds remain. SettingsSelect adapts lifetime/admission only; Floe renders/focuses/animates. Resource selector stays available; exact active identity gates writes. Leaving retires preflight even on immediate return; accepted work reconciles original authority.

## Browser Editor and configuration
One heading/status/refresh; embedded installer omits duplication. Selected route/primary action leads to real stages/progress/cancel/diagnostics; failure Retry/details. Ready version/source/update and selectable path/version/remove/copy disclosure retain install permission/confirmation. Show actual ports including disabled default; explain normalization ranges. Existing autosave/restart governs port/shell/filesystem/logging/permissions; PUT flat fields, not response wrappers. Runtime diagnostics retain permission and narrow geometry; obsolete full-backup browsing and restore are retired. [Extensions](flower-extensions.md) owns Skills/MCP.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Business content stays flat.

## Checkbox states
Unchecked faces remain hollow with a visible 1px control edge; checked/mixed faces use primary fill and a check/minus. Disabled faces retain the distinction. Published Floe owns this recipe and 24px/44px pointer targets. Single-line faces center within those targets; description controls retain first-line alignment. Model names and choices share the published small-control row scale and native labels with stable inputs; metadata and edit/reset actions remain independent. Acceptance checks state shape/contrast, repeated selection, focus/scroll continuity and saved intent.

## Icons
Consume Floe's icons subpath: 24-unit rounded rails,1.5-unit strokes,13% idle faces/filled selection. Desktop Activity Bar/mobile tabs pass actual active/expanded state; hover changes ink only. Monitoring uses rounded pulse/soft area, Switch Environment opposing arrows, Web Services globe. Plugin disclosure fills only while open; environment switching is momentary. Neither changes action/name/navigation ownership.

Flower's five petals meet beneath the yellow center. Navigation follows host size/state with outlined idle and filled selected petals/seams; geometry stays stable, brand/Workbench artwork unchanged. Detail masks reveal actual theme surface; forced colors use system ink. Verify live selection/disclosure/mobile editor retention and seam/icon contrast, not static SVG alone.

## Composer and layers
Expanded composer uses Floe field fill/edge as one stable writing boundary. Focus transfers among editor/toolbar/menu/thread never recolor it; internal controls retain keyboard feedback. Published Plus attachment is leftmost. Permission trigger is compact text/mode icon, no border/background/shadow even hover/open; keyboard focus underlines text.

Dedicated pages retain top editing inset and equal8px side/bottom upload/send insets. Control size sets radius; send circle stays concentric including1px border. Chat/approval/input share frame; touch targets>=44px. Companions retain panel radius/height/editor identity.

Model/permission/reasoning/More/reference/command/Goal/context/conversation layers use published material/presence. Exiting panels immediately become inert/accessibility-hidden; visual exit can reverse on reopening. Context menus keep first-frame appearance. Hover context retains content/scroll/expansion while hidden.

Slash commands use compact Floe menu rows with visible localized descriptions that wrap on narrow surfaces. One `/compact` entry requests Goal continuation when an unfinished Goal exists; pointer and keyboard selection share the same action.

Model/permission lifetimes are surface-owned across toolbar/More placement. Published anchored layers constrain/measure before first paint and resolve opening side before motion; above-composer menus travel from/back to edge, flipping travel/origin together. Reduced motion suppresses travel; no product popup-motion override. Eye/ShieldCheck/Unlock consistently identify modes, including measurement copy. Moving open controls into More retains editor/focus; reactive More updates the existing anchor before focus restoration.

Background catalog availability retains configured unavailable models, disabled for admission, without setup replacement or loss of draft/search/focus. Hidden Activity pages retain transcript gutter/toolbar allocation; apply saved rail width before visible layout and never resize composer from a zero-width hidden measurement.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## One font resolver for every terminal surface
Activity, Workbench, container exec, and settings previews consume the same font catalog and resolution result.

No fallback changes a persisted preference.

## Preferences and shared terminal geometry
Activity preferences stay on the client. Unknown saved IDs are retained and resolved through the same visible fallback; no protocol or storage-field migration is introduced.

Existing clipping and navigation apply when the canonical grid does not fit the local viewport.

## Unified settings ownership
Env App Settings → Terminal discovers catalog sessions, Workbench widgets and live container-exec attachments. Contextual gears carry exact session/widget IDs. Client defaults and shared widget fonts remain different scopes; widget writes use a fresh snapshot and its revision, preserving all session placement. A removed target never falls through to defaults. Applying current-session history requires an already-held controller, and settings never attaches or takes control. Radio groups are unique per retained target. Resolved font changes resize the existing viewport without recreating its session.

## Settings presentation
Terminal settings start with the actual resolved font and current theme preview. Narrow galleries retain one readable card column, including at 320px and 200% zoom.

sections.body:

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Stores and authority
Open versioned apps/terminal/groups.sqlite and views.sqlite before readiness; future/wrong-kind/drifted state stays unchanged. Atomically reorder full non-Default list; Default stays zero.

Thumbnails omit visible labels but keep accessible names/keyboard.

Views: terminal_view_catalog v3; RPC2024–2027 list/put/delete/notify,2028 atomic batch, process-launch/access-gate protected. Store ID/name/published SplitWorkspace geometry/occupancy/revision/timestamps. Pane empty:true means vacancy, no session claim. Limits64 views/32 panes/depth16/64KiB layout/128-byte IDs/64-character names. Validate shape/unique nodes/axis/ratio. Check touched views/catalog revision atomically; reject duplicate ownership/stale transfer. Cross-view transfer writes both and emits one snapshot; view deletion preserves PTYs.

Contiguous v1→v2 keeps session in highest-revision view, then newest creation, then lexical ID; prune older duplicate leaves/empty aliases without modifying sessions. v2→v3 validates existing records unchanged and enables vacancies. Close atomically replaces owned slot with fresh vacancy identity, retains geometry and emits catalog before closure event. Invalid stores remain untouched.

## Projection and UI
Navigation calls collection Groups. Icon-only plus matches Views with New group tooltip/name; scoped New session in {group} remains. Editors call default path Startup directory; membership never implies cwd.

One provider owns membership/order. Sessions/groups/views wait for current-channel Shell access and process permission, not transport/cache alone. Restored access hydrates; retirement fences replies and retains presentation. Late replies cannot undo moves/deletes; unknown groups refresh without reassignment. Deletion closes/hides members first; failures name sessions without guessed success/retry.

Search groups/paths/session presentation, temporarily reveal folded matches; views search names. Sidebar defaults258px, persists per environment/panel220–480px and reserves space. Floe ResizeHandle owns drag; arrows/Home/End keyboard; overlays have independent width.

Search/refresh replaces Quick switch. Desktop rows32px, larger mobile targets. Yellow Floe folder/disclosure/create/actions; rounded fill-selected session tiles, no rail. No view/group count badges; paths tooltip, secondary actions menu. Close visible hover/focus/touch; desktop24px actions/compact gap/indent, empty activity no title width. Reveal without title shift.

Rows/icons drag separately from buttons. Session preview follows scaled Workbench pointer; group preview stays sidebar. Split changes placement, group target membership/order. Metadata never remounts Runtime.

concepts.summary: Published Floe owns graph layout/routing/paint; Tessiven supplies canonical topology and details. Browser popup and native opening failures remain visible; never silently choose another route.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Canvas surfaces
Connected environments and Runtime details follow [scoped operations](../ai/tessiven-runtime-operations.md#runtime-operations). Distinct infrastructure responsibilities have distinct icons; repeated instances retain the same icon.

## Navigation and rendering
### Layout and routing
Canvas and thumbnails share Floe direction/layers/visibility. Saved positions order within rank, never override it. Isolated positioned nodes contribute actual bounds for fit.

### Connection scopes
Default overview has one directed connector per root endpoint pair; internal relationships remain in canonical overview without group self-loops. Overview/thumbnails always paint root scope, even during focused-host detail.

### Controls and rendering
Expand/collapse all groups reflows once, preserving selected visible object or enclosing group, without a document version. Large-graph tests count actual hosts, including grouped hosts.

## Document reading
View document lazily opens exact saved YAML in Floe's read-only themed code viewer: line numbers, guides, folding/find, default wrap and explicit wrap toggle. Escape closes find before dialog. Filename identifies canvas/version; copy/export preserve bytes, not reserialization. Plain source remains readable during loading; clipboard errors remain visible. Reading never changes versions.

## Relationship summaries
### Group summaries
Patterns use ordered canonical endpoints/granularity, kind, exact protocol and locality. Canvas/thumbnail share projection; raw relationship count never expands every group header.

### Interaction and details
Hover/focus never opens popups; lists never silently truncate at 100 references.

## Flower replies
### Reading surface
One opaque themed reading surface spans title/transcript/composer, with restrained border/shadow and compact spacing. End padding keeps final choices readable; actions stay outside fade.

### Actions and continuity
Each canvas owns multiple conversations with exactly one active. More offers new/history with active indicator, settings, subagents, available Computer actions and files. Activate history before opening composer. New drafts replace active identity only at canonical admission; returning preserves drafts. Copy/export/explicit fork remain shared across Desktop/Env.

Ongoing root/child work disables switching/new; server rejects stale activation, preserving visible errors/selection. Stop or settle first; switching never cancels implicitly. Live canvas metadata owns selection. Late admission refreshes it rather than posting another selection; canvas/visibility changes preserve drafts. Ordinary navigation, including stale ThreadID/live receipts, never renders canvas conversations. Existing content waits for product metadata; provisional new-thread receipts retain submitted canvas ownership. All messages/tools/questions/approvals/errors stay canonical; existing canvases open the combined window directly.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
The iOS host bundles shared TessivenGraph and published Floe as fixed resources. Data-only loading/rendered/failure/immutable selection messages are validated against canvas/version/objects before native details/Flower. Ask Flower focuses without sending.

### Explicit Group Packing
The shared mapper passes only visible presentation.groupLayouts to Floe; no second layout engine/menu. Browsing changes scenes, not saved topology/versions. Worker faults never produce guessed routes; culling cannot alter inspectable models. Native hosts share summary browsing/exact-object callbacks and load foundation plus graph styles. Canonical indexes/Set deduplication bound aggregation without another graph/router.

### Product verification
A rendered component or dev-server HTTP 200 is not connected Env acceptance. Both hosts must send a turn, display canonical streaming and exercise the compact reply menu using owned browser/Runtime fixtures.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
Initialization, persisted restoration, permission correction, automatic open and recovery use synchronous canonical commitment such as `commitNow()`. Genuinely blocking operations keep their dedicated presentation.

## Activity and retained content
Activity uses Shell UI-first mode and after-paint activation. Files preserves hidden virtual-grid measurements, usable width/range/scroll. Flower keeps the previous transcript during cold selection and replaces it only when the latest destination is ready.

## Measurement
Debug Console groups presentation events by surface/source. User interactions must avoid renderer tasks/frame gaps of 50 ms or more. Instrumentation flags intent at 32 ms and content at 100 ms; focused performance/browser gates enforce distributions and long-task limits.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:

Explicit environment replacement, permission-root replacement, connection recovery, resource-pressure policy already owned by the relevant subsystem, and user-requested closure may establish separate lifecycle boundaries; a navigation click alone may not.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Composition
Published matte palettes own canvas/widget/header/selection colors. Product adapters add no palette, preview or drag engine; adjacent-node changes retain responsive actions. Dark canvas has a 0.21 OKLCH lightness floor: Porcelain Dark uses #181819 around #0C0C0D body, including overview zoom; headers/borders/shadows/grid/light canvases retain palette/geometry.

Existing layouts, including intentionally empty advanced revisions, never reseed. Published controls own placeholders; locale changes update copy.

`workbench_layout_runtime` schema v6 appends sticky-note title via contiguous 5→6 migration. Handlers use current schema and persist material changes.

## Input ownership
Exported local-scroll viewport props declare `data-floe-canvas-wheel-interactive="true"` and a local-scroll role. Text-selection markers are separate and grant no wheel ownership unless combined with those props. Selected-widget boundaries guard canvas zoom. Image fit/actual-size reset deterministically; Ctrl/Cmd-wheel and keyboard `+`, `-`, `0`, `1` stay image-viewport scoped.

## Surface lifetime
Selection/loading/recovery retain widget identity. Floe owns Dock focus; selected Terminal viewports own wheel without DOM focus, unselected viewports remain canvas-owned. Shared recovery overlays make retained content inert without a visibility store.

[Page loading](page-loading-continuity.md#page-continuity) supplies per-widget Suspense/initial presentation while the canvas stays mounted; [Activity companion](flower-activity-companion.md#companion) owns retained Flower placement. Lazy delivery adds no lifecycle and cannot pre-mount inactive features or initialize Flower providers eagerly.

## Integration boundary
Projected widgets use the shared floating layer, never handmade viewport-to-surface coordinates or incidental DOM to infer canvas/input/recovery/focus/overlay ownership. Published Floeterm and floe-webapp own generic mechanisms.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Published Floe owns composition editing/floating mechanics. [Database migrations](../architecture/database-schema-migrations.md) owns atomicity, incompatible-schema rejection and startup failure; users never delete layouts to upgrade.

Lazy loading cannot weaken permissions, restoration, input or recovery. Only shell recovery snapshots may suspend the Workbench interaction tree. After terminal failure the retained canvas has no read/write interaction until a new Desktop session opens.

concepts.title: Workbench terminal interaction
concepts.summary: Floeterm terminal-go owns PTY, VT, geometry, controller epoch, semantic history and atomic Presentation. terminal-web renders one canvas/view and collects local input. [Activity companion](flower-activity-companion.md#companion) owns its measured footer; Workbench supplies none.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Ownership
One SessionActor owns each session; sequence/geometry generation only advance. All views receive the same canonical-dimension Presentation. Paint complete background before cells/graphics/selection/cursor to prevent stale resize/activation/theme edges. Floeterm owns attachment/geometry arbitration; browser views never parse bytes, own history or hide extra renderers.

Layout grants no attachment/control/input authority. TerminalInputBridge sends confirmed Unicode once, structured keys to native encoder and bounded paste. Reject script/malformed URLs, stale capabilities and remote paths.

Clear is actor semantic reset, never canvas erasure/Ctrl-L/recreation/detach. Stale generations do nothing. Close/delete removes catalog/attachments/capabilities; late events cannot resurrect sessions.

## History
Published HistoryScrollbar owns capture, frame-coalesced navigation, minimum thumb, cursors, track paging and Arrow/Page/Home/End. Redeven adds a 16 CSS-pixel rail, localized name/focus style and input focus restoration. History controller alone owns offset; cancel/capture-loss/blur/disposal release dragging.

Accepted text/paste/pressed or repeated keys return live through Floeterm input-follow by default; release-only, preedit, selection/copy, modifiers/background output do not. Persisted terminal:follow_input can disable it across Activity/Workbench/container surfaces. Return clears search/errors/stale retry/trace; old replies cannot restore browsing.

Settings separate new-session Runtime defaults from explicit current-session apply. Blank uses native defaults; zero grants no history budget. Rows and bytes (MiB display) jointly constrain page-granular storage, excluding live screen; neither means character count/screen dimensions. Only admins save defaults. Current-session apply needs interaction permission and confirmation for irreversible pruning; process/live screen/canonical geometry remain.

Fence reads/confirmation to selected session. Late defaults save refreshes visible defaults after selection changes. Unknown mutation blocks changes until explicit read-only reload, never replay. Old runtimes show unavailable; all shipped locales cover labels/feedback/confirmation.

## Product state
Dormant sessions are metadata-only; catalog has no renderer. Ask Flower reads selection or bounded visible semantic text; cwd requires current local-path capability. Canonical active/running/idle state and saved activity indicators remain authoritative. Opaque bodies/neutral static shadows stay unchanged during activation/drag/resize.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Redeven adapts Flowersec transport, permissions, local paths, responsive placement, notifications and Desktop URL/file actions. Never duplicate parsing/key encoding/history/arbitration/geometry/frame/cursor/graphics/rendering. No sibling links, raw-byte fallbacks, hidden renderers, resize reattach, swallowed errors or sequence rollback.
